levels.name: A1 — 入门
levels.description: 面向中文母语者的英语入门：发音、问候、代词、be 动词、数字、家庭、动词、冠词、疑问句、颜色、天气和地点。每一课都针对中文学习者最常见的错误。

topics.title: 字母与发音
topics.description: 中文里没有的英语字母和发音：th、v/w、r/l、æ、ng

guide.intro: 英语字母表由 26 个字母组成——与汉语拼音相比，包含 Q、W、X 等字母。重点不在书写而在发音：英语里有些声音在汉语中完全不存在。

rows: 无——不是 z，舌头在齿间
介于 a 与 e 之间的开口音

sections.text: 学习者最常见的错误：把「think」念成「tink」或「sink」。发「th」音时把舌尖轻轻放在上齿之间然后吹气。
W 与 V 的区别
汉语中没有「w」与「v」的对立。英语里这两个是不同的音，混淆会改变词义：「wine」（葡萄酒）和「vine」（藤蔓）是不同的词。发「W」时双唇像念「u」一样拢圆。

items: Q: queen, quick——几乎总是「qu」=「kw」音
W: window, week——双唇拢圆
X: box, six——「ks」音

lessons.title: 新字母：Q、W、X
lessons.description: 拼音里没有这样使用的英语字母

exercises.prompt: 「quick」里的「qu」发什么音？
exercises.explanation: 英语里 qu 几乎总是发「kw」音：queen = /kwiːn/，quick = /kwɪk/。中文学习者常按拼音读成「ku」，要注意。

exercises.prompt: 下面哪个单词里的字母 X 不发「ks」音？
exercises.explanation: 在 box / next / six 里 X 发「ks」；但 exam 里 X 在两个元音之间，发「gz」音。

exercises.prompt: 填字母：「___ater」(水)
exercises.explanation: 「water」以 W 开头。中文学习者要注意 W 与 V 不同——W 是双唇拢圆，V 是上齿咬下唇。

exercises.prompt: 把字母与示例单词配对
选择你听到的单词（注意 qu/k 的区别）
exercises.spokenText: queen

exercises.prompt: 在汉语拼音里很少独立出现、但在英语里常用的字母组合是？
exercises.explanation: 拼音里 qu 念「q+u」（如「去」），但英语里 qu 总是「kw」。这是中文学习者最常见的发音迁移错误。

exercises.prompt: 按字母表顺序排列：Q W X Y Z
exercises.explanation: 英语字母表的最后五个字母。

exercises.prompt: 填字母：「si___」(六)
exercises.explanation: six 以 x 结尾，发「ks」音。

exercises.prompt: 你听到哪个词？（注意 v 与 w 的区别）
exercises.spokenText: wet
exercises.explanation: 字母 W 读作「double-u」——词首发音时双唇要拢圆。

exercises.prompt: 选择正确的句子：
exercises.explanation: 中文里没有冠词，常说「我有问题」；但英语单数可数名词前必须有冠词：a question。

lessons.title: TH 音：think 与 this
lessons.description: 中文里没有的 /θ/ 和 /ð/ 音

exercises.prompt: 「think」里的 th 怎么发音？
options: 舌尖伸到上下牙齿之间，吹气（清音 /θ/）
exercises.answer: 舌尖伸到上下牙齿之间，吹气（清音 /θ/）
exercises.explanation: /θ/ 是中文里没有的音。学习者常念成「sink」或「tink」，要把舌尖放在齿间。

exercises.prompt: 填字母：「___ank you」(谢谢你)
exercises.explanation: 「Thank you」开头是 Th，发清音 /θ/。

exercises.prompt: 「this」里的 th 发什么音？
options: 浊音 /ð/，舌头在齿间但带声带振动
exercises.answer: 浊音 /ð/，舌头在齿间但带声带振动
exercises.explanation: this / that / the 里的 th 是浊音 /ð/。中文学习者常念成 z 或 d，但它和 z/d 都不一样。

exercises.prompt: 把单词与 th 的类型配对
你听到哪个词？（注意 think 与 sink 的区别）
exercises.spokenText: think
exercises.explanation: 学习者最常混淆的一对：think / sink。「th」音不是「s」。

exercises.prompt: 你听到哪个词？
exercises.spokenText: three
exercises.explanation: 中文学习者常把 three 念成 tree 或 free。注意 th 的舌位。

exercises.prompt: 填空：「I ___ English is fun.」(我觉得英语很有趣)
exercises.explanation: 「think」表示「认为，觉得」。注意 th 不是 s 也不是 t。

exercises.prompt: 选择正确的句子：
exercises.explanation: think (清 th /θ/) 和 this (浊 th /ð/) 都要练好，不要替换成 s 或 t。

exercises.prompt: 按顺序：「I think this is nice」
下面哪一个最难发？（中文母语者）
exercises.explanation: K、P、M 在中文里都有对应音，但 th 音在中文里完全不存在。

lessons.title: W 与 V 的区别
lessons.description: 中文里没有 V 音，学习者常把 V 念成 W

exercises.prompt: 字母 V 在英语里怎么发？
options: 上齿咬下唇，带声带振动（/v/）
exercises.answer: 上齿咬下唇，带声带振动（/v/）
exercises.explanation: 中文里没有 V 音。学习者常把 very 念成 wery。V 要上齿轻咬下唇。

exercises.prompt: 你听到哪个词？
exercises.spokenText: very
exercises.explanation: 「we」（我们）——双唇拢圆，不是 V。

exercises.prompt: 填字母：「___ ater」(水) 与「___ ery」(非常)
exercises.explanation: water 以 W 开头（双唇拢圆），very 以 V 开头（上齿咬下唇）。

exercises.prompt: 配对：字母与示例
选择你听到的词（注意 v/w 的区别）
exercises.explanation: wine（葡萄酒）和 vine（藤蔓）是不同的词。中文学习者常把它们混淆。
exercises.spokenText: wine

exercises.prompt: 选择正确发音：「very good」
exercises.spokenText: very
exercises.explanation: very 是浊音 V，不是 W，也不是 B。

exercises.prompt: 按顺序：「I like very cold water」
填空：「I drink a lot of ___ater.」(我喝很多水)
exercises.explanation: water 以 W 开头。

exercises.prompt: 你听到哪个词？
exercises.spokenText: vest

exercises.prompt: 下面哪个发音组合最常被中文母语者混淆？
exercises.spokenText: wine
exercises.explanation: 中文里 v 音不存在，所以 v 经常被替换成 w（very → wery）。

lessons.title: Æ 音：cat、apple
lessons.description: 中文里没有的开口前元音

exercises.prompt: 「cat」里的 a 怎么发音？
exercises.explanation: /æ/ 在中文里没有。把嘴张大、舌头放低，介于「啊」和「诶」之间。学习者常念成「凯特」(cat → /ket/)。

exercises.prompt: 填空：「I have an ___pple.」
exercises.explanation: apple 以 a /æ/ 开头，前面要用 an（元音前）。

exercises.prompt: 你听到哪个词？（注意 /æ/ 与 /e/）
exercises.spokenText: cat

exercises.prompt: 把单词与元音类型配对
下面哪个单词的元音是 /æ/？
exercises.explanation: bag /bæɡ/ 是 /æ/。big = /ɪ/, bug = /ʌ/, beg = /e/。

exercises.prompt: 你听到哪个词？
exercises.spokenText: man
exercises.explanation: man 是 /æ/。men 是 /e/。注意 /æ/ 嘴要张得大一些。

exercises.prompt: 填空：「I have a c___t.」(我有一只猫)
exercises.explanation: cat 中间是 /æ/。

exercises.prompt: 按顺序：「The cat is on the mat」
exercises.answer: The cat is on the mat

exercises.prompt: 选择正确的句子：
exercises.explanation: apple 以元音开头 → an；中文学习者常忘记加冠词（「I have apple」）。

exercises.prompt: 你听到哪个词？
exercises.spokenText: hat

lessons.title: 不发音字母与拼写
lessons.description: 英语里写出来但不发音的字母

exercises.prompt: 「know」里的 k 怎么读？
exercises.explanation: know / knee / knife 里的 k 都不发音。中文学习者拼字幕时常照字读，要特别记住。

exercises.prompt: 下面哪个字母在「write」里不发音？
exercises.explanation: write 里 w 不发音，发 /raɪt/。和 right 同音。

exercises.prompt: 填空：「I ___now him.」(我认识他)
exercises.explanation: know 以 k 开头，但 k 不发音。

exercises.prompt: 配对：单词与不发音的字母
你听到哪个词？
exercises.spokenText: know
exercises.explanation: know /noʊ/ 和 no /noʊ/ 同音，但拼写不同。

exercises.prompt: 填空：「One ___our has 60 minutes.」(一小时有60分钟)
exercises.explanation: hour 以 h 开头，但 h 不发音 → /aʊər/。所以要说 an hour（不是 a hour）。

exercises.prompt: 下面哪个单词的开头字母不发音？
exercises.explanation: hour 里 h 不发音；house / hat / happy 里 h 都要发音。

exercises.prompt: 按顺序：「I know an hour」
exercises.explanation: know 中的 K 不发音。

exercises.prompt: 选择你听到的词
exercises.spokenText: write
exercises.explanation: Hour 和 our 读音相同（「auır」）；H 不发音。

exercises.prompt: 选择正确的句子：
options: I know him for an hour.
I know him for a hour.
I knows him for an hour.
exercises.answer: I know him for an hour.
exercises.explanation: hour 以无声 h 开头 → 实际上以元音开头 → 用 an。

exercises.prompt: 填空：「Please ___rite your name.」
exercises.explanation: write 以 w 开头，但 w 不发音。

exercises.prompt: 配对：发音相同的对

lessons.title: 拼读练习
lessons.description: 逐字母拼读英文名字与单词

exercises.prompt: 「LI」（一个常见中文姓「李」的拼音）怎么逐字母拼读？
exercises.explanation: 在英语里逐字母拼名字时直接念字母名：L /el/，I /aɪ/。

exercises.prompt: 填空：拼读「CHEN」(陈) → 「C, H, E, ___」
exercises.explanation: Chen 由 C, H, E, N 四个字母组成。

exercises.prompt: 你听到哪个字母？
exercises.spokenText: G
exercises.explanation: G /dʒiː/ 和 J /dʒeɪ/ 是中文学习者最容易混淆的字母名。

exercises.prompt: 配对：字母名与字母
exercises.explanation: 按字母表读时 I 读作「ay」。

exercises.prompt: 选择正确的拼读：「WANG」(王)
按顺序拼读「LIU」(刘)：
填空：「My name is L___」(李)
exercises.explanation: 李 → Li，所以是字母 L + i。

exercises.prompt: 你听到哪个字母对？（容易混淆）
exercises.spokenText: B
exercises.explanation: B /biː/ 和 V /viː/ 是常见混淆。中文学习者常把 V 念成 B。

exercises.prompt: 选择正确的句子：
options: My name is Li. L, I.
My name is Li, L I am.
exercises.answer: My name is Li. L, I.
exercises.explanation: 中文里说「我叫李」不需要 is，但英语必须有 to be：My name **is** Li。

exercises.prompt: 填空：「How do you ___pell your name?」
exercises.explanation: spell = 拼读、拼写。

exercises.prompt: 配对：字母与示例单词
按顺序：「I am Liu. L-I-U.」
exercises.answer: I am Liu L I U

lessons.description: 在酒店前台用英文逐字母说出你的中文名字

turns.speaker: clerk

topics.title: 问候语
topics.description: Hello、Goodbye 和「你好吗」——注意英语里需要 be 动词和冠词

guide.intro: 英语问候因时段和场合正式程度而变化。汉语「你好」可以在任何场合使用，而英语需要掌握几种不同的说法。

sections.text: 「Good night」类似汉语的「晚安」——只用于睡前或夜里告别——不是晚上的问候语。晚上见面要说「Good evening」。
汉语里回答「你好吗？」只说「很好」就够了；英语中说「I'm fine, thanks. And you?」更礼貌——反问对方是惯例。

lessons.title: Hello 与 Goodbye
lessons.description: 基本问候与告别

exercises.prompt: 「你好」最常用的英语说法是？
exercises.explanation: 「Hello」是中性、任何时候都可用的问候语，对应中文的「你好」。

exercises.prompt: 「再见」用英语怎么说？
填空：「___, how are you?」(你好，最近怎么样？)
exercises.explanation: Hello 或 Hi 都可以，但句首要大写。

exercises.prompt: 把问候语与场合配对
你听到哪个词？
exercises.spokenText: hello

exercises.prompt: 选择正确的句子：
exercises.explanation: 「你好吗」字面上没有 be 动词，但英语里必须有：How **are** you?

exercises.prompt: 填空：「___ bye now.」(再见了)
exercises.explanation: Goodbye 由 good + bye 组成。

exercises.prompt: 按顺序：「Hello, my name is Li」
下面哪句话最不自然？
exercises.explanation: 「Long time no see」其实是中式英语（来自「好久不见」），在母语者里也用，但在 A1 阶段先掌握「Nice to see you again」更标准。

exercises.prompt: 你听到哪个词？
exercises.spokenText: goodbye

lessons.title: 按时间问好
lessons.description: Good morning / afternoon / evening / night

exercises.prompt: 「早上好」用英语怎么说？
「Good night」什么时候用？
exercises.explanation: Good night ≠ 晚上的问候语。晚上见面要说 Good evening。Good night 类似中文的「晚安」，只用在睡前。

exercises.prompt: 填空：「___ afternoon, teacher.」(下午好，老师)
把英语与对应的中文配对
你听到哪个词？
exercises.spokenText: morning

exercises.prompt: 晚上 8 点见到朋友，应该说？
exercises.explanation: 中文学习者常把 Good night 当成「晚上好」，其实它只用于睡前告别。

exercises.prompt: 按顺序：「Good morning, how are you?」
填空：上午 10 点见同事 → 「___ morning!」
选择正确的句子：
exercises.explanation: 和「你怎么样」对应的英语是 How **are** you——不要漏掉 are。

exercises.prompt: 你听到哪个词？
exercises.spokenText: evening

lessons.title: 你好吗？
lessons.description: 问候近况——记得用 be 动词

exercises.prompt: 「你好吗」用英语怎么说？
exercises.explanation: 中文「你好吗」字面上没有 to be，但英语必须有：How **are** you?

exercises.prompt: 回答「我很好，谢谢」最自然的说法？
exercises.explanation: 中文「我很好」常省略「是」，但英语主语后必须有 be 动词：I **am** fine（缩写 I'm）。

exercises.prompt: 填空：「I ___ fine, thanks.」
exercises.explanation: I 后面用 am。

exercises.prompt: 把问句与回答配对
你听到哪个词？
exercises.spokenText: fine

exercises.prompt: 选择正确的回答：「How are you?」
exercises.explanation: 完整的礼貌回答应该用 I'm（= I am），并礼貌反问 And you?

exercises.prompt: 按顺序：「How are you today?」
exercises.explanation: 英语中道谢并反问对方是礼貌的做法。

exercises.prompt: 填空：「I ___ very well, thank you.」
选择最自然的回答：
exercises.spokenText: I'm fine

exercises.prompt: 你听到哪个词？
exercises.spokenText: thanks
exercises.explanation: thanks 开头是 th /θ/，不是 t 也不是 s。

lessons.title: 相识：问名字和介绍自己
lessons.description: 「What's your name?」与「My name is...」

exercises.prompt: 「你叫什么名字」用英语怎么说？
exercises.explanation: 中文「你叫什么名字」字面没有「是」，但英语必须有 is：What **is** your name?

exercises.prompt: 填空：「My ___ is Li.」(我叫李)
选「我叫陈」的正确说法：
exercises.explanation: 标准句型 My name **is** + 名字。

exercises.prompt: 把问句与回答配对
你听到哪个词？
exercises.spokenText: name

exercises.prompt: 按顺序：「Nice to meet you」
填空：「___ to meet you.」(很高兴认识你)
选择正确的句子：
exercises.explanation: 中文「我来自中国」直译没有 be 动词，英语里必须有 am。

exercises.prompt: 你听到哪个句子？
exercises.spokenText: What is your name?

exercises.prompt: 按顺序：「My name is Chen」

lessons.title: 正式与随意的问候
lessons.description: 什么场合用 Hi，什么场合用 How do you do

exercises.prompt: 对老师/上司，哪种问候最合适？
exercises.explanation: 正式场合用 Good morning + 称谓。在英语里 Mr./Ms. + 姓 表示尊敬。

exercises.prompt: 对朋友最自然的问候是？
exercises.explanation: 「What's up?」是随意、日常的问候。

exercises.prompt: 填空：「___, Mr. Chen. How are you?」(正式场合)
exercises.explanation: 晚间：good evening；睡前：good night。

exercises.prompt: 把问候与正式程度配对
你听到哪个？
exercises.spokenText: Hello

exercises.prompt: 选择对老师最合适的回应：
exercises.explanation: 在中国习惯叫「老师」，在英语国家更常用 Mr./Ms. + 姓，或直接用 Good morning。

exercises.prompt: 按顺序：「Good morning, Mr. Wang」
填空：「How ___ you?」(正式问候)
exercises.explanation: 「Pleased to meet you.」= 很高兴认识你。

exercises.prompt: 选择正确的句子：
exercises.explanation: 「Hello」是问候，不是告别。

exercises.prompt: 把英语与中文配对
你听到哪个词？
exercises.spokenText: sir
exercises.explanation: 初次见面时说。

exercises.prompt: 按顺序：「Pleased to meet you」

lessons.title: 自我介绍
lessons.description: 姓名、国籍、职业——记得加 a/an

exercises.prompt: 「我是中国人」最自然的说法？
exercises.explanation: 国籍要用形容词形式（Chinese / American），不是国家名。并且必须有 am。

exercises.prompt: 填空：「I am ___ student.」(我是学生)
exercises.explanation: 中文「我是学生」没有冠词，但英语单数可数名词前必须有 a / an。

exercises.prompt: 「我是医生」用英语怎么说？
exercises.explanation: 中文学习者最常见的错误是漏掉 a：「I am doctor」是错的。

exercises.prompt: 把职业与英语配对
exercises.spokenText: I am from Istanbul.

exercises.prompt: 你听到哪个？
exercises.spokenText: Chinese

exercises.prompt: 选择正确的句子：
exercises.explanation: 「我从北京来」对应「I **am** from Beijing」——必须有 am。

exercises.prompt: 按顺序：「I am a teacher」
exercises.explanation: 汉语「我是医生」是几个字，英语「I am a doctor」是三个词。

exercises.prompt: 填空：「I am ___ engineer.」(我是工程师)
exercises.explanation: engineer 以元音 /e/ 开头 → an（不是 a）。

guide.intro: 汉语里「他/她/它」发音相同，只在字形上有别。英语用三个完全不同的代词：he（男性）、she（女性）、it（无生命/动物）。这是学习者最易出错的语法点之一。

sections.text: 汉语「他/她」发音相同，所以学习者经常把女性说成「he」。指女性时要记得用「she」：「My sister... she is nice.」。最常见的错误是给女性用「he」。
汉语「我」可以小写。英语中只有一个字母的代词「I」必须永远大写——即使在句子中间。

topics.title: 冠词入门：a / an / the
topics.description: 中文里没有冠词——这是中文学习者最大的难点

guide.intro: 汉语没有「a/an/the」这样的冠词。「我读了一本书」中的「一本」有点像不定冠词。英语中可数单数名词前必须加「a/an」或「the」。

rows: a book, a car, a teacher
an apple, an egg, an umbrella

sections.text: 规则看的是发音，不是字母本身。说「an hour」是因为「h」不发音，词以元音音开头。说「a university」是因为「u」这里读「yu」（辅音音）。

rows.translation: 我看见一只猫。（哪只不重要。）
我看见那只猫。（特指的猫。）

sections.text: 汉语用「这/那」之类的限定词来特指；英语用「the」。当没有限定词、泛指时，往往用「a/an」（可数单数）或不用冠词（不可数/复数泛指）。

lessons.title: A 还是 An？
lessons.description: 辅音前 a，元音前 an

exercises.prompt: 「一个苹果」用英语怎么说？
exercises.explanation: apple 以元音 /æ/ 开头 → 用 an。

exercises.prompt: 「一本书」用英语怎么说？
exercises.explanation: book 以辅音 /b/ 开头 → 用 a。

exercises.prompt: 填空：「I have ___ orange.」
填空：「She is ___ engineer.」
exercises.explanation: engineer 以元音 /e/ 开头 → an。

exercises.prompt: 把单词与冠词配对

exercises.explanation: student 辅音开头 → a。中文「我是学生」没冠词，但英语必须加。

exercises.prompt: 下面哪句话是错的？
exercises.explanation: 「I have apple」中文学习者最常见的错误：漏掉冠词。正确：I have an apple。

lessons.title: The（定冠词）
lessons.description: 特指的时候用 the

exercises.prompt: 什么时候用 the？
options: 已经提过或上下文中明确的事物
exercises.answer: 已经提过或上下文中明确的事物
exercises.explanation: the 表示「特定的」，第一次提及用 a/an，再次提及用 the。

exercises.prompt: 下面哪句话用 the 正确？
exercises.explanation: 世界上唯一的事物（太阳、月亮、地球）用 the。

exercises.prompt: 填空：「I see a cat. ___ cat is white.」
exercises.explanation: 第二次提到 → the（已知的那只猫）。

exercises.prompt: 把句子与冠词配对

pairs.left: I see a car. ___ car is red.

exercises.prompt: 「开门」(指特定的那扇门) 用英语？
exercises.explanation: 「读这本书」=「read the book」；「读一本书」=「read a book」。

exercises.prompt: 填空：「___ moon is beautiful tonight.」
按顺序：「The sun is bright」
选择正确的句子：「请把书递给我」(指特定的那本)
exercises.explanation: 首次提到用「a cat」（新信息）；再次提到用「the cat」（已知）。

exercises.prompt: 你听到哪个？
exercises.spokenText: the
exercises.explanation: the 在元音前读 /ði/，辅音前读 /ðə/。注意 th 是浊音。

exercises.prompt: 下面哪句话是错的？
options: I like the music.（一般地说，喜欢音乐）
I like the music in this movie.
exercises.answer: I like the music.（一般地说，喜欢音乐）
exercises.explanation: 泛指喜欢音乐用「I like music」（无冠词）。「I like the music」要指特定的音乐。

lessons.title: 什么时候不用冠词

exercises.prompt: 「我喜欢狗」(一般地说) 用英语怎么说？

下面哪句话是错的？

I drink coffee in the morning.

exercises.explanation: 泛指地说喝水不加 the。「the water」是指特定的那杯/瓶水。

topics.title: 疑问词
topics.description: What、where、when、who、why、how

guide.intro: 汉语用疑问助词「吗」或疑问词（什么、谁、哪里）在中间或句末。英语的疑问词永远放在句子的开头。

rows: What is this? — 这是什么？

sections.text: 结构：疑问词 + (do/does/is/are/was/were) + 主语 + …？ 例：「Where do you live?」（你住在哪里？）

topics.title: 天气
topics.description: 天气词汇及 “How is the weather?” 句型

guide.intro: 汉语里说「下雨」或「冷」可以没有主语——动词和形容词单独成句。英语里的天气句子总是以「It is ...」或「It + 动词」开头。这里的「it」没有具体含义——只是语法上必须有主语。

sections.text: 汉语「冷。」可以单独成句；英语「Cold.」单独不成句，要说「It is cold.」。这里的「it」不代表「它」——是没有实际意义的语法主语。
汉语问「天气怎么样？」。英语用「How is the weather?」或「What's the weather like?」。
注意区别：「rains」与「is raining」不同。「It rains in winter」（冬天下雨——泛指）与「It is raining now」（现在正在下雨）含义不同。

guide.intro: 汉语用「在……」表示位置：「在家」、「在学校」、「在公园」。英语根据地点不同要用不同的介词：in、at、on。最常用的是「in」（里面）和「at」（在某一具体地点）。

sections.text: 汉语的「在」在英语里要分三个词：「in」（在……里面——较大的地方、城市）、「at」（在某一具体点——地址、地点名称）、「on」（在……上面——表面之上）。

rows.source: The book is on the table.

items: at home（在家）——不用「in」

at work（在工作）——不用「in」
in bed（在床上）——不用「on」

sections.text: 把汉语「在家」直译为「in home」是常见错误。正确说法是「at home」。

topics.title: 一般过去时 (Past Simple)
topics.description: 用规则和不规则动词讲述过去 —— 解决中文「漏掉 -ed」的高频错误

guide.intro: 中文用「了」或时间词(昨天、上周)表达过去;英语用一般过去时(past simple),动词本身要变。规则动词加 -ed,不规则动词有特殊形式。所有人称的形式都一样 —— 不像中文要靠语境,英语靠动词形式本身。

sections.text: 拼写规则:辅音 + y → 把 y 变 i 再加 ed (study → studied)。单音节 + 单辅音 → 双写辅音再加 ed (stop → stopped)。以 e 结尾 → 只加 d (live → lived)。
用了 didn't/did 之后,动词要还原成原形。中文学习者常常说「I didn't went」(错),正确是「I didn't go」。这是 A2 阶段最常见的错误之一——中文没有时态变化,英语却既要助动词又要保留原形。

topics.title: 现在进行时 (Present Continuous)
topics.description: 正在发生的动作 —— 解决中文「漏掉 be 动词」的高频错误

guide.intro: 中文用「正在……」「在……呢」或在动词后加「着」表示正在进行;英语用「am/is/are + 动词-ing」。「我正在吃」=「I am eating」。重点要区分:一般现在时讲习惯,现在进行时讲此刻正在做。be 动词不能省略。

sections.text: 中文「我正在吃」可以省略 be 动词,但英语不行。「I eating」错误;必须写「I am eating」。这是中文学习者最容易遗漏 be 动词的地方。

rows: 单音节 + 单辅音字母(双写)

sections.text: 一般现在时 vs 现在进行时

rows.translation: 她今天在上班。(具体今天)

sections.text: 状态动词(know / love / understand / want / 表「拥有」的 have)不用 -ing 形式。「I am loving you」错误,正确是「I love you」。

guide.intro: 中文用「更」「最」放在形容词前(更大、最大)。英语却是形容词本身变化:短形容词加 -er/-est,长形容词前加 more/most。比较时用 than(不是 from!)。

topics.description: 表达拥有 —— she has(不是 she have)是 A2 的高频难点

guide.intro: 中文用「有」表示拥有。英语有两种说法:have 和 have got。两者意思一样;have got 在英式日常对话中更常用。注意第三人称单数:She have(错)→ She has(对)。

sections.text: have got = have(拥有)。但 have 还能做动作动词:I have breakfast(我吃早饭)—— 这种情况下不能换成 have got。
第三人称单数(he / she / it)要用 has,不是 have。中文「她有」一个字管所有人称;英语必须 She has。「She have」是中文学习者最高频错误之一。

topics.title: 情绪

guide.intro: 中文「我饿了」「我累了」可以直接说,英语却必须用 be 动词:「I am hungry.」漏掉 am/is/are 是中文学习者最高频的错误之一。

「How are you?」是寒暄(你好吗?);「How do you feel?」更常用于对生病或心情不好的人。

sections.text: enjoy 后面只能跟 -ing(enjoy swimming 对,enjoy to swim 错)。like / love / hate 两种都行。want / would like 只能跟 to + V。
play 配运动(play football / play tennis),go 配某些活动(go swimming / go shopping),do 配其他活动(do yoga / do karate)。

sections.text: 有计划 → going to。说话时临时决定 → will。预测时:没证据用 will,有证据用 going to。

levels.name: B1 — 中级英语
levels.description: 面向中文为母语的英语学习者:现在完成时、情态动词、条件句、被动语态、短语动词和假朋友词汇。重点突破中文里没有直接对应的英语结构。

topics.title: 现在完成时 (have/has + V3)
topics.description: 描述「从过去延续到现在」的动作 — 中文用「了/过」,英语必须用 have/has + 过去分词

guide.intro: 现在完成时是中文母语者最难掌握的英语时态。中文用「了」「过」表达「做完了」「经历过」,但「了」既能对应英语过去时,也能对应现在完成时,所以同学们经常误用过去时(I lived here for three years)。核心规则:动作开始于过去,直到现在仍有影响或仍在持续 → 必须用 have/has + V3。

sections.text: 肯定:主语 + have/has + V3(过去分词)。否定:主语 + haven't/hasn't + V3。疑问:Have/Has + 主语 + V3?
中文「我在北京住了三年」既可能指现在还住(present perfect),也可能指过去某段时间(past simple)。英语必须二选一。

rows.source: I have lived in Beijing for three years.
rows.translation: 我在北京住了三年(现在仍住在那里)。

rows.source: I lived in Beijing for three years.
rows.translation: 我在北京住过三年(现在不住了)。
她读过这本书(现在知道内容)。
她昨天读了这本书(过去某时间点)。

sections.text: 「yesterday」「last week」「in 2010」「when I was a child」这类「明确过去时间」不能与现在完成时连用。错误:「I have seen him yesterday.」正确:「I saw him yesterday.」

rows: + 起点 (2020, Monday, I was a child)

sections.text: 中文「自从」和「已经」都可以翻成 since 或 already,但 since 后面一定是「起点」,for 后面一定是「时长」。中文影响下常出错:「I have lived here since 5 years」是错的,应该是「for 5 years」。

rows.source: I have just finished my homework.
I haven't seen that film yet.
rows.translation: 我还没看过那部电影。(否定)

rows.source: Have you ever been to London?

sections.text: 中文母语者最常见的两个错误:1) 漏掉 have(「I been to Beijing」);2) 用过去时代替现在完成时(「I lived here for 3 years」表达「现在仍住」)。

lessons.title: 结构:have/has + V3
lessons.description: 现在完成时的基础结构

exercises.prompt: 「She ___ finished her work.」空格里应该填什么?
exercises.explanation: 第三人称单数 (she/he/it) 用「has」。中文里没有人称变化,这是中文母语者最常忽略的点。

exercises.prompt: 动词「go」的过去分词(V3)是什么?
exercises.explanation: go-went-gone。「went」是过去式,「gone」是过去分词,用在现在完成时里。

exercises.prompt: 「I ___ seen that film.」完成这个否定句(中文:「我没看过那部电影。」)
exercises.explanation: 否定:have + not = haven't。中文用「没」一个字否定,英语必须 have + not + V3。

exercises.prompt: 匹配动词原形和它的过去分词(V3)

exercises.spokenText: I have lost my keys.

exercises.prompt: 构造疑问句:「___ you ever been to Paris?」
exercises.explanation: 疑问句:Have/Has + 主语 + V3?中文「你去过……吗」用「吗」结尾,英语用 have 提前。

exercises.prompt: 动词「write」的过去分词形式是:
exercises.explanation: write-wrote-written。「wrote」是过去式(I wrote a letter),「written」是过去分词(I have written a letter)。

lessons.title: 现在完成时 vs 一般过去时
lessons.description: 什么时候用现在完成时,什么时候用一般过去时?

exercises.prompt: 「我在北京住了三年(现在仍住在那里)。」用英语怎么说?
options: I lived in Beijing for 3 years.
I am living in Beijing for 3 years.
I have lived in Beijing for 3 years.
I live in Beijing since 3 years.
exercises.answer: I have lived in Beijing for 3 years.
exercises.explanation: 「现在仍持续」→ 现在完成时。中文用「了」容易让人误选过去时。

exercises.prompt: 「我昨天看见他了。」用英语怎么说?
exercises.explanation: 「yesterday」是明确过去时间 → 一般过去时。现在完成时不能和明确过去时间词连用。

exercises.prompt: 哪一个时间表达不能和现在完成时连用?
exercises.explanation: 「yesterday」指向已结束的过去时间点。同类:last week, in 2010, when I was young。

exercises.prompt: 「I ___ (live) here since 2018.」
exercises.explanation: since + 起点 → 现在完成时。

exercises.prompt: 「She ___ (visit) Rome last summer.」
exercises.explanation: 「last summer」是明确过去 → 一般过去时。

exercises.prompt: 把句子和它表达的时态意义匹配

pairs.right: 一般过去时 — 过去某时间点,现已结束

pairs.left: I have lived in Shanghai since 2010.
pairs.right: 现在完成时 — 现在仍在那里
一般过去时 — 去年,现在不在那儿了

pairs.left: I have worked here for a year.
pairs.right: 现在完成时 — 已持续一年

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确句子:「她从一月起就在这里工作(到现在仍在)」
exercises.answer: She has worked here since January

exercises.prompt: 听并选择你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: We have known each other for ten years.
options: We have known each other for ten years.
We knew each other for ten years.
We have known each other since ten years.
We have know each other for ten years.
exercises.answer: We have known each other for ten years.

exercises.prompt: 哪一句是错的?
options: I have been here since Monday.
I have lived here for two years.
exercises.explanation: 「in 2015」是明确过去时间 → 必须用一般过去时:「I saw him in 2015.」

exercises.prompt: 「When I was a child, I ___ (love) ice cream.」
exercises.explanation: 「when I was a child」是明确过去语境 → 一般过去时。

lessons.title: for / since 的区别
lessons.description: 时长用 for,起点用 since

exercises.prompt: 「___ three years」(三年了)
exercises.explanation: 时长 (3 years) → for。
起点 (2020) → since。

exercises.prompt: 「I have known her ___ five years.」
exercises.explanation: 时长 → for。

exercises.prompt: 「He has worked here ___ Monday.」
exercises.explanation: Monday 是起点 → since。

exercises.prompt: for 还是 since?
把单词排成正确句子:「我学英语学了两年了(到现在还在学)」
exercises.answer: I have studied English for two years

exercises.prompt: 哪一句是正确的?
options: I have lived here since 5 years.
I have lived here for 5 years.
I have lived here from 5 years.
I am living here since 5 years.
exercises.answer: I have lived here for 5 years.
exercises.explanation: 5 years 是时长 → for。「since 5 years」是中文母语者最常见的错误之一。

exercises.prompt: 听并选择你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: She has been ill since Tuesday.
options: She has been ill since Tuesday.
She has been ill for Tuesday.
She has been ill from Tuesday.
exercises.answer: She has been ill since Tuesday.

exercises.prompt: 「We haven't seen each other ___ a long time.」
「我从早上一直在工作。」用英语怎么说?
options: I have been working since morning.
exercises.answer: I have been working since morning.
exercises.explanation: 「一直在做」+「从早上(起点)」→ 现在完成进行时 + since。

lessons.title: just / already / yet / ever / never
lessons.description: 现在完成时常用副词的微妙差别

exercises.prompt: 「I have ___ finished.」(刚刚完成)
exercises.explanation: 「just」= 刚刚,极近的过去。

exercises.prompt: 「Have you finished ___?」(还……了吗)
exercises.explanation: 「yet」用于疑问句和否定句,放在句尾。

exercises.prompt: 「I have ___ been to Italy.」(从来没去过)
exercises.explanation: 「never」本身就是否定意义,不需要再加 not。

exercises.prompt: 「Have you ___ tried sushi?」(曾经)
exercises.explanation: 「ever」= 曾经,用于疑问句。

exercises.prompt: 把副词和它的中文含义匹配
把单词排成正确句子:「她已经离开了」
哪一句是错的?
exercises.explanation: 「yet」只能用于疑问句或否定句,肯定句要用「already」。

exercises.prompt: 听并选择你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: He has never seen the sea.
options: He has never seen the sea.
He has ever seen the sea.
He has never see the sea.
exercises.answer: He has never seen the sea.

exercises.prompt: 「The train has ___ arrived.」(刚到)
「你以前去过日本吗?」用英语怎么说?
options: Have you been to Japan ever?
Have you ever been to Japan?
Did you ever go to Japan before?
Have you ever go to Japan?
exercises.answer: Have you ever been to Japan?
exercises.explanation: 「ever」放在主语和 V3 之间。注意是 been,不是 go。

lessons.title: ever / never / yet / just / already 综合
lessons.description: 现在完成时副词的综合练习

exercises.prompt: 「我已经吃过午饭了。」用英语怎么说?
options: Both B and C are correct.
exercises.answer: Both B and C are correct.
exercises.explanation: 「already」可以放在 have 和 V3 之间,也可以放在句尾。但一定要用现在完成时,不能光用过去时。

exercises.prompt: 「他还没回来。」用英语怎么说?
exercises.explanation: 「yet」用于否定句,放在句尾。注意是 hasn't + V3,不是过去时 didn't。

exercises.prompt: 「I have ___ finished my report.」(刚刚)
「She hasn't called me ___.」(还没)
把句子和情境匹配

pairs.left: Have you ever woken up at 5 a.m.?

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确句子:「他从来没看过那部电影」
exercises.answer: He has never seen that film

exercises.prompt: 哪一句不自然?
exercises.explanation: 「ever」一般只用于疑问句,不用于陈述句。

exercises.prompt: 听并选择你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: I haven't finished my homework yet.
options: I haven't finished my homework yet.
I have finished my homework yet.
I didn't finish my homework yet.
I haven't finish my homework yet.
exercises.answer: I haven't finished my homework yet.

exercises.prompt: 「你做过寿司吗?」用英语怎么说?
exercises.explanation: 问经历用现在完成时 + ever,V3 是 made。

exercises.prompt: 「The bus has ___ left.」(已经)
「我从来没听过这首歌。」哪句对?
options: I have never hear this song.
I never have heard this song.
I have never heard this song.
I haven't never heard this song.
exercises.answer: I have never heard this song.
exercises.explanation: never + V3 (heard)。never 本身是否定,不能再加 not。

exercises.prompt: 句子与正确翻译匹配

lessons.title: 现在完成进行时(have/has been + V-ing)
lessons.description: 强调动作的持续与过程

exercises.prompt: 「我等了两个小时了。」用英语怎么说?
options: I am waiting for two hours.
I have waited for two hours.
I have been waiting for two hours.
exercises.answer: I have been waiting for two hours.
exercises.explanation: 「一直在做某事」+ 强调持续过程 → 现在完成进行时 (have been + V-ing)。

exercises.prompt: 「She ___ ___ ___ (study) all morning.」(她整个上午一直在学习)
exercises.explanation: has been + V-ing。

exercises.prompt: 现在完成进行时的结构是:
exercises.explanation: have/has + been + 现在分词。

exercises.prompt: 「They ___ ___ ___ (work) on this project since June.」
exercises.explanation: since + 起点 → 现在完成进行时强调持续。

exercises.prompt: 选择更自然的时态

pairs.left: 我跑了 5 公里(刚结束,有结果)
我跑了 1 小时了(还在跑)
pairs.right: I have been running for an hour.

pairs.left: 她一直在读书,还没读完
pairs.right: She has been reading the book.

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确句子:「我学了三年英语了(仍在学)」
exercises.answer: I have been studying English for three years

exercises.prompt: 哪一句更强调「持续了很久」的过程?
options: I have been reading for hours.
exercises.answer: I have been reading for hours.
exercises.explanation: 现在完成进行时强调「持续 + 过程」。

exercises.prompt: 听并选择你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: It has been raining all day.
options: It has been raining all day.
It has been rain all day.
exercises.answer: It has been raining all day.

exercises.prompt: 哪个动词不能用现在完成进行时?
exercises.explanation: 状态动词(know、love、like、believe)一般不用进行时。要说「I have known her for years」,不是「I have been knowing」。

exercises.prompt: 「How long ___ ___ ___ (learn) English?」(到目前为止学了多久了)
exercises.explanation: 问「持续多久」用现在完成进行时。

exercises.prompt: 「我刚跑完步,所以满身大汗。」哪句对?
options: I have run, so I am sweaty.
I have been running, so I am sweaty.
I am running, so I am sweaty.
I ran, so I am sweaty.
exercises.answer: I have been running, so I am sweaty.
exercises.explanation: 强调最近持续的动作留下的痕迹 → 现在完成进行时。

exercises.prompt: 选择更合适的时态(完成时 vs 完成进行时)

pairs.left: 强调结果:她写完三封邮件了
强调过程:她一直在写邮件
强调过程:我一直在学 Python

lessons.title: 对话:多年后重逢
lessons.description: 在咖啡馆偶遇老朋友 — 自然语境中的现在完成时

exercises.prompt: 在咖啡馆偶遇老朋友 — 注意现在完成时的用法

turns.speaker: emma
turns.text: Oh my goodness, is that really you? I haven't seen you in ages!

turns.speaker: you
turns.text: Emma! Wow, you look exactly the same. How long has it been?

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 选择正确的时态(我们已经多久没见面了 — 持续到现在)
options: We haven't met since university, I think.
We didn't meet since university, I think.
We don't meet since university, I think.
turns.answer: We haven't met since university, I think.

turns.speaker: emma
turns.text: That's almost six years! So tell me everything. What have you been up to?

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 填入正确的助动词(现在完成时)
turns.after: just moved to a new flat downtown.

turns.speaker: emma
turns.text: Downtown? That's lovely. I've always dreamed of living near the centre.

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 时长用 for 还是 since?
options: I've actually been there for three months now.
I've actually been there since three months now.
I've actually been there from three months now.

turns.speaker: emma

topics.title: 情态动词(can、must、should、may、might)
topics.description: 表达能力、许可、义务和可能性

guide.intro: 情态动词在中文里对应「能、会、应该、必须、可能」等不同副词。中文母语者最常犯的错误是:1) 在情态动词后加 to(must to go);2) 用 must 表达「必须」而忽略 have to;3) 把「应该」全部翻成 should,忽视 ought to / had better 的微妙差别。

sections.text: 情态动词后必须跟动词原形,且不带 to。错误:He can to swim. 正确:He can swim. 例外:have to、ought to、had better(后面跟原形,但前两者带 to)。

rows: 能力(I can swim)、许可(Can I go?)
强烈义务(主观)、强烈推断

rows.translation: 我必须今晚完成(我自己觉得必须)。

rows.source: I have to wear a uniform at work.
rows.translation: 上班必须穿制服(规定要求)。

sections.text: mustn't 和 don't have to 完全不同!mustn't = 禁止(不能做);don't have to = 不必(可以不做)。

rows.translation: 你应该去看医生(一般建议)。
你应该道歉(比 should 更正式)。
你最好现在就走(不走会有麻烦)。

sections.text: 中文母语者高频错误:must to (×) → must (√);should to (×) → should (√)。情态动词后绝不能加 to(have to / ought to 除外)。

lessons.title: can / could — 能力与许可
lessons.description: 「会」「能」「可以」的英语对应

exercises.prompt: 「她会游泳。」用英语怎么说?
exercises.explanation: can + 动词原形。中文母语者常错加 to 或加 s。

exercises.prompt: 「我可以问个问题吗?」最礼貌的问法?
exercises.explanation: could 比 can 更礼貌、更委婉。may 也礼貌,但更正式。

exercises.prompt: 「When I was young, I ___ run very fast.」(过去能力)
exercises.explanation: 「过去能够做某事」用 could。

exercises.prompt: 哪一句是错的?
options: He can to speak three languages.
exercises.answer: He can to speak three languages.
exercises.explanation: can 后面不加 to,直接接动词原形。这是中文母语者最高频的错误。

exercises.prompt: 把句子和它表达的含义匹配

pairs.left: I could ski when I was 10.
pairs.right: 我十岁时会滑雪。(过去能力)

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确句子:「他不会开车」
听并选择你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: Could you open the window, please?
options: Could you open the window, please?
Can you open the window, please?
Could you to open the window, please?
You could open the window, please?
exercises.answer: Could you open the window, please?

exercises.prompt: 「___ I borrow your pen?」(可以借你的笔吗?礼貌请求)
exercises.explanation: Could / May 都很礼貌;Can 也可以,但稍微随便。

exercises.prompt: 「我小时候不会游泳。」用英语怎么说?
options: I cannot swim when I was a child.
I couldn't swim when I was a child.
I didn't can swim when I was a child.
I don't could swim when I was a child.
exercises.answer: I couldn't swim when I was a child.
exercises.explanation: 过去否定能力用 couldn't,不是 didn't can。

exercises.prompt: 「你能给我讲一下吗?」(礼貌请求)
exercises.explanation: Could you + 动词原形(无 to)。

lessons.title: must / have to — 义务
lessons.description: 主观必须 vs 客观规则

exercises.prompt: 「我必须今晚完成作业。」哪句对?
options: I must to finish my homework tonight.
I must finish my homework tonight.
I have finish my homework tonight.
I should to finish my homework tonight.
exercises.answer: I must finish my homework tonight.
exercises.explanation: must 后面直接跟动词原形,不加 to。这是中文母语者最常见的错误。

exercises.prompt: 「员工必须戴工作牌。」(客观规定)
options: Employees must to wear a badge.
Employees have to wear a badge.
exercises.answer: Employees have to wear a badge.
exercises.explanation: 外部规定一般用 have to。must 偏主观感受。

exercises.prompt: mustn't 和 don't have to 的区别是什么?
options: mustn't = 禁止;don't have to = 不必
mustn't = 不必;don't have to = 禁止
exercises.answer: mustn't = 禁止;don't have to = 不必
exercises.explanation: 「You mustn't smoke」= 禁止抽烟(不能);「You don't have to come」= 你不必来(可以不来)。

exercises.prompt: 「你不必道歉(可以选择不道歉)。」哪句对?
exercises.explanation: 「不必」= don't have to;mustn't = 禁止。

exercises.prompt: 「You ___ ___ (wear) a helmet on this site.」(规则要求)
exercises.explanation: 外部规定一般用 have to;主观也可用 must。

exercises.prompt: 把英语句子和中文含义匹配
把单词排成正确句子:「我必须早起」
exercises.answer: I have to get up early

exercises.prompt: 听并选择你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: You don't have to come if you're tired.
options: You don't have to come if you're tired.
You mustn't come if you're tired.
You don't must come if you're tired.
You haven't to come if you're tired.
exercises.answer: You don't have to come if you're tired.

exercises.prompt: 「过去式」表示「必须」:I ___ work yesterday.
exercises.explanation: must 没有过去式,过去「必须」用 had to。

exercises.prompt: 「Children ___ ___ wear school uniforms.」(必须 — 规定)
exercises.explanation: 学校规定可以用 have to 或 must。

lessons.title: should — 建议
lessons.description: 委婉的建议、轻微的义务

exercises.prompt: 「你应该多睡一点。」哪句对?
exercises.explanation: should + 动词原形,不加 to。

exercises.prompt: 「You ___ ___ (see) a doctor.」(建议)
exercises.explanation: should + 原形 see,不要写成 to see 或 saw。

exercises.prompt: 「你不应该熬夜。」哪句对?
options: You shouldn't to stay up late.
You don't should stay up late.
You should not to stay up late.
exercises.explanation: shouldn't + 原形。注意没有 do/does 助动词。

exercises.prompt: 「我该走了吗?」哪句对?
exercises.explanation: 疑问句:Should + 主语 + 原形?

exercises.prompt: 「She doesn't feel well. She ___ rest.」(应该)
exercises.explanation: should 是建议。

exercises.prompt: 把建议和情境匹配
把单词排成正确句子:「你应该多锻炼」
听并选择你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: You shouldn't worry too much.
options: You don't should worry too much.
You shouldn't to worry too much.

exercises.prompt: should、must、have to 之中,哪个语气最弱?
exercises.explanation: should = 建议;must / have to = 必须。

exercises.prompt: 「I think you ___ apologise to her.」(应该)
exercises.explanation: 建议用 should。

lessons.title: may / might — 可能性
lessons.description: 「也许」的两个英语对应

exercises.prompt: 「他可能在家。」哪句最自然?
options: He may to be at home.
exercises.explanation: may + 动词原形(be)。注意 may be 是两个词,maybe 是副词。

exercises.prompt: may 和 might 哪个表达「可能性更小」?
exercises.explanation: might 表达的可能性比 may 稍小,也更不确定。

exercises.prompt: 「明天可能会下雨。」哪句对?
exercises.explanation: might + 原形,主语第三人称也不变形。

exercises.prompt: 「She ___ ___ (come) later, but I'm not sure.」(可能 — 不确定)
exercises.explanation: 不确定的可能性 → might / may + 原形。

exercises.prompt: 把英文情态动词和中文匹配

pairs.right: 可能(中等可能性,较正式)
可能(较低可能性,不太确定)

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确句子:「他可能晚到」
听并选择你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: She might not come to the party.
options: She might not come to the party.
She may not come to the party.
She might not comes to the party.
She doesn't might come to the party.
exercises.answer: She might not come to the party.

exercises.prompt: 「他一定在家(肯定)。」(强烈推断)
exercises.explanation: must 用于强烈推断:「一定是」。

exercises.prompt: 「She left an hour ago. She ___ be at the airport by now.」(强烈推断 — 一定)
exercises.explanation: must 表示「肯定、一定」。

exercises.prompt: 「他不可能在那儿,他在中国。」哪句对?
options: He mustn't be there. He's in China.
He can't be there. He's in China.
He may not be there. He's in China.
He shouldn't be there. He's in China.
exercises.answer: He can't be there. He's in China.
exercises.explanation: 推断否定用 can't(= 不可能);mustn't = 禁止。

lessons.title: must / have to / mustn't / don't have to
lessons.description: 义务与禁止的细致区别

exercises.prompt: 「你不能在这儿抽烟(禁止)。」哪句对?
options: You don't have to smoke here.
exercises.explanation: 禁止 = mustn't。don't have to = 不必,不是禁止。

exercises.prompt: 「你不必为我做这个(随你)。」
options: You mustn't do this for me.
You don't have to do this for me.
You haven't to do this for me.
You don't must do this for me.
exercises.answer: You don't have to do this for me.
exercises.explanation: 「不必」= don't have to;mustn't 是禁止。

exercises.prompt: 「Passengers ___ ___ (fasten) their seatbelts.」(规则 — 必须)
「Tomorrow is Sunday. I ___ ___ ___ (work).」(不必)
exercises.explanation: 「不必」用 don't have to,不是 mustn't。

exercises.prompt: 义务程度匹配
把单词排成正确句子:「你不能这么跟我说话」
exercises.answer: You mustn't talk to me like that

exercises.prompt: 哪一句意思是「禁止」?
options: You may not want to enter.
exercises.explanation: mustn't = 不可以(禁止)。

exercises.prompt: 听并选择你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: You don't have to bring anything.
options: You don't have to bring anything.
exercises.answer: You don't have to bring anything.

exercises.prompt: 「我昨天必须工作。」哪句对?
exercises.explanation: must 没有过去式;过去「必须」用 had to。

exercises.prompt: 「She ___ ___ stay late at the office last night.」(过去 — 必须)
exercises.explanation: 过去的「必须」用 had to。

exercises.prompt: 哪句最自然?(图书馆里)
options: You don't have to speak loudly.
exercises.explanation: 禁止用 mustn't。

exercises.prompt: 句子和中文意思匹配

pairs.right: 我必须 8 点走(自己想)。

lessons.title: should / ought to / had better
lessons.description: 建议、温和义务和带警告的建议

exercises.prompt: 「你最好现在就走(不走会出事)。」
exercises.explanation: had better 比 should 更强,带警告意味。

exercises.prompt: ought to 后面跟什么?
exercises.explanation: ought + to + 原形:「You ought to apologise.」注意 ought to 是少数自带 to 的情态动词。

exercises.prompt: 「You ___ ___ (apologise) for being late.」(应该 — ought to)
exercises.explanation: ought + to + 原形。

exercises.prompt: 「We ___ ___ leave before the storm.」(最好 — had better)
exercises.explanation: had better + 动词原形,不带 to。

exercises.prompt: 把情态动词和语气匹配

pairs.right: 最好(警告,不照做有麻烦)

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确句子:「你最好关上窗户」
exercises.answer: You had better close the window

exercises.prompt: 哪一句是错的?
options: You ought to see a doctor.
You had better to see a doctor.
You had better see a doctor.
exercises.answer: You had better to see a doctor.
exercises.explanation: had better 后面不加 to,直接动词原形。

exercises.prompt: 听并选择你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: You'd better not be late again.
options: You'd better not be late again.
You'd better to not be late again.
You don't better be late again.
You'd not better be late again.
exercises.answer: You'd better not be late again.

exercises.prompt: had better 的否定形式是?
exercises.explanation: 否定:had better + not + 动词原形(「You had better not go.」)。

exercises.prompt: 「You ___ ___ ___ touch that wire — it's dangerous.」(最好不要)
「我们应该多帮助别人。」(温和建议、道德意义)
options: We had better help others more.
We ought to help others more.
We have to help others more.
exercises.answer: We ought to help others more.
exercises.explanation: ought to 略带道德、义务意味,适合这种语境。

exercises.prompt: 句子与正确翻译匹配

pairs.right: 你最好休息(不然会病倒)。

lessons.title: 对话:向同事征求建议
lessons.description: 就一个项目向同事请教 — 情态动词的自然使用

exercises.prompt: 与同事讨论一个棘手的项目 — 注意情态动词的搭配

turns.speaker: you
turns.text: Raj, do you have a minute? I'd like your advice on something.

turns.speaker: raj
turns.text: Of course, what's on your mind?

turns.speaker: you
turns.text: I'm stuck on this project. The deadline is Friday.

turns.speaker: raj
turns.prompt: 选择正确的情态动词搭配(建议 — should + 原形)
options: You should talk to the manager about extending the deadline.
You should to talk to the manager about extending the deadline.
You must to talk to the manager about extending the deadline.
turns.answer: You should talk to the manager about extending the deadline.

turns.speaker: you
turns.text: I thought about that, but I don't want to look unprepared.

turns.speaker: raj
turns.prompt: 填入合适的情态动词(强烈推断:她一定会理解)
turns.after: understand. She's been in this situation before.

turns.speaker: you
turns.text: That's true. Any other ideas?

turns.speaker: raj
turns.prompt: 选择正确的句子(最好 — had better + 原形)
options: You had better start with the easy parts first.
You had better to start with the easy parts first.
You should better start with the easy parts first.
turns.answer: You had better start with the easy parts first.

turns.speaker: you
turns.text: Good point. I tend to overthink things.

turns.speaker: raj
turns.text: We all do. Just remember, you don't have to be perfect.

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 填入合适的情态动词(也许会有帮助 — 不确定的可能性)
turns.before: Thanks. I think a short walk
turns.after: help me clear my head.

turns.speaker: raj
turns.text: Excellent idea. Go for it — and good luck!

topics.title: 条件句(if 从句)
topics.description: 零型、第一型和第二型条件句 — 真实 vs 假设

guide.intro: 中文「如果……就……」结构统一,但英语条件句根据「真实性」分成几型,动词形式各不相同。中文母语者最常见的错误是把第一型和第二型混在一起(例如「If I have time tomorrow, I would go」)。

rows.source: If you heat water to 100°C, it boils.
If I'm tired, I drink coffee.
If it rains tomorrow, we will stay home.
rows.translation: 如果明天下雨,我们就待在家。

rows.source: If I have time tonight, I'll call you.
rows.translation: 我今晚有空就给你打电话。

sections.text: 1 型条件句:if 从句里不能用 will!错误:「If it will rain」;正确:「If it rains」。

rows.source: If I had a million dollars, I would buy a house.
rows.translation: 如果我有一百万美元,我就会买房子(实际上没有)。

rows.source: If I were you, I would apologise.
rows.translation: 如果我是你,我会道歉(我不是你)。

sections.text: 2 型条件句惯用「If I were」(不是 was),即使主语是 I/he/she。这是从虚拟语气延续下来的固定用法。

items: if + will:「If it will rain」(× → If it rains)
类型混搭:「If I have time, I would go」(× → If I have time, I will go)
省略助动词:「If I am you」(× → If I were you)
用现在时表假设:「If I am rich」(× 真实 / If I were rich = 假设)

lessons.title: 零型条件句 — 一般真理
lessons.description: 科学规律和习惯性事实

exercises.prompt: 「水加热到 100°C 就沸腾。」哪句对?
options: If you heat water to 100°C, it will boil.
If you heat water to 100°C, it boils.
If you will heat water to 100°C, it boils.
If you heated water to 100°C, it would boil.
exercises.answer: If you heat water to 100°C, it boils.
exercises.explanation: 0 型条件句:if + 现在时 + 现在时,表达一般真理。

exercises.prompt: 「If I ___ (be) tired, I ___ (drink) coffee.」(0 型 — 习惯)
exercises.explanation: 0 型:if + 现在时 + 现在时。

exercises.prompt: 哪一句是 0 型条件句(一般真理)?
options: If it rains, the grass gets wet.
If it rains tomorrow, we'll stay home.
If I had time, I would help.
If she comes, please tell me.
exercises.answer: If it rains, the grass gets wet.
exercises.explanation: 0 型 = 自然/习惯性结果。

exercises.prompt: 「If you ___ (mix) red and blue, you ___ (get) purple.」
把 if 从句和合适的主句匹配(0 型)
把单词排成正确句子:「我累的时候就喝咖啡」
exercises.answer: If I am tired I drink coffee

exercises.prompt: 听并选择你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: If it snows, the roads get slippery.
options: If it snows, the roads get slippery.
If it will snow, the roads get slippery.
If it snowed, the roads would get slippery.
If it snows, the roads will get slippery.
exercises.answer: If it snows, the roads get slippery.

exercises.prompt: 0 型条件句最大的特点是?
options: if 从句和主句都用现在时
if 从句用现在时,主句用 will
if 从句用过去时,主句用 would
if 从句用 will,主句用现在时
exercises.answer: if 从句和主句都用现在时
exercises.explanation: 0 型 = 两边都是现在时。

exercises.prompt: 「If it ___ (be) sunny, kids ___ (play) outside.」(0 型)
哪一句是错的?
options: If you don't sleep, you get tired.
If you don't sleep, you will get tired.
If you don't sleep, you would get tired.
If you didn't sleep, you would get tired.
exercises.answer: If you don't sleep, you would get tired.
exercises.explanation: if + 现在时 + would 是类型混搭。要么用 will(1 型),要么 if 从句用过去时(2 型)。

lessons.title: 第一型条件句 — 将来可能
lessons.description: 可能发生的将来

exercises.prompt: 「如果明天下雨,我们就待在家。」哪句对?
options: If it will rain tomorrow, we stay home.
If it rains tomorrow, we will stay home.
If it rained tomorrow, we would stay home.
If it rains tomorrow, we would stay home.
exercises.answer: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay home.
exercises.explanation: 1 型:if + 现在时,主句 will + 原形。

exercises.prompt: 「If I ___ (have) time tomorrow, I ___ (call) you.」(1 型)
exercises.explanation: 1 型:if + 现在时,主句 will + 原形。

exercises.prompt: 哪一句是错的?
options: If you study hard, you will pass.
If you will study hard, you will pass.
If she comes, I will be happy.
If it rains, the picnic will be cancelled.
exercises.answer: If you will study hard, you will pass.
exercises.explanation: 1 型条件句:if 从句里不能用 will!这是中文母语者高频错误。

exercises.prompt: 「If you ___ (eat) too much, you ___ (feel) sick later.」(1 型 — 警告)
把 if 从句和合适的主句匹配(1 型)
把单词排成正确句子:「如果我有空我就来」
exercises.answer: If I am free I will come

exercises.prompt: 听并选择你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: If you are late again, I will be very upset.
options: If you are late again, I will be very upset.
If you will be late again, I will be very upset.
If you were late again, I would be very upset.
If you are late again, I would be very upset.
exercises.answer: If you are late again, I will be very upset.

exercises.prompt: 1 型条件句的结构是什么?
options: if + 过去时, would + 原形
if + 现在时, will + 原形
if + 现在时, 现在时
exercises.answer: if + 现在时, will + 原形

exercises.prompt: 「If she ___ (call), I ___ (tell) her the news.」(1 型)
哪一句最自然?
options: If it will be sunny, we go to the beach.
If it is sunny, we will go to the beach.
If it is sunny, we would go to the beach.
If it was sunny, we will go to the beach.
exercises.answer: If it is sunny, we will go to the beach.
exercises.explanation: 将来可能 + 将来计划 → 1 型。

lessons.title: 第二型条件句 — 假设现在
lessons.description: 与现实相反的假设

exercises.prompt: 「如果我是百万富翁,我就会买一栋房子(我不是)。」
options: If I am a millionaire, I will buy a house.
If I were a millionaire, I would buy a house.
If I will be a millionaire, I would buy a house.
If I were a millionaire, I will buy a house.
exercises.answer: If I were a millionaire, I would buy a house.
exercises.explanation: 2 型:if + 过去时(were), 主句 would + 原形 = 与现实相反的假设。

exercises.prompt: 「If I ___ (be) you, I ___ (apologise).」(2 型 — 我不是你)
exercises.explanation: 「If I were you」是固定表达(虚拟语气),很标准。

exercises.prompt: 哪一句表达「与现实相反」?
options: If I have time, I'll help you.
If I had time, I would help you.
If I'm tired, I drink coffee.
If it rains, we stay home.
exercises.answer: If I had time, I would help you.
exercises.explanation: had + would = 2 型 = 现在不可能/不真实。

exercises.prompt: 「If she ___ (know) the truth, she ___ (be) angry.」(2 型)
把 if 从句和合适的主句匹配(2 型)

pairs.right: we would speak French every day.

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确句子:「如果我有钱我就买」
exercises.answer: If I had money I would buy it

exercises.prompt: 听并选择你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: If I were you, I would take the job.
options: If I were you, I would take the job.
If I am you, I will take the job.
If I were you, I will take the job.
If I was you, I would taking the job.
exercises.answer: If I were you, I would take the job.

exercises.prompt: 2 型条件句的结构是?
options: if + 现在时, will + 原形
if + 过去时, would + 原形
if + 过去时, will + 原形
if + 过去完成时, would have + V3
exercises.answer: if + 过去时, would + 原形

exercises.prompt: 「If I ___ (win) the lottery, I ___ (travel) around the world.」(2 型)
「如果我是鸟,我就会飞。」哪句最自然?
options: If I am a bird, I can fly.
If I were a bird, I would fly.
If I will be a bird, I would fly.
If I was a bird, I will fly.
exercises.answer: If I were a bird, I would fly.
exercises.explanation: 不可能/假设 → 2 型,if + were + would。

lessons.title: 三种条件句综合练习
lessons.description: 选择正确的类型

exercises.prompt: 「如果明天有时间,我会给你打电话。」(将来 — 可能)
options: If I had time tomorrow, I would call you.
If I have time tomorrow, I will call you.
If I will have time tomorrow, I call you.
If I have time tomorrow, I would call you.
exercises.answer: If I have time tomorrow, I will call you.
exercises.explanation: 将来可能 = 1 型。中文母语者常错把 1 型和 2 型混搭(if 现在 + would)。

exercises.prompt: 「如果我有时间(实际没有),我会帮你。」(假设)
options: If I have time, I would help you.
If I had time, I would help you.
If I had time, I will help you.
If I will have time, I would help you.
exercises.answer: If I had time, I would help you.
exercises.explanation: 与现实相反 = 2 型,if + had + would。

exercises.prompt: 「植物缺水就会枯死。」(一般真理)
options: If plants don't get water, they die.
If plants will not get water, they die.
If plants didn't get water, they would die.
If plants don't get water, they will die.
exercises.answer: If plants don't get water, they die.
exercises.explanation: 0 型 = 自然规律。两边都用现在时。

exercises.prompt: 「If I ___ (be) rich, I ___ (help) the poor.」(2 型 — 假设)
「If you ___ (study), you ___ (pass) the exam next week.」(1 型 — 真实将来)
把句子和它的类型匹配

pairs.left: If you heat ice, it melts.
If it rains, we will stay home.
If I were rich, I would travel.
If I have time, I'll call.

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确句子:「如果我是你,我就道歉(我不是你)」
exercises.answer: If I were you I would apologise

exercises.prompt: 听并选择你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: If I had a map, I wouldn't be lost now.
options: If I had a map, I wouldn't be lost now.
If I have a map, I won't be lost now.
If I had a map, I won't be lost now.
If I will have a map, I wouldn't be lost.
exercises.answer: If I had a map, I wouldn't be lost now.

exercises.prompt: 哪一句类型混搭(错误)?
options: If it rains, we will stay home.
If I had money, I would buy it.
If I have time, I would help.
If you heat water, it boils.
exercises.answer: If I have time, I would help.
exercises.explanation: if + 现在时 + would = 类型混搭(中文母语者最高频的错误)。应该是 will help 或者 if I had time, I would help。

exercises.prompt: 「如果我中了彩票(假设),我会环游世界。」
options: If I win the lottery, I would travel the world.
If I won the lottery, I would travel the world.
If I had won the lottery, I would travel.
If I won the lottery, I will travel the world.
exercises.answer: If I won the lottery, I would travel the world.
exercises.explanation: 2 型 — 假设(不太可能):if + 过去时 + would + 原形。

lessons.title: 混合条件句和第三型条件句
lessons.description: 过去对现在 / 过去对过去

exercises.prompt: 「如果当初我学得更努力一点,现在就会有更好的工作。」(过去 → 现在)
options: If I studied harder, I would have a better job now.
If I had studied harder, I would have a better job now.
If I had studied harder, I will have a better job now.
If I studied harder, I had a better job now.
exercises.answer: If I had studied harder, I would have a better job now.
exercises.explanation: 混合型:if + had + V3 (过去) + would + 原形 (现在结果)。

exercises.prompt: 「如果当时我看到他,我就会跟他打招呼。」(过去对过去 — 3 型)
options: If I saw him, I would say hello.
If I had seen him, I would have said hello.
If I had seen him, I would say hello.
If I saw him, I would have said hello.
exercises.answer: If I had seen him, I would have said hello.
exercises.explanation: 3 型:if + had + V3 + would have + V3。过去事实的相反假设。

exercises.prompt: 「If I ___ ___ ___ (know) earlier, I ___ ___ ___ (help) you.」(3 型 — 当时不知)
「If she ___ ___ ___ (take) the bus, she ___ ___ ___ ___ (be) here by now.」(混合 — 过去对现在)
条件句类型匹配

pairs.left: If I had studied, I would have passed.
If I had studied, I would have a good job now.
If I studied, I would pass.
If I study, I will pass.

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确句子:「我要是当时知道我就告诉你了」
exercises.answer: If I had known I would have told you

exercises.prompt: 3 型条件句的结构是?
options: if + 过去时, would + 原形
if + 过去完成时, would have + V3
if + 现在时, will + 原形
if + 过去完成时, will + 原形
exercises.answer: if + 过去完成时, would have + V3
exercises.explanation: 3 型用于过去与事实相反的假设。

exercises.prompt: 听并选择你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: If you had told me earlier, I could have helped.
options: If you had told me earlier, I could have helped.
If you told me earlier, I could help.
If you had told me earlier, I will help.
If you told me earlier, I would help.
exercises.answer: If you had told me earlier, I could have helped.

exercises.prompt: 「他们如果早点来,就赶上飞机了(他们没赶上)。」
options: If they came earlier, they would catch the flight.
If they had come earlier, they would have caught the flight.
If they will come earlier, they catch the flight.
If they come earlier, they will catch the flight.
exercises.answer: If they had come earlier, they would have caught the flight.
exercises.explanation: 已经错过 → 3 型,had come + would have caught。

exercises.prompt: 「If I ___ ___ ___ (sleep) more, I ___ ___ ___ ___ (feel) better today.」(混合)
选出语法错误的句子:
options: If I were rich, I would buy a house.
If I had been rich, I would have bought a house.
If I had been rich, I will buy a house.
If I had been rich, I would buy a house now.
exercises.answer: If I had been rich, I will buy a house.
exercises.explanation: 中文「如果」不区分真实/虚拟条件。英语中 if + had + V3 (虚拟过去) 必须配 would/could/might，不能配 will (那是真实将来条件)。

exercises.prompt: 把句子配对到对应的含义:

pairs.left: If I were taller, I'd be a model.
pairs.right: 现在事实相反 (现在我个子矮)

pairs.left: If I had studied, I'd have passed.
pairs.right: 过去事实相反 (过去没学习)

pairs.left: If I had studied, I'd have a job now.
pairs.right: 过去原因 + 现在结果 (混合条件)

pairs.left: If you heat ice, it melts.

lessons.title: wish / if only / unless
lessons.description: 愿望、遗憾和例外

exercises.prompt: 「我希望我会说法语(其实不会)。」哪句对?
options: I wish I can speak French.
I wish I could speak French.
I wish I will speak French.
exercises.answer: I wish I could speak French.
exercises.explanation: wish + 过去时 = 与现在事实相反的愿望;能力用 could。

exercises.prompt: 「我希望我没说过那句话(后悔)。」
options: I wish I didn't say that.
I wish I haven't said that.
I wish I hadn't said that.
I wish I won't say that.
exercises.answer: I wish I hadn't said that.
exercises.explanation: wish + 过去完成时 = 对过去的遗憾。

exercises.prompt: 「I wish I ___ (be) taller.」(现在愿望)
exercises.explanation: wish + were/was 表达现在愿望。were 更正式、更标准。

exercises.prompt: 「You won't pass ___ you study.」(除非)
exercises.explanation: unless = if not,「除非」。

exercises.prompt: 把句子和正确翻译匹配

pairs.left: I wish I had a car.
pairs.right: 我希望我有车(现在没有)。

pairs.left: I wish I had bought it.

pairs.right: 我要是年轻一点就好了!

pairs.right: 除非你快点,否则会迟到。

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确句子:「除非下雨,否则我们就去野餐」
exercises.answer: We will go on a picnic unless it rains

exercises.prompt: 「Unless you call me, I won't come.」意思等同于?
options: If you call me, I won't come.
If you don't call me, I won't come.
If you call me, I will come.
If you don't call me, I will come.
exercises.answer: If you don't call me, I won't come.
exercises.explanation: unless = if not。

exercises.prompt: 听并选择你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: I wish I could fly.

exercises.prompt: 「If only I ___ younger!」(虚拟 — 现在)
exercises.explanation: if only + were(虚拟,与现在相反)。

exercises.prompt: 「She won't talk to me ___ I apologise.」(除非)
选出语法错误的句子:
options: I wish I had been rich.
exercises.explanation: 中文「我希望」+ 现在状态可能让人想用 am/is/are。英语 wish 后面跟过去式 (虚拟): I wish I were/was... (现在愿望) 或 I wish I had been (过去愿望)。

exercises.prompt: 把句子配对到对应的含义:

pairs.right: 现在很遗憾 (此刻不知道)
过去很遗憾 (那时不知道)
希望你将来打 (含责备/期盼)
如果不下雨我们就去 (= If it doesn't rain)

lessons.title: 对话:如果我中了彩票……

exercises.prompt: 和朋友讨论假设中彩票后的计划 — 注意 2 型条件句

turns.speaker: leo

If I win that, I would quit my job immediately.
If I had won that, I would quit my job immediately.
turns.answer: If I won that, I would quit my job immediately.

turns.speaker: you
turns.text: Really? Wouldn't you miss it after a while?

turns.speaker: leo
turns.prompt: 填入正确的 if 从句动词形式(2 型 — 假设)
turns.after: richer, I would still want to do something meaningful.

If I have the money, I would travel for a whole year.

turns.after: buy my parents a beautiful house.

topics.title: 被动语态(Passive Voice)
topics.description: 用 be + V3 构成的被动句

guide.intro: 中文「被」字句的使用范围比英语 passive 窄得多,而且不一定要明示。英语在很多场合(科学描述、新闻、客观说明)必须用被动语态,但中文常用主动语态。中文母语者最常见的错误是:1) 漏掉 be(「the book wrote by him」);2) 用动词原形或过去式代替 V3(「was eat」)。

sections.text: 被动语态 = 主语 + be + V3(过去分词)+ (by + 施动者)。be 的形式根据时态变化。
主动 → 被动 的步骤

items: 找到主动句的宾语 → 变成被动句的主语
动词改为 be + V3
主动句的主语用 by 引出(可省)

rows.translation: 莎士比亚写了《哈姆雷特》。(主动)
《哈姆雷特》是莎士比亚写的。(被动)

sections.text: 中文母语者高频错误:漏掉 be 动词。错误:「The book wrote by him」 → 正确:「The book was written by him.」
另一个高频错误:动词不变 V3 形式。错误:「The room was clean by her」 → 正确:「The room was cleaned by her.」

lessons.title: 基本结构和主动-被动转换
lessons.description: be + V3 的基础

exercises.prompt: 「这本书是他写的。」哪句对?
options: The book was wrote by him.
The book was written by him.
The book is wrote by him.
exercises.answer: The book was written by him.
exercises.explanation: 被动 = be + V3。write-wrote-written;过去 → was/were + written。漏 be、用过去式、不变 V3 都是常见错误。

exercises.prompt: 「这个房间正在被打扫。」(现在进行)
exercises.explanation: 现在进行被动 = is/are + being + V3。

exercises.prompt: 「The window ___ ___ (break) yesterday.」(过去被动)
exercises.explanation: was + V3 (broken)。

exercises.prompt: 「English ___ ___ (speak) all over the world.」(现在被动)
exercises.explanation: is + V3 (spoken)。

exercises.prompt: 把主动句和它的被动形式匹配
把单词排成正确被动句:「蛋糕是妈妈做的」
exercises.answer: The cake was made by mum

exercises.prompt: 把「People speak Spanish here」改成被动:
exercises.explanation: 现在时被动 = is + V3 (spoken)。

exercises.prompt: 听并选择你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: The letter was sent yesterday.

exercises.prompt: 哪一句是错的?
options: The car was washed by John.
The car was wash by John.
The car is washed every Saturday.
The car will be washed tomorrow.
exercises.answer: The car was wash by John.
exercises.explanation: 被动必须用 V3(washed),不是动词原形(wash)。

exercises.prompt: 「The cake ___ ___ (eat) by the children.」(过去被动)
exercises.explanation: was + eaten(eat 的 V3)。

lessons.title: 不同时态中的被动
lessons.description: 过去时、现在完成时、将来时的被动语态

exercises.prompt: 「房子已经被建好了。」(现在完成被动)
exercises.explanation: 现在完成被动 = has/have + been + V3。

exercises.prompt: 「报告明天就会被完成。」(将来被动)
options: The report will be finished tomorrow.
The report will being finished tomorrow.
The report is going finished tomorrow.
exercises.answer: The report will be finished tomorrow.
exercises.explanation: 将来被动 = will + be + V3。

exercises.prompt: 「The bridge ___ ___ ___ (build) by next year.」(将来完成被动)
exercises.explanation: 将来完成被动 = will + have + been + V3。

exercises.prompt: 「Dinner ___ ___ ___ (prepare) when I came home.」(过去进行被动)
exercises.explanation: 过去进行被动 = was/were + being + V3。

exercises.prompt: 时态和被动结构匹配
把单词排成正确句子:「这部电影会被很多人观看」
exercises.answer: The film will be watched by many people

exercises.prompt: 「这道菜每天都被很多人点。」(现在时被动)
options: This dish is ordered by many people every day.
This dish ordered by many people every day.
This dish has ordered by many people every day.
This dish was ordered by many people every day.
exercises.answer: This dish is ordered by many people every day.
exercises.explanation: 现在时 + 被动 → is + V3。

exercises.prompt: 听并选择你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: The car has been repaired.

exercises.prompt: 哪一句正确?
options: The room is being clean now.
The room is being cleaned now.
The room is be cleaned now.
exercises.answer: The room is being cleaned now.
exercises.explanation: 现在进行被动 = is + being + V3。

exercises.prompt: 「The package ___ ___ (deliver) tomorrow.」(将来被动)
exercises.explanation: 将来被动 = will + be + V3。

lessons.title: 什么时候用被动语态?
lessons.description: 中文偏主动,英语在很多场合偏被动

exercises.prompt: 哪种情境最自然用被动语态?
exercises.explanation: 施动者不重要或不明 → 被动。「Television was invented in 1925.」

exercises.prompt: 「This building was built in 1900.」中,by 后面省略的原因?
options: 因为施动者不明或不重要
因为被动句不能用 by
exercises.answer: 因为施动者不明或不重要
exercises.explanation: 施动者不重要时,by 短语可以省。

exercises.prompt: 「Penicillin ___ ___ (discover) in 1928.」(科学/历史 — 常用被动)
「My phone ___ ___ (steal) last night.」(被偷,不知是谁)
exercises.explanation: steal-stole-stolen。

exercises.prompt: 把句子和它适合的场景匹配

pairs.right: 出版信息(施动者不重要)

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确句子:「这首歌是 1965 年录制的」
下面哪句最不自然?
options: The Mona Lisa was painted by Leonardo.
I was opened the door by her.
exercises.answer: I was opened the door by her.
exercises.explanation: 中文母语者常错误地把双宾语动词的主动变被动,加多余的 by。「She opened the door for me.」无需变被动。

exercises.prompt: 听并选择你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: The cake was eaten by the kids.
options: The cake was eaten by the kids.
The cake was eat by the kids.
The cake ate by the kids.
The cake is eat by the kids.
exercises.answer: The cake was eaten by the kids.

exercises.prompt: 「Someone broke my phone.」改成被动:
exercises.explanation: 施动者是 someone(不明确),可以省 by。break-broke-broken。

exercises.prompt: 「This temple ___ ___ (build) over 500 years ago.」(历史事实)

lessons.title: 被动语态 — 综合练习
lessons.description: 所有时态和用法的综合

exercises.prompt: 「我的车昨天被偷了。」哪句对?
exercises.explanation: 过去被动 = was + V3 (stolen)。

exercises.prompt: 「这个问题已经解决了。」(现在完成被动)
exercises.explanation: has been + V3。

exercises.prompt: 把主动句「They are building a new bridge」变成被动:
options: A new bridge is being built.
A new bridge will be built.
exercises.answer: A new bridge is being built.
exercises.explanation: 现在进行被动 = is/are + being + V3。

exercises.prompt: 「The window ___ ___ (clean) every Monday.」(现在时被动 — 习惯)
「The thieves ___ ___ (catch) last night.」(过去被动)
exercises.explanation: catch-caught-caught。复数主语 thieves → were。

exercises.prompt: 把主动句变成被动
把单词排成正确句子:「这部小说被翻译成 30 种语言」
exercises.answer: The novel has been translated into 30 languages

exercises.prompt: 听并选择你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: The door was opened by the wind.
options: The door was opened by the wind.
The door was open by the wind.
The door opened by the wind.
The door is opening by the wind.
exercises.answer: The door was opened by the wind.

exercises.prompt: 哪句不正确?
options: The room is clean by her.
exercises.answer: The room is clean by her.
exercises.explanation: 缺少 V3 形式;应该是「is cleaned by her」。

exercises.prompt: 「我们正在被监视。」(现在进行被动)
exercises.explanation: 现在进行被动 = are + being + V3。

lessons.title: 被动语态的时态变化
lessons.description: 不同时态的被动结构

exercises.prompt: 「咖啡是巴西种植的。」(现在时被动 — 一般事实)
options: Coffee has been grow in Brazil.
exercises.explanation: 现在时被动 = is + V3 (grown)。grow-grew-grown。

exercises.prompt: 「他被警察问话了。」(过去被动)
options: He was questioned by the police.
He was question by the police.
He has questioned by the police.
exercises.answer: He was questioned by the police.

exercises.prompt: 「The work ___ ___ (complete) next week.」(将来被动)
「The cake ___ ___ ___ (cut) when we arrived.」(过去进行被动)
时态结构匹配
把单词排成正确句子:「问题已经解决了」
「The car is being repaired.」意思是?
exercises.explanation: is being + V3 = 现在进行被动。

exercises.prompt: 听并选择你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: The package will be sent tomorrow.
options: The package will be sent tomorrow.
exercises.answer: The package will be sent tomorrow.

exercises.prompt: 「The bridge was being built when I last visited.」是什么时态的被动?
「This film ___ ___ ___ (release) yet.」(现在完成被动 — 否定)
「This song has been ___ million times.」(被下载过)
exercises.explanation: has been + V3 (downloaded)。

exercises.prompt: 句子和正确时态名称匹配

lessons.title: by + 施动者 和 get + V3 被动
lessons.description: 被动句中的施动者以及非正式的「get」被动

exercises.prompt: 「My phone got stolen yesterday.」用了哪种被动?
exercises.explanation: get + V3 是更口语化的被动,常用于「不好的事」(get stolen, get hurt, get fired)。

exercises.prompt: 什么时候可以省略「by + 施动者」?
options: 当施动者不重要或不明时
当施动者是 by 时
exercises.answer: 当施动者不重要或不明时
exercises.explanation: 「by 施动者」在大多数被动句中是可选的。

exercises.prompt: 「He ___ ___ (hurt) in the accident.」(get 被动 — 不幸的事)
「The window was broken ___ a stone.」(用 — 工具)
exercises.explanation: 施动者用 by;工具也常用 with(broken with a stone)。

exercises.prompt: 把句子和它的施动者/工具搭配

pairs.left: The letter was written by Tom.
The cake was cut with a knife.
The Mona Lisa was painted by Leonardo.
The wall was painted with a brush.

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确句子:「他在比赛中受伤了」(get 被动)
exercises.answer: He got injured in the match

exercises.prompt: 下列哪一个 get 被动最自然?
options: All of the above are natural.
exercises.answer: All of the above are natural.
exercises.explanation: get 被动在口语里非常常见,尤其表达事件的发生。

exercises.prompt: 听并选择你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: My bike got stolen last week.
options: My bike got stolen last week.
My bike was stolen last week.
My bike has stolen last week.
My bike is stolen last week.
exercises.answer: My bike got stolen last week.

exercises.prompt: be 被动 和 get 被动 的区别是什么?
options: get 更口语、强调动作发生(常用于不好的事)
get 是过去时,be 是现在时
get 只能用在被动否定句
exercises.answer: get 更口语、强调动作发生(常用于不好的事)
exercises.explanation: be 被动更中性、更正式;get 被动更口语、强调事件突发性。

exercises.prompt: 「She ___ ___ (fire) last month.」(get 被动 — 被解雇)
哪一句不太自然?
options: He got arrested at the protest.
We got lost in the city.
exercises.explanation: know 不能用 get 被动;且 know 的 V3 是 known,不是 knowed。

exercises.prompt: 把句子和正确翻译匹配

lessons.title: 对话:我的手机被偷了
lessons.description: 在派出所报案 — 被动语态的自然使用

exercises.prompt: 在派出所报案 — 注意被动语态(was stolen, was taken 等)

turns.speaker: officer
turns.text: Good afternoon. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 选择正确的被动语态(被偷)
options: My phone was stolen this morning.
My phone was stole this morning.
turns.answer: My phone was stolen this morning.

turns.speaker: officer
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Where did it happen?

turns.speaker: you
turns.text: On the bus, near the city centre.

turns.speaker: officer
turns.prompt: 完成现在完成被动(被告诉过)
turns.after: the bus company been informed yet?

turns.speaker: you
turns.text: Not yet. I came straight here.

turns.speaker: officer
turns.prompt: 选择正确的被动语态(将来被处理)
options: Your case will be processed within 48 hours.
Your case will processed within 48 hours.
Your case is process within 48 hours.
turns.answer: Your case will be processed within 48 hours.

turns.speaker: you
turns.text: Thank you. Is there anything else I should do?

turns.speaker: officer
turns.prompt: 完成被动结构(被取消 — 手机卡)
turns.after: cancelled as soon as possible.

turns.speaker: you
turns.text: Right, I'll call my carrier immediately.

turns.speaker: officer
turns.text: Good. Here is your case number. Please keep it safe.

turns.speaker: you
turns.text: Thank you, officer. I appreciate your help.

topics.title: 短语动词(Phrasal Verbs)
topics.description: look up、give up、run into 等 — 中文里没有的结构

guide.intro: 短语动词(动词 + 副词/介词)在中文里没有对应结构。中文母语者最容易犯的错误是直译:「look up」字面理解成「往上看」,实际意思是「查找」。短语动词整体常和构成部分的字面意思无关。

sections.text: 短语动词 = 动词 + 小品词(up, down, in, on, off, out 等),整体意思往往无法从字面推出。

rows.translation: 我查了那个词(不是「往上看那个词」)。

sections.text: 可分离 vs 不可分离
可分离的短语动词:宾语可以放在动词和小品词之间,也可以放在后面。代词必须放在中间。

rows.source: Turn off the TV. / Turn the TV off.

sections.text: 不可分离的短语动词(look after, run into, get over):宾语必须放在后面。错误:「I ran Tom into」 → 正确:「I ran into Tom.」

rows: Look up the word in the dictionary.
I ran into an old friend.

lessons.title: 高频短语动词 10 个
lessons.description: look up、give up、run into 等

exercises.prompt: 「我在词典里查了那个词。」哪句对?
options: I looked up the sky for the word.
I looked up the word in the dictionary.
I looked up to find the word.
I looked the word at the dictionary.
exercises.answer: I looked up the word in the dictionary.
exercises.explanation: 「look up」= 查找(信息),不是字面上的「往上看」。

exercises.prompt: 「她戒烟了。」用 give up 怎么说?
options: Both B and C are correct.
exercises.answer: Both B and C are correct.
exercises.explanation: give up + V-ing。可以说 give up smoking 或 give smoking up(可分离)。

exercises.prompt: 「I ___ ___ an old friend at the supermarket.」(偶遇)
exercises.explanation: run into = 偶遇,撞见。

exercises.prompt: 「Please ___ ___ the lights when you leave.」(关闭)
把短语动词和中文含义匹配
把单词排成正确句子:「我七点来接你」
exercises.answer: I will pick you up at seven

exercises.prompt: 「Look after」的意思是?
exercises.explanation: look after = 照顾。「She looks after her grandmother.」

exercises.prompt: 听并选择你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: I gave up coffee last month.
options: I gave up coffee last month.
I give up coffee last month.
I gave up to coffee last month.
I have give up coffee last month.
exercises.answer: I gave up coffee last month.

exercises.prompt: 「Let's put off the meeting.」意思是?
exercises.explanation: put off = 推迟。

exercises.prompt: 「The plane ___ ___ at 6:30.」(起飞)
exercises.explanation: take off = 起飞(也可以是脱下衣物)。

lessons.title: 可分离 vs 不可分离
lessons.description: 宾语放在哪里?

exercises.prompt: 代词宾语在可分离短语动词中必须放在哪里?
exercises.explanation: 「Turn it off.」(√)而不是 「Turn off it.」(×)

exercises.prompt: 哪句正确?
exercises.explanation: 代词宾语必须放在中间。

exercises.prompt: 「I picked ___ the keys from the floor.」(可分离 — 名词宾语)
「I'll look ___ ___ tomorrow.」(给一个代词宾语:them)
exercises.explanation: look + them + up(代词必须中间)。

exercises.prompt: 把短语动词分到可分离和不可分离
把单词排成正确句子:「我撞见他了(偶遇)」
哪句是错的?(代词位置)
exercises.explanation: 代词宾语必须中间,不能在外。

exercises.prompt: 听并选择你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: Please turn it off.

exercises.prompt: Look after 是哪一种?
exercises.explanation: look after my dog,不能说 look my dog after。

exercises.prompt: 「Can you take ___ ___ ___ ___ tomorrow?」(填:我妹妹 — 名词宾语,带 my sister 短语)
exercises.explanation: take care of 是不可分离短语动词 (= 照顾)。

lessons.title: 多重含义
lessons.description: take off、work out、pick up — 一词多义

exercises.prompt: 「Take off」有哪些含义?
options: 起飞 / 脱下衣服 / 突然成功
exercises.answer: 起飞 / 脱下衣服 / 突然成功
exercises.explanation: Take off 一词多义,具体含义看语境。

exercises.prompt: 「She picked up Italian quickly.」意思是?
options: 她把意大利人捡起来了
她快速学会了意大利语
exercises.answer: 她快速学会了意大利语
exercises.explanation: pick up + 语言 = 自然习得、轻松学会。

exercises.prompt: 「Pick up」最不可能的意思是?
exercises.explanation: pick up 没有「卖出」的意思。

exercises.prompt: 听并选择你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: I'll work out the details tomorrow.
options: I'll work out the details tomorrow.

I'll work to out the details tomorrow.

exercises.prompt: 「Their relationship didn't work out.」意思是?

lessons.title: 短语动词 — 综合复习
lessons.description: 综合所有主题

exercises.prompt: 「They get ___ very well.」（他们相处得很好）
exercises.explanation: get along = 相处。get along with someone = 和某人相处得来。中文「相处」对应固定搭配 get along。

exercises.prompt: 「find out」是什么意思？
exercises.explanation: find out = 查明 / 发现（信息、事实），不是找东西。例：I found out the truth.（我查明了真相。）找东西用 find：I found my keys.（我找到了钥匙。）

exercises.prompt: 填空：「Don't ___ ___ trying!」（不要放弃尝试！）
exercises.explanation: give up = 放弃。后面接 V-ing：give up trying / give up smoking。给力一点：never give up = 永不放弃。

exercises.prompt: 「put off」的正式（书面）对应词是？___（一个词，以 p 开头）
exercises.explanation: put off（口语）= postpone（正式）= 推迟、延期。写邮件、报告用 postpone；日常对话用 put off。

exercises.prompt: 把短语动词和它的正式对应匹配
按正确顺序排列：「我得在词典里查一下这个词。」
exercises.answer: I need to look this word up
exercises.explanation: look up 是可分离短语动词，代词或名词宾语都可放在中间：look it up / look this word up。也可以说 look up this word（名词宾语在后），但代词宾语必须在中间（look it up，不能 look up it）。

exercises.prompt: 选择你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: Let's put off the trip until next week.
options: Let's put off the trip until next week.
Let's put on the trip until next week.
Let's put up the trip until next week.
Let's put off the trick until next week.
exercises.answer: Let's put off the trip until next week.

exercises.prompt: 「look into」是什么意思？
exercises.explanation: look into = 调查、深入研究（问题、案件）。例：The police are looking into the case.（警方正在调查此案。）不是字面「往里面看」。

exercises.prompt: 填空：「I'll ___ ___ it tomorrow.」（明天我会调查 / 研究一下）
exercises.explanation: look into = 调查、研究（问题）。注意 look into 后面直接跟宾语，不需要 at / on。

exercises.prompt: 哪个短语动词意思是「偶然遇见 / 偶遇」？
exercises.explanation: run into someone = 偶遇某人。例：I ran into my old teacher at the supermarket.（我在超市偶遇我的老师。）注意 into 不是 in 或 with。

lessons.title: 短语动词:人际关系和日常生活
lessons.description: get along、fall out、break up、settle down

exercises.prompt: 「get along with」是什么意思？
exercises.explanation: get along with someone = 和某人和睦相处。例：I get along with my sister.（我和我妹妹处得很好。）

exercises.prompt: 「break up」（在恋爱关系语境中）是什么意思？
exercises.explanation: break up = 分手（恋爱关系结束）。例：They broke up last month.（他们上个月分手了。）注意 break up with someone 接介词 with。

exercises.prompt: 填空：「I ___ ___ ___ my best friend yesterday.」（昨天我和最好的朋友吵架了）
exercises.explanation: fall out with someone = 与某人闹翻 / 吵架。过去式 fell out with。比 argue with 更强调关系破裂。

exercises.prompt: 「I'm going to ___ ___ my grandmother this weekend.」（看望奶奶）
exercises.explanation: call on someone = 拜访（短暂看望）。中文「看」一个字对应英语多个动词：visit（拜访）、call on（短暂拜访）、see（一般见面）、look at（看着）、watch（观看）。

exercises.prompt: 短语动词 — 含义
排列:「Kardeşimle iyi geçiniyorum」
exercises.answer: I get along well with my brother

exercises.prompt: 「make up」有哪些常见含义？
exercises.explanation: make up 一词多义：(1) 和好（争吵后）：They had a fight but made up the next day. (2) 编造：He made up a story.（他编了个故事。）(3) 化妆（put on makeup）。

exercises.prompt: 选择你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: They broke up after five years.
options: They broke up after five years.
They broke up for five years.
They broke down after five years.
They broke off after five years.
exercises.answer: They broke up after five years.

exercises.prompt: 「put up with」是什么意思？
exercises.explanation: put up with = 忍受 / 容忍（不好的事情）。例：I can't put up with the noise.（我受不了这噪音。）三个词的短语动词，不可分离。

exercises.prompt: 'I can't ___ ___ ___ his lies anymore.' (put up with)
exercises.explanation: Tahammül edememek.

exercises.prompt: 「come over」是什么意思？
exercises.explanation: come over = 顺道来访 / 过来一下。例：Come over for dinner!（过来吃饭吧！）over 有「过来」的方向感。

exercises.prompt: 人际关系短语动词

lessons.title: 短语动词:可分离 vs 不可分离
lessons.description: 当宾语是代词时会发生什么?

exercises.prompt: 可分离短语动词（如 turn off）后面的宾语是代词（it / him / them）时，代词放在哪里？
options: 必须放在动词和小品词之间
exercises.answer: 必须放在动词和小品词之间
exercises.explanation: 可分离短语动词 + 代词宾语 → 必须分开：Turn it off. (√)  Turn off it. (×) 名词宾语两种都可以：Turn off the light / Turn the light off. 但代词宾语只能放中间。

exercises.prompt: 哪一句是正确的？
exercises.explanation: 代词宾语必须放在动词和小品词之间：Turn it off / Turn them off。Turn off it 是中文学习者根据语序直译造成的典型错误。

exercises.prompt: 改写：「Pick up the kids.」用代词替换 the kids：「Pick ___ ___ .」
exercises.explanation: 代词宾语（them）放在 pick 和 up 之间。pick the kids up 和 pick up the kids 都对，但 pick up them 是错的。

exercises.prompt: 填空：「I'll look ___ ___ .」（我会照顾他们 — look after 不可分离）
exercises.explanation: look after = 照顾（不可分离短语动词）。代词宾语也只能放在 after 之后：look after them (√)  look them after (×)。和可分离的 turn off / pick up 不同。

exercises.prompt: 短语动词 — 类型
按正确顺序排列：「请把它关掉。」
exercises.explanation: turn off 可分离；代词 it 必须放在中间。Please turn off it（×）。中文「把它关掉」中的「它」对应代词 it，提示要分离。

exercises.prompt: 哪一句是错的？
exercises.explanation: 代词宾语（him）必须放在 pick 和 up 之间。名词宾语（John）两种语序都对。看到代词，要立刻想到「分离」。

exercises.prompt: 选择你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: Can you turn it down?

exercises.prompt: 「run into」（偶遇）属于哪种类型的短语动词？
exercises.explanation: run into 不可分离：I ran into him (√) / I ran him into (×)。一般来说，含介词的短语动词（into / after / for / with）通常不可分离。

exercises.prompt: 改写：「I came across an old letter.」用代词替换：「I came ___ ___ .」
exercises.explanation: come across = 偶然发现，不可分离。代词宾语也跟在 across 后面：came across it (√) / came it across (×)。

exercises.prompt: 哪个是三个词的短语动词（一般不可分离）？
exercises.explanation: 三个词的短语动词（动词 + 副词 + 介词）一律不可分离：look forward to / put up with / get along with / run out of。代词宾语放最后。

topics.title: 假朋友词汇 (False Friends)
topics.description: 中文中借用过的外来词在英语里的不同含义

guide.intro: 假朋友 (false friend):在两种语言中看起来相似但含义不同的词对。许多从法语/意大利语/英语借入中文的词,在英语里的含义可能完全不同。这种错误是 B1 学习者最常踩的陷阱,因为它会造成「我认识这个词」的错觉。

guide.intro: 英语讲故事通常需要两种时态搭配:一般过去时(主要事件)和过去进行时(背景 / 持续动作)。对中文母语者来说,叙述方式有时会令人困惑,因为中文里没有英语「-miş」(传闻、未亲历)那样的对应形式。

rows.translation: 我正在走回家(持续),这时下起了雨(突发)。

rows.source: She was cooking while he was reading.
rows.translation: 她在做饭,与此同时他在看书。

sections.text: Türkçedeki '-mis/-mis' eki (gitmis, gormus) İngilizce'de TAM karsiligi YOKTUR. 'Tanik olunmadan duyulan' anlami İçin 'apparently', 'I heard that', 'It seems' gibi ifadeler kullanilir.

rows.source: Yesterday, I went to the park.
While I was sitting on a bench, I saw an old friend.
rows.translation: 坐在长椅上时,我看见了一位老朋友。

rows.source: Finally, we exchanged numbers and said goodbye.
rows.translation: 最后我们交换了电话,然后道别。

topics.description: 表达意见、礼貌同意/不同意、缓和语气的句型

guide.intro: 在英语中,表达观点是学术和日常交流都必备的能力。中文里「我觉得」一句话就能解决,英语却有「I think」、「in my opinion」、「I believe」、「in my view」等不同语域。此外,礼貌地表达异议 (polite disagreement) 在英语文化中也非常重要。

topics.title: B1 综合复习
topics.description: 整合所有 B1 主题的综合复习

guide.intro: 整合 B1 六大主题的复习单元:现在完成时、情态动词、条件句、被动语态、短语动词和假朋友词汇。在每一课中你都会做到至少一道来自每个主题的练习。

items: 现在完成时:have/has + V3 — 从过去延伸到现在的动作。
情态动词:must (义务)、should (建议)、can/could (能力/许可)、may/might (可能)。
条件句:zero (普遍真理)、first (可能的将来)、second (假想的现在)。
被动:be + V3 — 动作者不重要或未知。
短语动词:动词 + 介词 → 整体含义(要记忆)。
假朋友词汇:「actual」= 实际的;「library」= 图书馆;「chef」= 厨师。

sections.text: Bu tekrar bölümünde 3 ders var, her biri farklı konuları karıştırır. Hatalarını not et — hangi konuda hâlâ takıldığını gösterir.
