The meeting has been postpone until Friday.
The meeting was postponed until Friday.
The meeting is postponed until Friday.
exercises.answer: The meeting has been postponed until Friday.

exercises.prompt: 哪句是正确的?
「Don」t ___ ___ trying — you「re almost there!」 (vazgeçme)
「你能检查一下这份报告吗？」用英语怎么说？
options: Can you control of this report?
Can you make a control of this report?
exercises.explanation: 中文「检查报告 / 看一下报告」用 check / review，不是 control。control 在英语里只用于「控制权力 / 操控系统」（pilot controls the plane）。

lessons.title: 对话:旅行归来的朋友
lessons.description: 和长途旅行归来的朋友聚会 — B1 语法综合

exercises.prompt: 按正确顺序排列：「我认识那个会说五种语言的女人。」
exercises.answer: I know the woman who speaks five languages
exercises.explanation: 中文「会说五种语言的女人」修饰语在前；英语反过来：the woman + who speaks five languages（关系代词 who 引导，从句放名词后面）。人用 who / that，物用 which / that。

levels.name: B2 — 中高级
levels.description: 讨论抽象话题、表达观点、阅读新闻并在工作场合使用英语。重点关注复杂时态、条件句和语域差异。

topics.title: 表达和捍卫观点
topics.description: 如何阐述观点、如何缓和语气、如何反对

guide.intro: 在 B2 阶段,光说 「I think」 是不够的。英语母语者用各种缓和语气(hedging)的工具来表达观点。中文里的「我觉得」、「在我看来」、「我猜」 这些细微的差别在英语中都有对应说法 —— 但并非一一对应。

sections.text: 在英语中表达观点时,调整语气的强度很重要。「I think」 是中性的;「I believe」 略强一些;「I'd argue」 带有辩论的色彩;「It seems to me」 较为间接。
英语母语者常常会缓和自己的观点。「sort of」、「kind of」、「I guess」 这类填充词在中文中很难找到完全对等的说法。它们并不显得犹豫,而是体现礼貌。

rows.source: I sort of agree, but I have one concern.
rows.translation: 我有点同意，但有一个顾虑。

rows.source: It's kind of complicated, to be honest.
I'd say it's more nuanced than that.
rows.translation: 我觉得情况比那更微妙。

sections.text: 在英语中直接说 「You are wrong」 太过生硬。更可取的说法包括 「I see your point, but…」、「I'm not sure I agree」 或 「I have to disagree」。
中文里「我不同意」 是一句很直接的话;但在英语商务场合,不加缓和地直接说出来会显得粗鲁。「I'd have to respectfully disagree」 是更稳妥的说法。

rows.source: I see where you're coming from, but I'd push back on that.
rows.translation: 我理解你的意思，但我会反对这一点。

rows.source: With all due respect, I don't quite agree.
rows.translation: 恕我直言，我并不完全同意。

rows.source: That's a fair point, although I'd add that…
rows.translation: 有道理，不过我想补充一点……

lessons.title: 阐述你的观点
lessons.description: 学习表达观点的句型

exercises.prompt: 「It seems to me that…」 在中文里相当于什么意思?
exercises.explanation: 「It seems to me」 用委婉的方式表达个人印象。

exercises.prompt: 「我觉得这个想法合理」 最自然的英文翻译是哪个?
options: By me, this idea makes logic.
I think this idea makes sense.
From me, this idea is logic.
In my opinion this idea is logical for me.
exercises.answer: I think this idea makes sense.
exercises.explanation: 「Make sense」 = 「合理、说得通」。「Make logic」 是错误搭配。

exercises.prompt: 「___ argue that remote work boosts productivity.」(中文:「我会说远程工作提升了效率。」)
exercises.explanation: 「I'd argue」 表达带有辩论色彩的观点。

exercises.prompt: 把英文句型与中文释义配对
造句:「依我看,这个计划不现实。」
exercises.answer: As far as I'm concerned this plan is not realistic
exercises.explanation: 「As far as I'm concerned」 接近中文里「依我看」 的句型。

exercises.prompt: 选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: I'd argue that the policy needs revision.
options: I'd argue that the policy needs revision.
I argue the policy needs vision.
I'd agree that the policy needs revision.
I argued the police need revision.
exercises.answer: I'd argue that the policy needs revision.
exercises.explanation: 「I'd argue」 = 「I would argue」;用于表达带辩论色彩的观点。

exercises.prompt: 「___ my mind, the proposal lacks substance.」(中文:「依我看,这个提议不够有深度。」)
exercises.explanation: 「To my mind」 = 「我认为」(正式)。

exercises.prompt: 哪一句表达了最强烈的观点?
options: I sort of think it's fine.
I'm firmly convinced this is the right path.
It seems to me this might work.
exercises.answer: I'm firmly convinced this is the right path.
exercises.explanation: 「Firmly convinced」 = 「坚定地相信」。其他选项都带有缓和。

exercises.prompt: 造句:「从我的角度看,这个解决方案不够。」
exercises.answer: From my perspective this solution is inadequate

exercises.prompt: 「Honestly, I ___ convinced.」 填空(中文:「老实说,我并未完全被说服。」)
exercises.explanation: 「Not entirely convinced」 是一种委婉的反对句型。

lessons.title: 缓和语气(hedging)
lessons.description: 用委婉的方式表达想法

exercises.prompt: 「sort of」 起什么作用?
options: 缓和句子,降低肯定程度
exercises.answer: 缓和句子,降低肯定程度
exercises.explanation: 「sort of」 = 「有点」;让主张更委婉。

exercises.prompt: 「It's ___ complicated.」(中文:「有点复杂。」)
exercises.explanation: 「kind of」 / 「sort of」 = 「有点、有些」。

exercises.prompt: 把缓和语气的表达与中文释义配对
下列哪一种是最礼貌的反对句型?
exercises.explanation: 在职场场合直接说 「You are wrong」 显得粗鲁。

exercises.prompt: 造句:「我得说我并未完全被说服。」
exercises.answer: I have to say I'm not entirely convinced

exercises.prompt: 选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: With all due respect, I have to disagree.
options: With all due respect, I have to disagree.
With all the respect, I had to disagree.
Without due respect, I have to agree.
With all my respect, I have disagree.
exercises.answer: With all due respect, I have to disagree.
exercises.explanation: 「With all due respect」 = 「恕我直言」。

exercises.prompt: 「I see your point, ___ I'd push back on that.」(中文:「我明白,但我会反对这一点。」)
exercises.explanation: 为了缓和反对,先表达认同,再提出异议。

exercises.prompt: 哪一句的确定性最低?
options: This is definitely the best option.
I sort of think this might work.
exercises.answer: I sort of think this might work.
exercises.explanation: 「sort of」 + 「might」 = 双重缓和。

exercises.prompt: 造句:「恕我直言,我对这个想法并不完全同意。」
exercises.answer: With all due respect I don't quite agree with this idea

exercises.prompt: 「That's a ___ point, although I'd add that…」(中文:「有道理,不过我还想补充……」)
exercises.explanation: 「fair point」 = 「有道理」。

lessons.title: 辩论句型
lessons.description: 在观点冲突中保持平衡

exercises.prompt: 「on the one hand… on the other hand…」 的中文意思是什么?
exercises.explanation: 用于在辩论中平衡正反两方。

exercises.prompt: 「___ admit that the data is mixed.」(中文:「我必须承认数据是混合的。」)
exercises.explanation: 「I'll admit」 = 「我必须承认」。

exercises.prompt: 把辩论句型与中文释义配对
「Having said that」 是什么意思?
exercises.explanation: 用于在前一句之后加入相反的观点。

exercises.prompt: 造句:「综合考虑,这个计划是成功的。」
exercises.answer: All things considered the plan was successful

exercises.prompt: 选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: On the contrary, the evidence suggests otherwise.
options: On the contrary, the evidence suggests otherwise.
In the contrary, the evidences suggest otherwise.
On the country, the evidence suggested otherwise.
On contrary the evidence suggest otherwise.
exercises.answer: On the contrary, the evidence suggests otherwise.

exercises.prompt: 「___ the contrary, costs went down.」(中文:「相反,成本下降了。」)
exercises.explanation: 「On the contrary」 是一个固定搭配。

exercises.prompt: 下列哪一项是「Granted」 在辩论中的含义?
exercises.explanation: 「Granted, X, but Y」 = 「承认 X 没错,但是 Y」。

exercises.prompt: 造句:「一方面便宜,另一方面质量差。」
exercises.answer: On the one hand it's cheap on the other hand it's low quality

exercises.prompt: 「I take your point, ___ I see things differently.」(中文:「我理解你的论点,但我有不同看法。」)
exercises.explanation: 「I take your point」 是一种礼貌的认可,后接 「but」 表示反对。

lessons.title: 观点 — 复习
lessons.description: 整合表达观点与辩论的句型

exercises.prompt: 哪一句以最正式的方式表达观点?
options: From my perspective, the proposal merits further consideration.
exercises.answer: From my perspective, the proposal merits further consideration.

exercises.prompt: 「I'm ___ convinced that this is the right approach.」(中文:「我坚信这是正确的做法。」)
exercises.explanation: 「firmly convinced」 表达强烈的观点。

exercises.prompt: 把中文表达与最自然的英文配对
造句:「恕我直言,数据并不支持你。」
exercises.answer: With all due respect the data doesn't agree with you

exercises.prompt: 反对时最礼貌的句型是哪一个?
options: I don't believe a word of it.

exercises.prompt: 选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: Granted, the cost is high, but the long-term gains outweigh it.
options: Granted, the cost is high, but the long-term gains outweigh it.
Granted, the cost is high, but the long-term gains outweigh them.
Grand, the cost is high, but long-term gains overweigh it.
Granted, the costs are high, but long-term gains weigh outside.
exercises.answer: Granted, the cost is high, but the long-term gains outweigh it.

exercises.prompt: 「All things ___, the trade-off seems worth it.」(中文:「综合考虑,这种取舍似乎是值得的。」)
exercises.explanation: 「All things considered」 = 「综合考虑」。

exercises.prompt: 「It seems to me that…」 是哪一类句型?
造句:「一方面你说得对,另一方面时间不够了。」
exercises.answer: On the one hand you're right on the other hand time is running out

exercises.prompt: 「I take your ___, but I see things differently.」(中文:「我理解你的话,但我有不同看法。」)
exercises.explanation: 「Take someone's point」 = 「理解某人所说的话」。

lessons.title: 为观点提供论据
lessons.description: 用 「because」、「given that」、「considering」 支持你的观点

exercises.prompt: 在 「Given that we have limited time, I'd suggest postponing the launch.」 中,「given that」 是什么意思?
exercises.explanation: 「Given that」 = 「考虑到……」。

exercises.prompt: 「我是根据数据做出这个决定的」 最自然的英文是?
options: I made this decision in lights of the data.
I made this decision in the light of the data.
I made this decision under data lights.
I made this decision in data light.
exercises.answer: I made this decision in the light of the data.
exercises.explanation: 「In the light of」 是一种正式的论证句型。

exercises.prompt: 哪一句对观点提出了最有力的论证?
options: I think it's fine because of reasons.
I'd argue it's the right call given the recent data and our team's bandwidth.
exercises.answer: I'd argue it's the right call given the recent data and our team's bandwidth.
exercises.explanation: 结合数据与资源两方面的双重论证属于 B2 水平。

exercises.prompt: 「___ that the deadline has been moved, we should reprioritize.」(中文:「鉴于截止日期被推后,我们应当重新调整优先级。」)
exercises.explanation: 「Now that」 / 「Given that」 / 「Seeing that」 起同样作用。

exercises.prompt: 「I take this view ___ several reasons.」 填空。
exercises.explanation: 「For several reasons」 = 「出于若干原因」。

exercises.prompt: 「My position is grounded ___ recent research.」(中文:「……立足于最新的研究。」)
exercises.explanation: 「Grounded in」 = 「立足于……」。

exercises.prompt: 把论证句型与中文释义配对
按语气强度配对
选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: I'd take that position on the grounds that the data is inconclusive.
options: I'd take that position on the grounds that the data is inconclusive.
I take that position on the ground the data is conclusive.
I'd take that position on the grounds that the data is conclusive.
I take this position on grounds the data are inconclusive.
exercises.answer: I'd take that position on the grounds that the data is inconclusive.
exercises.explanation: 「On the grounds that」 = 「以……为理由」。

exercises.prompt: 选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: Considering the budget cuts, I think we should scale back.
options: Considering the budget cuts, I think we should scale back.
Consider the budget cuts, I think we scale back.
Considering the budget cards, I think we should scale back.
Considered budget cuts, I think we scaled back.
exercises.answer: Considering the budget cuts, I think we should scale back.
exercises.explanation: 「Scale back」 = 「收缩、缩减」。

exercises.prompt: 造句:「鉴于当前的情况,这一举动显得有风险。」
exercises.answer: Given the current circumstances this move seems risky

exercises.prompt: 造句:「我的观点建立在多年的研究之上。」
exercises.answer: My view is grounded in years of research

lessons.title: 回应反对论点
lessons.description: Devil's advocate, conceding, refuting

exercises.prompt: 「Playing devil's advocate, I'd say…」 这一句型起什么作用?
exercises.explanation: 「Devil's advocate」 故意为辩论扮演反方。

exercises.prompt: 在 「Granted, the costs are high, but the long-term gains outweigh them.」 中,「granted」 起什么作用?
exercises.explanation: 「Granted」 = 「我承认……」(部分让步)。

exercises.prompt: 哪一种回答是最学术的反对?
options: I'm afraid I can't accept that premise.
exercises.answer: I'm afraid I can't accept that premise.
exercises.explanation: 「I'm afraid I can't accept that premise」 是一种正式且礼貌的反对。

exercises.prompt: 「That said, I still ___ stand my position.」(中文:「尽管如此,我仍坚持我的立场。」)
exercises.explanation: 「Stand by」 = 「站在……一方」。

exercises.prompt: 「I take your point, ___ I see it differently.」(中文:「我理解你的论点,但我看法不同。」)
exercises.explanation: 先认可,再反驳。

exercises.prompt: 「Your argument doesn't quite ___ up for me.」(中文:「你的论点对我来说不太站得住脚。」)
exercises.explanation: 「Hold up」 / 「stack up」 = 「站得住脚」。

exercises.prompt: 把应答策略配对
把反对的句型配对
选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: Granted, the data is limited, but the trend is unmistakable.
options: Granted, the data is limited, but the trend is unmistakable.
Granting the data limited, but the trend was unmistakable.
Granted the data is limit, but the trend was mistakable.
Granted, the data is limited, but the trend is mistakable.
exercises.answer: Granted, the data is limited, but the trend is unmistakable.
exercises.explanation: 「Unmistakable」 = 「显而易见、无法误解」。

exercises.prompt: 选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: That said, I still stand by my original assessment.
options: That said, I still stand by my original assessment.
That say, I still stand by my origin assessment.
That said, I still stand by my origin assessment.
That say, I still stand by my original assessment.
exercises.answer: That said, I still stand by my original assessment.
exercises.explanation: 「Stand by an assessment」 = 「坚持自己的判断」。

exercises.prompt: 造句:「如果我要做反方论者,情况要复杂得多。」
exercises.answer: Playing devil's advocate the situation is far more complex

exercises.prompt: 造句:「我理解你的论点,但我必须礼貌地表示反对。」
exercises.answer: I understand your argument but I'd respectfully push back on that

lessons.title: 对话:咖啡馆里的电影评论
lessons.description: 你和朋友讨论刚看过的电影,以委婉的方式表达观点

exercises.prompt: 在咖啡馆里和朋友讨论电影

turns.speaker: mia
turns.text: So, what did you think of the film? Honestly, I found it a bit overrated.

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 用缓和语气表达你的观点(hedging)
options: It seems to me the ending was rushed, but the acting saved it.
I say absolutely the ending was rushed totally.
The ending it rushed was, but acting saved.
turns.answer: It seems to me the ending was rushed, but the acting saved it.

turns.speaker: mia
turns.text: Yeah, the pacing was off. I'd argue the director could have cut twenty minutes.

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 用「sort of」 表达半同意
options: I sort of agree, though I think those scenes built the atmosphere.
I full agreement, however the scenes the atmosphere built.
Agree I sort of, the scenes atmosphere did building.
turns.answer: I sort of agree, though I think those scenes built the atmosphere.

turns.speaker: mia
turns.text: Fair point. From my perspective, the soundtrack was the strongest element.

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 补全缓和语气的句型 — 「在我看来……」
turns.after: to me the soundtrack carried the emotional weight throughout.

turns.speaker: mia
turns.text: Exactly. Would you recommend it to someone who hasn't seen it yet?

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 略带保留地建议 — 使用情态完成时
options: I'd recommend it, but they should have read the book first for context.
I recommend, but they must read the book firstly for context.
Recommend would I, but the book they reading should.
turns.answer: I'd recommend it, but they should have read the book first for context.

turns.speaker: mia
turns.text: Good call. Let's grab another coffee and pick the next one to watch.

topics.title: 理解新闻
topics.description: 破解新闻标题,跟读新闻文本

guide.intro: 英语新闻语言自成一体:标题简短、被动结构、引述动词,以及高频固定搭配。对中文学习者来说,陷阱在于中文新闻措辞(尤其是与拉丁词根相关的)并不一定一一对应到英语。例如「实际的」在英语中并不一定是 「actual」,而 「actual」 实际上意味着「真正的、实际存在的」 —— 这是经典的「假朋友」(false friend)。

sections.text: 英语新闻标题通常使用现在时(即使是过去发生的事件),省略 「a/the」 冠词,并用不定式表示将来。

rows: The PM has resigned amid a scandal
A tech firm is going to acquire its rival
科技公司将收购竞争对手
Three people are dead in a factory explosion
工厂爆炸造成 3 人死亡

sections.text: 新闻报道中不会每句都用 「said」,而是用 「claimed」、「stated」、「announced」、「reported」、「denied」 等带有不同语气的动词。每一个的语气都不一样。
中文里的「声称」 并不总是 「claimed」。正式声明用 「stated」 或 「announced」 更恰当。「claimed」 在英语中通常带有怀疑意味。
新闻语言中,若主语不明或不重要,会倾向使用被动结构:「Three people were arrested」、「A new policy is being introduced」。

rows.source: The bill is expected to pass next week.
rows.translation: 据报道该法案预计将于下周通过。

rows.source: The minister was reported to have stepped down.

lessons.title: 破解新闻标题
lessons.description: 学习新闻标题的隐藏语法

exercises.prompt: 新闻标题 「PM resigns amid scandal」 的完整中性表达是什么?
options: The PM will resign because of a scandal.
The PM has resigned amid a scandal.
The PM is resigning while scandal.
exercises.answer: The PM has resigned amid a scandal.

exercises.prompt: 新闻标题中 「to + 动词」 结构通常表示什么?
exercises.explanation: 「Tech firm to acquire rival」 = 「将收购竞争对手」。

exercises.prompt: 「3 ___ in factory blast」(中文:「工厂爆炸造成 3 人死亡」)
exercises.explanation: 新闻标题为简短起见用 「dead」 而非 「are dead」。

exercises.prompt: 把新闻标题与完整释义配对
造句:「该法案预计将在下周通过。」
exercises.answer: The bill is expected to pass next week

exercises.prompt: 选出你听到的新闻标题
exercises.spokenText: Two suspects have been detained.

exercises.prompt: 「Government to launch new program」 如何翻译?
options: 政府将启动一个新项目。
政府应该启动一个新项目。
exercises.answer: 政府将启动一个新项目。

exercises.prompt: 「CEO ___ fire over remarks.」(中文:「CEO 因言论而受到压力。」)
exercises.explanation: 「under fire」 = 「受到批评 / 压力」。

exercises.prompt: 造句:「据报道,部长已经辞职。」
exercises.answer: The minister was reported to have stepped down

exercises.prompt: 哪一项是标准的新闻标题缩短方式?

lessons.title: 引述动词
lessons.description: 「said」 的微妙近亲

exercises.prompt: 「claimed」 通常带有怎样的语气?
exercises.explanation: 「claimed」 暗示陈述者并不一定可信。

exercises.prompt: 把引述动词与中文释义配对
「The minister ___ the allegations.」(中文:「部长否认了这些指控。」)
exercises.explanation: 「denied」 = 「否认」。

exercises.prompt: 正式的新闻发布会上最合适的动词是?
造句:「公司宣布了一位新的 CEO。」
exercises.answer: The company announced a new CEO

exercises.prompt: 选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: Officials alleged misconduct in the report.
options: Officials alleged misconduct in the report.
Officials allowed misconduct in the report.
Official alleged miscount in the report.
Officials alleged misconduct in the resort.
exercises.answer: Officials alleged misconduct in the report.

exercises.prompt: 中文里的「声称」 一定对应 「claimed」 吗?
options: 是的,在所有语境都一样。
不 —— 正式声明用 「stated/announced」 更合适;「claimed」 暗含怀疑。
exercises.answer: 不 —— 正式声明用 「stated/announced」 更合适;「claimed」 暗含怀疑。
exercises.explanation: 「claimed」 暗示怀疑;中文 L1 学生常因「声称 = claim」的固定对应而误用,在正式中立报道中应改用 「stated」 或 「announced」。

exercises.prompt: 「The witness ___ that he saw nothing.」(中文:「证人声称他什么也没看到。」)
exercises.explanation: 证人的说法通常用 「claimed」 来报道。

exercises.prompt: 造句:「警方宣布凶杀案嫌疑人已被抓获。」
exercises.answer: Police announced that the murder suspect had been caught

exercises.prompt: 哪一个引述动词带有「确定认可」 的语气?
exercises.explanation: 「confirmed」 = 「证实」;以正式方式确认信息。

lessons.title: 新闻被动语态与中立语气
lessons.description: 在新闻中使用被动结构与中立引述

exercises.prompt: 新闻语言中为什么倾向使用被动?
options: 因为施动者不重要、不明或需要被隐藏
exercises.answer: 因为施动者不重要、不明或需要被隐藏

exercises.prompt: 「Three people ___ arrested last night.」(中文:「昨晚有三人被逮捕。」)
exercises.explanation: 被动语态:be 动词 + V3 结构。

exercises.prompt: 造句:「一项新政策正在被推出。」
exercises.answer: A new policy is being introduced

exercises.prompt: 被动时态 + 中文
「It is reported that…」 在中文里相当于什么?
exercises.explanation: 「It is reported that…」 = 「据报道……」。

exercises.prompt: 选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: The investigation is being conducted by federal agents.
options: The investigation is being conducted by federal agents.
The investigations is being conduct by federal agent.
The investigation are being conducted by federal agent.
The investigation has being conducted by federal agents.
exercises.answer: The investigation is being conducted by federal agents.

exercises.prompt: 「A breakthrough has ___ achieved.」(中文:「一项突破已经取得。」)
exercises.explanation: 现在完成时被动:have been + V3。

exercises.prompt: 哪一句更具中立的新闻语气?
options: The crooked minister got booted out.
The minister was dismissed from office.
exercises.answer: The minister was dismissed from office.
exercises.explanation: 被动语态 + 中性动词产生新闻语气。

exercises.prompt: 造句:「据报道,边境口岸已经被关闭。」
exercises.answer: The border crossing was reported to have been closed

exercises.prompt: 「The bill ___ expected to pass.」(中文:「该法案预计将通过。」)
exercises.explanation: 「is expected to」 属于一般现在时被动。

lessons.title: 新闻词汇与「假朋友」
lessons.description: 注意容易混淆的词对

exercises.prompt: 英语中 「actual」 的中文意思是什么?
exercises.explanation: 「actual」 = 「真实的」。中文「现实的」 才对应 「actual」,而「时事的」 对应 「current」。经典的「假朋友」。

exercises.prompt: 配对「假朋友」
「The ___ situation is unclear.」(中文:「当前形势尚不明朗。」)
exercises.explanation: 「current」 = 「当前的」;「actual」 在此处不合适。

exercises.prompt: 中文里的「检查」 在英语中最准确的翻译是:
exercises.explanation: 英语中 「control」 表示「掌控」;表示「检查」 要用 「check」。

exercises.prompt: 「Please ___ the documents.」(中文:「请检查 / 审阅文件。」)
exercises.explanation: 「control」 在此处不合适。

exercises.prompt: 选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: He's a sensible man with reasonable ideas.
options: He's a sensible man with reasonable ideas.
He's a sensitive man with reasonable ideas.
He's a sensual man with reason ideas.
He's a sense man with reasonable ideas.
exercises.answer: He's a sensible man with reasonable ideas.

exercises.prompt: 造句:「时事正在影响价格。」
下列哪一项是错误用法?
options: The actual weather report says rain.
exercises.answer: The actual weather report says rain.
exercises.explanation: 这里应该用 「current」;「actual」 = 「真实」 会让意思错乱。

exercises.prompt: 「She is very ___ to criticism.」(中文:「她对批评非常敏感。」)
exercises.explanation: 「敏感」 = 「sensitive」;「明智」 = 「sensible」。

exercises.prompt: 「eventual」 的中文意思是什么?
options: 可能发生的 / 最终会发生的
也许会发生的 / 偶然的
exercises.answer: 可能发生的 / 最终会发生的
exercises.explanation: 「假朋友」!「eventual」 = 「最终会发生的」(经过一段过程后)。中文 L1 易把它和「也许、偶然」混淆,因为「eventually」 听起来像 「event」 + ly。

lessons.title: 新闻来源与引述
lessons.description: 「According to」、「sources say」、「reportedly」

exercises.prompt: 在 「According to officials, the deal is imminent.」 中,「according to」 是什么意思?
exercises.explanation: 「According to」 = 「根据」(用于引述来源)。

exercises.prompt: 哪一个词表示「据称、据说」 的意思?
exercises.explanation: 「Reportedly」 表示信息未经证实就被引述。

exercises.prompt: 在 「Sources close to the matter said the merger is on hold.」 中体现了新闻语言的哪一个特点?
exercises.explanation: 「Sources close to the matter」 = 「接近事件的消息人士」(匿名来源)。

exercises.prompt: 「The minister is ___ to have resigned.」(中文:「据报道部长已经辞职。」)
exercises.explanation: 「Said/reported/alleged + to + V3」 = 「据说/据称做了某事」。

exercises.prompt: 「The CEO ___ denied the allegations.」(中文:「CEO 强烈否认了这些指控。」)
exercises.explanation: 新闻语言中 「flatly/categorically deny」 = 「彻底否认」。

exercises.prompt: 「The bill ___ scrutiny in the senate.」(中文:「该法案正在参议院接受审议。」)
exercises.explanation: 「Undergo scrutiny」 = 「接受审查」。

exercises.prompt: 把引述动词与中文释义配对
把新闻句型配对
选出你听到的句子

options: The official allegedly accepted bribes from contractors.
The official allegedly accepted brides from contractors.

exercises.answer: The official allegedly accepted bribes from contractors.

exercises.prompt: 选出你听到的句子

options: According to the latest figures, unemployment has fallen sharply.
According to the late figures, unemployment had fallen shortly.
According to last figures, unemployed had fall sharply.
Accordingly latest figures, unemployment has fall sharply.

exercises.explanation: 「Fall sharply」 = 「大幅下降」。

exercises.prompt: 造句:「据高层消息,协议即将破裂。」
exercises.answer: According to senior sources the deal is on the verge of collapse

exercises.prompt: 造句:「据报道,公司被指控篡改了记录。」
exercises.answer: The company is reportedly alleged to have falsified records

lessons.title: 间接引语的多种类型
lessons.description: 时态后移、引述动词、情态转换

exercises.prompt: 「She said she had been working all night.」 属于哪一种间接引语结构?
options: Present perfect cont. → past perfect cont.
exercises.answer: Present perfect cont. → past perfect cont.
exercises.explanation: 直接引语:「I have been working all night」 → 间接引语:「had been working」。

exercises.prompt: 「He claimed that he ___ the report.」 直接引语:「I will finish the report」
exercises.explanation: 间接引语:「will」 → 「would」。

exercises.prompt: 下列哪一项不是引述动词(reporting verb)?

exercises.prompt: 「She admitted ___ the mistake.」(中文:「她承认犯了这个错误。」)
exercises.explanation: 「Admit + V-ing」 句型。

exercises.prompt: 「He denied ___ ever met her.」(中文:「他否认曾见过她。」)
exercises.explanation: 「Deny + having + V3」 是正式否认过去动作的句型。

exercises.prompt: 「They urged us ___ reconsider the offer.」 填空?
exercises.explanation: 「Urge sb to V」 句型。

exercises.prompt: 把引述动词与对应结构配对
把情态动词的时态后移配对
选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: She insisted that she had nothing to do with the incident.
options: She insisted that she had nothing to do with the incident.
She insists that she has nothing to do the incident.
She inserted that she had nothing to do with the incident.
She insisted she had nothing to do the accident.
exercises.answer: She insisted that she had nothing to do with the incident.
exercises.explanation: 「Insist that」 + 过去完成时(时态后移)。

exercises.spokenText: He admitted having mishandled the situation.
options: He admitted having mishandled the situation.
He admits had mishandle the situation.
He admitted having mishandling the situation.
He admitted to mishandled the situation.
exercises.answer: He admitted having mishandled the situation.
exercises.explanation: 「Admit having + V3」 是正式承认过去动作的句型。

exercises.prompt: 造句:「发言人断然否认存在任何不当行为。」
exercises.answer: The spokesperson categorically denied that any wrongdoing had occurred

exercises.prompt: 造句:「官员们提醒公众不要恐慌。」
exercises.answer: Officials warned the public not to panic

lessons.title: 对话:对新闻标题的反应

topics.title: 环境与气候
topics.description: 谈论气候变化、可持续发展和自然资源

guide.intro: 要在 B2 水平讨论环境话题,搭配(collocations)非常关键。要说 「take action」,而不说 「do action」;说 「reduce emissions」,「lower emissions」 也行,但 「shrink emissions」 听起来就很别扭。

sections.text: 讨论环境时常常涉及可能性和必要性。「must」、「should」、「ought to」、「might」、「could」 表达不同程度。「We must cut emissions」 是强烈必要;「We could explore alternatives」 是温和建议。

rows.source: Governments must take immediate action on climate change.
rows.translation: 各国政府必须立即就气候变化采取行动。

rows.source: We could reduce our carbon footprint by switching to renewables.
rows.translation: 我们可以通过转向可再生能源来减少碳足迹。

rows.source: Without intervention, biodiversity loss is bound to accelerate.
rows.translation: 若不采取干预,生物多样性丧失必将加速。

sections.text: 「bound to」 = 「必定会/必定已发生」,是强势的推测。相当于中文的「不可避免」 的力度。

lessons.title: 气候词汇
lessons.description: 记忆核心术语

exercises.prompt: 把术语与中文释义配对
「greenhouse gas emissions」 是什么?
options: 字面译「绿色房屋气体」(错)

exercises.prompt: 「We need to cut greenhouse gas ___.」(中文:「我们必须减少温室气体排放。」)
哪一句使用了正确的搭配?
options: We must do action on climate change.
We must take action on climate change.
We must make action on climate change.
We must put action on climate change.
exercises.answer: We must take action on climate change.
exercises.explanation: 「take action」 是固定搭配。

exercises.prompt: 造句:「可再生能源正变得越来越实惠。」
exercises.answer: Renewable energy is becoming more affordable

exercises.prompt: 选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: Carbon emissions are rising sharply.

exercises.prompt: 「My ___ footprint is too large.」(中文:「我的碳足迹太大了。」)
「sustainable」 的中文意思是什么?
造句:「生物多样性丧失正以令人担忧的速度持续。」
exercises.answer: Biodiversity loss is continuing at an alarming rate

exercises.prompt: 「Many countries are investing in ___ energy.」(中文:「许多国家正在投资可再生能源。」)

lessons.title: 用情态动词提建议
lessons.description: 调整建议与必要性的强度

exercises.prompt: 哪一句表达了最强烈的必要性?
情态动词 — 中文
「We ___ explore alternative fuels.」(中文:「我们可以探索替代燃料。」)
「bound to」 是什么意思?
options: 必定会发生 / 不可避免
exercises.answer: 必定会发生 / 不可避免

exercises.prompt: 造句:「若不干预,损失将不可避免。」
exercises.answer: Without intervention the loss is bound to occur

exercises.prompt: 选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: Governments ought to invest more in clean technology.
options: Governments ought to invest more in clean technology.
Governments out to invest more in clean technology.
Governments ought invest more in clean technology.
Governments oughta to invest in clean technology.
exercises.answer: Governments ought to invest more in clean technology.

exercises.prompt: 「Companies ___ disclose their emissions data.」(中文:「公司应当公开其排放数据。」)
哪一个情态动词提出了最礼貌的建议?
exercises.explanation: 「might want to」 是一种温和、间接的建议。

exercises.prompt: 造句:「决策者应当考虑转向可再生能源。」
exercises.answer: Policymakers should consider transitioning to renewables

exercises.prompt: 「Without action, the climate ___ continue to warm.」(中文:「若不采取行动,气候将继续变暖。」)

lessons.title: 问题与解决方案的语言
lessons.description: 陈述环境问题并提出解决方案

exercises.prompt: 把「问题-解决」句型配对
哪一个动词表示「想出解决方案」?
「We need to ___ awareness about plastic waste.」(中文:「我们必须就塑料垃圾提高意识。」)
造句:「我们每个人都需要负责任地行事。」
exercises.answer: All of us need to act responsibly

exercises.prompt: 选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: We have to tackle plastic pollution head-on.
options: We have to tackle plastic pollution head-on.
We had to tackle plastic pollution head on.
We have to tickle plastic pollution head on.
We have to tack plastic pollution head-on.
exercises.answer: We have to tackle plastic pollution head-on.

exercises.prompt: 「address an issue」 是什么意思?
options: 讨论 / 处理一个话题
exercises.answer: 讨论 / 处理一个话题

exercises.prompt: 「Cities are ___ to extreme weather.」(中文:「城市在极端天气面前很脆弱。」)
exercises.explanation: 「vulnerable to」 = 「易受……影响、脆弱」。

exercises.prompt: 造句:「水资源短缺正在成为长期问题。」
exercises.answer: Water scarcity is becoming a persistent problem

exercises.prompt: 哪一句突出强调了环境解决方案?
options: The problem is impossible to solve.
Switching to electric vehicles offers a viable path forward.
exercises.answer: Switching to electric vehicles offers a viable path forward.

exercises.prompt: 「Recycling alone ___ enough.」(中文:「光靠回收远远不够。」)

lessons.title: 气候变化 — 因果
lessons.description: 结合因果连接词与气候词汇

exercises.prompt: 用合适的词填空:「Rising sea levels are a direct ___ of melting ice caps.」
exercises.explanation: 「Consequence of」 = 「……的后果」。

exercises.prompt: 「冰川融化扰乱了洋流」 最自然的英文是?
exercises.explanation: 「Disrupt」 = 「扰乱」;「currents」 = 「洋流」。

exercises.prompt: 用合适的介词填空:「Carbon emissions have skyrocketed ___ the past decade.」
exercises.explanation: 「Over the past decade」 = 「在过去十年里」。

exercises.prompt: 「Deforestation is largely ___ for biodiversity loss.」(中文:「森林砍伐在很大程度上要为生物多样性丧失负责。」)
exercises.explanation: 「Responsible for」 / 「to blame for」 = 「对……负责」。

exercises.prompt: 「The government has pledged to ___ emissions by 50% by 2035.」 填空?
exercises.explanation: 「Cut/reduce/slash emissions」 = 「减少排放」。

exercises.prompt: 「Coastal cities are bearing ___ brunt of climate change.」 填空?
exercises.explanation: 「Bear the brunt of」 = 「首当其冲」。

exercises.prompt: 把气候变化词汇配对
把影响类动词配对
选出你听到的句子

If we don't ask now, the damage may be reversible.
If we won't act now, the damage maybe irreversible.
If we don't act now, the damages might be reversible.
exercises.answer: If we don't act now, the damage may be irreversible.
exercises.explanation: 「Irreversible」 = 「不可逆的」。

exercises.prompt: 选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: Coastal cities are bearing the brunt of climate change.
options: Coastal cities are bearing the brunt of climate change.
Costal cities are bear the brunt of climate change.
Coastal cities are bearing the brand of climate change.
Coastal cities have been bearing brunt climate change.
exercises.answer: Coastal cities are bearing the brunt of climate change.

exercises.prompt: 造句:「转向可再生能源不再是一个选项,而是一种必需。」
exercises.answer: Transitioning to renewable energy is no longer optional but a necessity

exercises.prompt: 造句:「减少碳足迹是我们共同的责任。」
exercises.answer: Reducing our carbon footprint is our collective responsibility

lessons.title: 可持续发展与政策语言
lessons.description: 政策动词:pledge、phase out、offset、incentivize

exercises.prompt: 'The EU has pledged to phase out single-use plastics by 2030.' 'Phase out' ne demek?
exercises.explanation: 「Phase out」 = 「逐步淘汰」。

exercises.prompt: 'Subsidies will incentivize companies to switch to clean energy.' 'Incentivize' = ?
exercises.explanation: 「Incentivize」 = 「激励」。

exercises.prompt: 在可持续发展语境下，哪一项配对是正确的？
options: fossil fuel = 可再生能源（错）
exercises.explanation: 「Biodegradable」 = 「可生物降解」。

exercises.prompt: 「Companies must ___ their emissions through verified offsets.」 填空?
exercises.explanation: 「Offset emissions」 = 「抵消排放」。

exercises.prompt: 「The treaty is ___ legally binding on all signatories.」 填空?
exercises.explanation: 「Legally binding」 = 「具有法律约束力」。

exercises.prompt: 「They have set ___ targets to reach net zero by 2050.」 填空?
exercises.explanation: 「Ambitious/stringent targets」 = 「雄心勃勃 / 严格的目标」。

exercises.prompt: 把政策类动词配对
把可持续发展概念配对
选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: The treaty is now legally binding on all signatories.
options: The treaty is now legally binding on all signatories.
The treat is now legally binding on all signatures.
The treaty was now legal binding on all signers.
The treaty is now legal binding to all signatories.
exercises.answer: The treaty is now legally binding on all signatories.
exercises.explanation: 「Signatory」 = 「签署方」。

exercises.prompt: 选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: We need stringent measures to curb pollution.
options: We need stringent measures to curb pollution.
We need stringy measures to cure pollution.
We need strict measure to verb pollution.
We need stringent measures to herb solution.
exercises.answer: We need stringent measures to curb pollution.
exercises.explanation: 「Curb」 = 「抑制、限制」。

topics.title: 人际关系与情感

guide.intro: 情绪是普世的,但在不同语言中的表达方式并不一样。英语中表达情绪常用「形容词 + feel」 结构:「I feel overwhelmed」、「She felt let down」。中文里这些情绪常用动词或动宾结构表达:「我感到压力山大」、「我很失望」。

sections.text: 英语中表达人际关系的动词对介词的选择很敏感:「fall out with someone」(吵架)、「make up with someone」(和好)、「put up with」(忍受)、「look up to」(尊敬)。

rows.source: I had a falling out with my brother last year.
We made up after the argument.
I can't put up with this any longer.
She really looks up to her mentor.

sections.text: 中文里的「我心都碎了」 表达较为间接;英语中可用 「My heart was broken」,但更自然的是 「I was heartbroken」。「Heart-broken」 视作一个单词来读。

topics.title: 条件句与混合结构
topics.description: 学习第二、第三和混合条件句

guide.intro: B2 阶段的条件句不只是 if 从句的规则;它是表达推测、遗憾和假设性思考的工具。中文里的「如果……就……」 结构与英语第三类条件句(third conditional)有相似之处,但并不完全相同。

sections.text: 如果过去的决定影响到当下的情况,就使用混合条件句:「If I had studied harder, I would have a better job now」 = 「如果我当时更努力学习,现在就会有一份更好的工作」。

rows.source: If I were you, I'd take the offer.
rows.translation: 如果我是你,我会接受这个提议。

rows.source: If she had left earlier, she'd be home by now.
rows.translation: 如果她早点出发,现在就到家了。

rows.source: Had I known, I would have called.
rows.translation: 我要是知道,就会打电话了。

sections.text: 正式写作中,像 「Had I known」 这种没有 if 的倒装结构非常考究。在 C1 阶段会更常见;在 B2 阶段能识别即可。

lessons.title: 第二类条件句 — 假设的现在
lessons.description: 「If + past, would」 结构

exercises.prompt: 「我要是你就走了」 在英语中是哪一句?
options: If I am you, I will go.
If I were you, I would go.
If I am you, I went.
If I were you, I will go.
exercises.answer: If I were you, I would go.
exercises.explanation: 第二类条件句:If + were + would + V1。

exercises.prompt: 「If I ___ rich, I would travel.」(中文:「要是我有钱,我就去旅行。」)
exercises.explanation: 正式形式用 「were」;口语中 「was」 也可接受。

exercises.prompt: 造句:「要是我有时间,我就会学了。」
exercises.answer: If I had time I would learn

exercises.prompt: 结构 — 含义
下列哪一项是错误的?
options: If she had a car, she would drive.
If she has a car, she would drive.
If she had a car, she'd drive.
If she were rich, she'd buy one.
exercises.answer: If she has a car, she would drive.
exercises.explanation: 第二类条件句应使用 if + past;「has」 + 「would」 不是合规的混合条件。

exercises.prompt: 选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: If I knew the answer, I'd tell you.
options: If I knew the answer, I'd tell you.
If I know the answer, I tell you.
If I knew the answer, I'll tell you.
If I knew the answers, I would tells you.
exercises.answer: If I knew the answer, I'd tell you.

exercises.prompt: 「If she ___ here, she would help.」(中文:「要是她在这里,她会帮忙的。」)
下列假设句的中文是:「If we had more time, we could finish.」
options: 如果以后我们有更多时间，我们就能完成。
要是当时我们有更多时间,我们早已完成。
要是我们有更多时间，就能完成。
我们一有更多时间，就完成。
exercises.answer: 要是我们有更多时间，就能完成。

exercises.prompt: 造句:「要是我少工作一点,我会更开心。」
exercises.answer: If I worked less I would be happier

exercises.prompt: 「If I ___ a billionaire, I'd start a foundation.」(中文:「要是我是亿万富翁,我就会成立基金会。」)

lessons.title: 第三类条件句 — 对过去的遗憾
lessons.description: 「If + past perfect, would have」

exercises.prompt: 「我要是知道就来了」 在英语中是哪一句?
options: If I knew, I would come.
If I had known, I would have come.
If I have known, I would come.
If I had known, I will come.
exercises.answer: If I had known, I would have come.

exercises.prompt: 「If she ___ harder, she would have passed.」(中文:「要是她更努力,她就能通过了。」)
造句:「要是我们早点出发,就能赶上火车了。」
exercises.answer: If we had left earlier we would have caught the train

exercises.prompt: 「Had I known」 的完整形式是什么?
exercises.explanation: 无 if 的倒装结构 = 「Had I known」 = 「If I had known」。

exercises.prompt: 选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: If they had warned us, we would have prepared.
options: If they had warned us, we would have prepared.
If they warn us, we will prepare.
If they warned us, we would prepare.
If they had warn us, we would have prepare.

exercises.prompt: 「If you ___ told me, I could have helped.」(中文:「要是你告诉我,我本可以帮忙。」)
哪一句是第三类条件句?
options: If I had time, I'd help.
If I had had time, I would have helped.
If I have time, I'll help.
When I have time, I help.

lessons.description: 过去原因 + 当前结果

exercises.prompt: 「要是我当时更努力,现在就会有一份更好的工作」 的英文是?
options: If I had studied harder, I have a better job now.

If I studied harder, I would have a better job now.
If I studied harder, I have a better job.
exercises.answer: If I had studied harder, I would have a better job now.

exercises.prompt: 「If you hadn't quit, you ___ a manager by now.」(中文:「要是你没辞职,你现在就是经理了。」)
句子 — 条件句类型

pairs.left: If she were here, she'd help.
If he had called, I would have answered.
If I had taken that job, I'd be in London now.
pairs.right: 混合条件句(过去原因 + 现在结果)

pairs.right: 第一类(可能发生的未来)

exercises.prompt: 混合条件句的逻辑用法?
options: 两个现在的事实之间的因果
过去的原因 + 现在仍持续的结果
普遍真理 / 自然规律
exercises.answer: 过去的原因 + 现在仍持续的结果
exercises.explanation: 混合条件句 = If + 过去完成时, would + V1。 例:「If I had married her, I would be richer now.」 中文里没有专门的语法形式,常用「要是当时……,现在就……」 翻译。

exercises.prompt: 选出你听到的句子

If we hadn't miss the flight, we'd be in Tokyo right now.
If we hadn't missed the flight, we'd been in Tokyo right now.
If we hadn't miss flight we'd be in Tokyo.
exercises.answer: If we hadn't missed the flight, we'd be in Tokyo right now.

exercises.prompt: 「If you had eaten breakfast, you ___ hungry now.」(中文:「要是你吃了早餐,现在就不饿了。」)

options: 要是他当时听了,以后就不会有麻烦。

要是他听了,他就不会有麻烦。
exercises.answer: 要是他当时听了,现在就不会有麻烦。
exercises.explanation: 混合结构:过去原因,现在结果。

exercises.prompt: 造句:「要是我当时提醒了他,他现在就不会难过。」
exercises.answer: If I had warned him he wouldn't be upset now

lessons.title: 「Wish」 与 「If only」
lessons.description: 表达遗憾和愿望

exercises.prompt: 「真希望我有更多时间」 的英文是?

exercises.prompt: 「If only I ___ his number.」(中文:「真希望我有他的电话号码。」)
哪一句强调了强烈的遗憾?
options: If only I had known sooner.
exercises.answer: If only I had known sooner.

exercises.prompt: 造句:「真希望我能学会唱歌。」

lessons.title: 混合条件句
lessons.description: 过去条件 + 现在结果,现在条件 + 过去结果

exercises.prompt: 「If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.」 是哪一种条件句?
exercises.explanation: 过去条件(Type 3)+ 现在结果(Type 2)= 混合条件句。

exercises.prompt: 「If she were more organized, she wouldn't have missed the deadline.」 属于哪一种结构?
exercises.explanation: 现在/普遍条件(Type 2)+ 过去结果(Type 3)= 混合条件句。

exercises.prompt: 对混合条件句的最准确解释是?
options: 将过去与现在的虚拟联系起来
exercises.answer: 将过去与现在的虚拟联系起来
exercises.explanation: 混合条件句将两个不同的时态以虚拟方式联系起来。

exercises.prompt: 「If I ___ taken that job, I'd be living in Berlin now.」(Type 3 + Type 2)
exercises.explanation: Type 3 的 if 子句:had + V3。

exercises.prompt: 「If she ___ more cautious, she wouldn't have signed the contract.」(Type 2 + Type 3)
exercises.explanation: Type 2 的 if 子句:were/was。

exercises.prompt: 「If we hadn't missed the train, we ___ in Rome by now.」 填空?
exercises.explanation: Type 2 的结果:would + V(用于现在的内容)。

exercises.prompt: 把混合条件句句型配对

exercises.prompt: 选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: If I had taken that offer, I would be running my own company by now.
options: If I had taken that offer, I would be running my own company by now.
If I have taken that offer, I would be running my own company by now.
If I had taken that offer, I would have running my own company by now.
If I had taken the offer, I would been running my own company now.
exercises.answer: If I had taken that offer, I would be running my own company by now.
exercises.explanation: Type 3 + Type 2:「had taken」 + 「would be running」。

exercises.prompt: 选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: If she were more decisive, she wouldn't have lost the deal.
options: If she were more decisive, she wouldn't have lost the deal.
If she was more decisive, she wouldn't lost the deal.
If she were more decisive, she wouldn't lose the deal.
If she would be more decisive, she would lose the deal.
exercises.answer: If she were more decisive, she wouldn't have lost the deal.

exercises.prompt: 造句:「要是我当时学了那门语言,我现在就会在东京工作。」

lessons.title: 其他条件句句型
lessons.description: 「unless」、「provided that」、「as long as」、「in case」、「otherwise」、「but for」

exercises.prompt: 「Unless you hurry, you'll miss the train.」 是什么意思?
options: 如果你赶时间就会错过火车
不赶时间就会错过火车
火车开了之后再赶时间
exercises.answer: 不赶时间就会错过火车
exercises.explanation: 「Unless」 = 「除非」。

exercises.prompt: 「Provided that you sign the NDA, we can share the document.」 = ?

不签保密协议我们也分享文件
exercises.answer: 签了保密协议我们就能分享文件
exercises.explanation: 「Provided that」 = 「只要……」。

exercises.prompt: 「But for your help, I would have failed.」 = ?
options: 没有你的帮助我会失败
exercises.answer: 没有你的帮助我会失败
exercises.explanation: 「But for sth」 = 「要不是……」(正式)。

exercises.prompt: 「I'll come ___ as you don't bring up politics.」(中文:「只要你不提政治,我就会来。」)
exercises.explanation: 「As long as」 / 「so long as」 / 「provided that」 = 「只要……」。

exercises.prompt: 「Take an umbrella in ___ it rains.」 填空?
exercises.explanation: 「In case」 = 「以防万一」。

exercises.prompt: 「Hurry up, ___ we'll be late.」 填空?
exercises.explanation: 「Otherwise」 / 「or」 / 「or else」 = 「否则」。

topics.title: 正式与非正式语域
topics.description: 用不同语气表达同一想法

guide.intro: 英语中,在口语和正式书面语中表达同一意思时用词不同。「get」 在日常会话中无所不能,但正式书面语中更倾向于 「receive」、「obtain」、「become」 等选项。

sections.text: 对不认识的人:「Dear Mr/Ms [姓]」。熟悉但仍属职业关系:「Hi [名]」。内部同事之间:「Hey [名]」 可以接受。结尾:「Sincerely」(最正式)、「Best regards」(标准)、「Best」/「Cheers」(亲切)。

rows.source: I am writing to enquire about…
Should you require any further information, please do not hesitate to contact me.
rows.translation: 如需更多信息,请随时联系我。

rows.source: Hey, just a quick heads up — the file is ready.
rows.translation: 嗨,简单告知一下 —— 文件准备好了。

sections.text: 中文里的「此致敬礼」 并不总是对应 「Sincerely」。正式申请用 「Yours sincerely」(英)、「Sincerely」(美)。给同事用 「Best regards」 就够了。

topics.title: 被动语态与复杂时态
topics.description: 过去完成时、将来完成时、情态被动

guide.intro: 在 B2 阶段,时态轴变得更精细。你将学习被动语态在各种时态中的形式,以及如何与情态动词结合。

sections.text: 过去完成时 — 更早的过去
过去完成时(had + V3)表示两个过去事件中较早发生的那个:「When I arrived, they had already left」 = 「我到达时,他们已经离开了」。相当于中文里的「曾经……了」 结构。

rows.source: By the time we got there, the meeting had ended.
rows.translation: 我们到那里时,会议已经结束了。

rows.source: She had never seen such a sight before.
rows.translation: 她之前从未见过这样的景象。

rows.source: The report had been reviewed by the board.
rows.translation: 报告已经被董事会审阅过了。

sections.text: 将来完成时(will have + V3)表示在未来某个时点已经完成的事情。「By 2030, AI will have transformed many industries」 = 「到 2030 年,人工智能将已经改造了许多行业」。

topics.title: 教育与学术生活
topics.description: 学校体系、学习习惯、考试词汇,以及英式英语与美式英语教育术语的差异

guide.intro: B2 阶段谈论教育不只是说一句 「I go to school」。各国教育体系不同,英式英语(BrE)和美式英语(AmE)的术语也有差异,描述学习习惯的动词(如 「cram」、「revise」、「retain」)也无法直接翻译成中文。

sections.text: 大多数国家的教育分为三个阶段:初等(primary)、中等(secondary)和高等(tertiary)。「Compulsory education」 = 「义务教育」。
中文里的「学习」 在英语中有多种细分:「study」=泛指学习;「revise」(英式)=复习;「cram」=临时突击;「memorize」=背诵;「grasp」=理解;「retain」=记住知识。

rows.source: I crammed all night for the exam.
rows.translation: 我整晚临时抱佛脚准备考试。

rows.source: You shouldn't just memorize — try to grasp the underlying ideas.
rows.translation: 不要只是死记硬背 —— 要努力理解核心概念。

rows.source: I find it hard to retain information when I'm tired.
rows.translation: 我累的时候很难记住知识。

rows.source: I need to brush up on my French before the trip.
rows.translation: 出行前我得复习一下我的法语。

sections.text: 英式英语 「sit an exam」 = 美式英语 「take an exam」。成绩相关习语:「pass with flying colours」(以优异成绩通过)、「scrape through」(勉强通过)、「fail miserably」(惨败)、「ace an exam」(考得极好)。
英式英语里的 「public school」 实际上是收费的、高端的私立学校 —— 并不是「公立学校」。这是一个容易混淆的术语。英式英语中「公立学校」 用 「state school」。

rows.source: I had to resit the exam after failing.
rows.translation: 我考砸了之后不得不补考。

topics.title: 辩论与反对
topics.description: 在职业/社交场合礼貌反对、让步、寻找共识的句型

guide.intro: B2 阶段的辩论已远不止 「I agree / I disagree」 那么简单。在职业场合直接反对会显得粗鲁;然而一味同意又显得被动。解决之道是:先认可,再委婉提出异议。这与中文里「你说得有道理,但……」 之类的句型相似。

sections.text: 英语中有许多现成的反对句型。「I beg to differ」 正式且礼貌;「with all due respect」 略带防御性;「I'm not so sure」 很委婉;「on the contrary」 直截了当但不带个人色彩。

rows: I'm not so sure about that

sections.text: 让步 + 反驳(concede + push back)
高效的辩论者会先部分认可对方,再坚持自己的主张。「Granted, …」、「Fair point, but …」、「I take your point, however …」 都属于此类。

rows.source: Granted, the costs are high, but the long-term benefits outweigh them.
rows.translation: 承认成本很高,但长期收益远超于此。

rows.source: Fair point, but I still think the timing is off.
rows.translation: 你说得有道理,但我仍然觉得时机不对。

rows.source: I take your point; that said, the data tells a different story.
rows.translation: 我明白你的意思;不过数据讲了一个不同的故事。

sections.text: 在会议中礼貌插话可以说 「If I may, …」/「May I jump in?」/「Sorry to interrupt, but …」。请求进一步解释时,可以说 「Could you elaborate?」/「Could you clarify what you mean?」。
中文里「我当然不同意」 这种程度的反对,如果直接译为 「Of course I disagree」 会显得过于生硬。改用 「I'm afraid I have to disagree」 或 「I'd respectfully push back on that」 —— 同样清晰,但语气好得多。
最后,用 「find common ground」(寻找共识)、「meet in the middle」(各让一步)、「reach a compromise」(达成妥协)、「agree to disagree」(求同存异)等表达,可以成熟地结束辩论。

rows.source: Why don't we meet in the middle on this?
rows.translation: 我们在这件事上各让一步好吗?

rows.source: All things considered, I think we've found a workable compromise.
rows.translation: 综合考虑,我认为我们已经达成了一个可行的妥协。
我们就当我们意见不同好了。

exercises.prompt: 「I see your point, ___ I'd push back on the assumption.」 填空?
exercises.explanation: 先认可,再反驳。

exercises.prompt: 「I'm not so ___ I agree with that conclusion.」(中文:「我并不太确定自己赞同这个结论。」)
exercises.explanation: 「Not so sure/certain/convinced」 = 「不太确定」。

exercises.prompt: 把反对的句型配对
把缓和语气的工具配对

pairs.left: I'm not so sure about that
I see what you mean, but…
That's one way to look at it, although…
pairs.right: 这只是其中一种看法,不过……

exercises.prompt: 选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: With all due respect, I think there's a flaw in your reasoning.
options: With all due respect, I think there's a flaw in your reasoning.
With all the respect, I think there's a flow in your reasoning.
With all due respect, I think there's a flaw in your reason.
Without due respect, I think there's a flaw in your reasoning.
exercises.answer: With all due respect, I think there's a flaw in your reasoning.
exercises.explanation: 「Flaw in reasoning」 = 「推理中的漏洞」。

exercises.prompt: 选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: I beg to differ; the figures suggest the opposite.
options: I beg to differ; the figures suggest the opposite.
I beg to defer; the figures suggest the opposite.
I begged to differ; the figures suggest the opposite.
I beg to differ; the figures suggested the opposite.
exercises.answer: I beg to differ; the figures suggest the opposite.
exercises.explanation: 「I beg to differ」 + 「figures suggest」 构成强而礼貌的反对。

exercises.prompt: 造句:「恕我直言,我认为这些数字可以有不同的解读。」
exercises.answer: With all due respect I think these figures can be interpreted differently

exercises.prompt: 造句:「事实恰恰相反,近期的报告指向了不同的局面。」
exercises.answer: On the contrary recent reports point to a different picture

lessons.title: 部分让步并反对(concede + push back)
lessons.description: 「Granted」、「I take your point」、「that said」、「even so」

exercises.prompt: 在 「Granted, the costs are higher, but the long-term benefits outweigh them.」 中,「Granted」 起什么作用?
exercises.explanation: 「Granted, …」 是「让步 + 反驳」 句型。

exercises.prompt: 「I take your point, but I still think we need more data.」 = ?
options: 我明白你的论点,但我们仍需要更多数据
exercises.answer: 我明白你的论点,但我们仍需要更多数据
exercises.explanation: 「I take your point, but…」 = 部分认可 + 反对。

exercises.prompt: 「That said, I still don't see how this scales.」 = ?
options: 即便如此,我还是看不出它如何扩大规模
exercises.answer: 即便如此,我还是看不出它如何扩大规模
exercises.explanation: 「That said」 = 「尽管如此」。

exercises.prompt: 「___ that point, but I'd add that timing matters too.」 填空?
exercises.explanation: 「Granted」 / 「Fair point」 都是部分认可的表达。

exercises.prompt: 「Even ___, I'd argue the trade-off isn't worth it.」 填空?
exercises.explanation: 「Even so」 = 「即便如此」。

exercises.prompt: 「I'll concede that ___ this once, but it's not the rule.」 填空?
exercises.explanation: 「Concede sth for this once」 = 「这一次承认」。

exercises.prompt: 把「让步+反驳」句型配对
把反驳副词配对
选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: Fair point, but I still think the timing is off.
options: Fair point, but I still think the timing is off.
Fair point, but I steel think the timing is off.
Fare point, but I still think the timing is off.
Fair point, but I still think the timing was off.
exercises.answer: Fair point, but I still think the timing is off.
exercises.explanation: 「Fair point, but…」 = 部分认可 + 反驳。

exercises.prompt: 选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: Granted, the proposal has merit, but it's not feasible right now.
options: Granted, the proposal has merit, but it's not feasible right now.
Granted, the proposal has merit, but it's not feasibly right now.
Granted, the proposal had merit, but it's not feasible right now.
Granting, the proposal has merit, but it's not feasible right now.
exercises.answer: Granted, the proposal has merit, but it's not feasible right now.
exercises.explanation: 「Has merit」 = 「有价值」;「feasible」 = 「可行」。

exercises.prompt: 造句:「这个提议是合理的,不过我觉得时机不对。」
exercises.answer: The proposal is reasonable that said I think the timing is wrong

exercises.prompt: 造句:「我承认成本很高,但长期收益更重要。」
exercises.answer: I'll concede that the costs are high but the long-term gain outweighs them

lessons.title: 支持观点并举例
lessons.description: 「For instance」、「take X」、「a case in point」、「by way of example」

exercises.prompt: 「A case in point is the 2008 financial crisis.」 = ?
options: 可以举 2008 年金融危机为例
exercises.answer: 可以举 2008 年金融危机为例
exercises.explanation: 「A case in point」 = 「一个典型例子」。

exercises.prompt: 「Take Berlin, for example.」 这一句型起什么作用?
exercises.explanation: 「Take X, for example」 = 「以 X 为例」。

exercises.prompt: 哪一句是最学术的举例句式?
options: By way of illustration, consider the case of Berlin.
exercises.answer: By way of illustration, consider the case of Berlin.
exercises.explanation: 「By way of illustration, consider…」 是正式 / 学术性的举例开头。

exercises.prompt: 「This is borne ___ by recent statistics.」(中文:「这一点得到了近期统计数据的支持。」)
exercises.explanation: 「Borne out by」 = 「被……所证实」。

exercises.prompt: 「Studies have ___ this trend repeatedly.」 填空?
exercises.explanation: 「Confirmed/shown/documented」 都是提供论据的动词。

exercises.prompt: 「There's ___ evidence to support this.」 填空?
exercises.explanation: 「Ample/substantial/considerable evidence」 = 「大量/重要的证据」。

exercises.prompt: 把举例表达配对
把举证动词配对
选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: Recent studies bear out this hypothesis quite convincingly.
options: Recent studies bear out this hypothesis quite convincingly.
Recent studies bare out this hypothesis quite convincingly.
Recent studies bear out this hypocrisy quite convincingly.
Recent studies beard out this hypothesis quite convincingly.
exercises.answer: Recent studies bear out this hypothesis quite convincingly.
exercises.explanation: 「Bear out」 = 「证实」。

exercises.prompt: 选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: Take Tokyo, for example — it's been a model of urban planning.
options: Take Tokyo, for example — it's been a model of urban planning.
Take Tokyo, for example — it's been a model of urban planing.
Take Tokyo, for example — it has been a modal of urban planning.
Take Tokyo, for example — it's been a moral of urban planning.
exercises.answer: Take Tokyo, for example — it's been a model of urban planning.
exercises.explanation: 「A model of X」 = 「X 的典范」。

exercises.prompt: 造句:「我们可以举最近的公司合并作为典型例子。」
exercises.answer: A case in point would be the recent corporate merger

exercises.prompt: 造句:「我的论点由过去三年的统计数据支持。」
exercises.answer: My argument is backed up by statistics from the past three years

lessons.title: 提问和插话
lessons.description: 「Could you elaborate」、「may I jump in」、「if I may」

exercises.prompt: 「Could you elaborate on that?」 = ?
exercises.explanation: 「Elaborate on」 = 「详细说明」。

exercises.prompt: 在会议中插话最礼貌的方式是?
options: If I may, I'd like to add something.
exercises.answer: If I may, I'd like to add something.
exercises.explanation: 「If I may」 = 「请允许我」(正式插话)。

exercises.prompt: 「Sorry to interrupt, but…」 在什么情况下合适?
options: 为了快速指出某点而礼貌地插话
exercises.answer: 为了快速指出某点而礼貌地插话
exercises.explanation: 「Sorry to interrupt, but…」 = 「抱歉打断一下,但是……」。

exercises.prompt: 「May I ___ in for a second?」 填空?
exercises.explanation: 「Jump in」 / 「step in」 / 「chime in」 = 「插话」。

exercises.prompt: 「Could you ___ what you mean by 「sustainable」?」 填空?
exercises.explanation: 「Clarify what you mean」 = 「澄清你的意思」。

exercises.prompt: 「Just to play ___ advocate for a moment…」 填空?
exercises.explanation: 「Play devil's advocate」 = 「故意唱反调」。

exercises.prompt: 把插话表达配对
把请求澄清的表达配对

pairs.left: Just to make sure I follow…

exercises.prompt: 选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: Sorry to interrupt, but could you clarify what you mean by scalable?
options: Sorry to interrupt, but could you clarify what you mean by scalable?
Sorry to interrupt, but could you classify what you mean by scalable?
Sorry to interrupt, but could you clarify what you mean by scaleable?
Sorry to interrupting, but could you clarify what you mean by scalable?
exercises.answer: Sorry to interrupt, but could you clarify what you mean by scalable?
exercises.explanation: 礼貌插话 + 请求澄清的句型。

exercises.prompt: 选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: If I may, I'd like to push back on that assumption.
options: If I may, I'd like to push back on that assumption.
If I might, I'd like to push back on that assumption.
If I may, I'd like to push back on that assumed.
If I may, I'd liked to push back on that assumption.
exercises.answer: If I may, I'd like to push back on that assumption.
exercises.explanation: 「If I may + push back on assumption」 = 正式反对。

exercises.prompt: 造句:「请允许我礼貌地对这一假设提出异议。」
exercises.answer: If I may I'd like to respectfully push back on that assumption

exercises.prompt: 造句:「您能再详细说说吗,因为我没完全跟上你的逻辑。」
exercises.answer: Could you elaborate on that as I didn't quite follow the reasoning

lessons.title: 结束辩论与达成共识
lessons.description: 「common ground」、「meet in the middle」、「agree to disagree」

exercises.prompt: 「Let's find some common ground.」 = ?
exercises.explanation: 「Common ground」 = 「共同点」。

exercises.prompt: 「Why don't we meet in the middle?」 = ?
options: 我们为什么不各让一步呢?(达成妥协)
我们为什么不在路中间见面?
exercises.answer: 我们为什么不各让一步呢?(达成妥协)
exercises.explanation: 「Meet in the middle」 是习语 = 「各让一步达成共识」。中文 L1 直译陷阱:「在中间见面」 是字面意思,实际语境中几乎不会这样用。

exercises.prompt: 「Let's just agree to disagree.」 = ?
options: 我们承认彼此意见不同
exercises.answer: 我们承认彼此意见不同
exercises.explanation: 「Agree to disagree」 = 「同意保留各自的不同意见」。

exercises.prompt: 「I think we can ___ a compromise here.」 填空?
exercises.explanation: 「Reach/find/strike a compromise」 = 「达成妥协」。

exercises.prompt: 「Let's ___ to disagree on this one.」 填空?
exercises.explanation: 「Agree to disagree」 句型。

exercises.prompt: 「We seem to be at cross ___ here.」(中文:「我们似乎是各说各的。」)
exercises.explanation: 「At cross purposes」 = 「彼此误解」。

exercises.prompt: 把和解句型配对

pairs.right: 求同存异 / 承认分歧

exercises.prompt: 把结尾表达配对

pairs.left: at the end of the day,

exercises.prompt: 选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: All things considered, I think we've found a workable compromise.
options: All things considered, I think we've found a workable compromise.
All things considering, I think we've found a workable compromise.
All things considered, I think we've find a workable compromise.
All things considered, I think we've found a walkable compromise.
exercises.answer: All things considered, I think we've found a workable compromise.
exercises.explanation: 「Workable compromise」 = 「可行的妥协」。

exercises.prompt: 选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: At the end of the day, we'll have to agree to disagree.
options: At the end of the day, we'll have to agree to disagree.
At the end of a day, we'll have to agree to disagree.
At the end of the day, we'll had to agree to disagree.
At the ends of the day, we'll have to agree to disagree.
exercises.answer: At the end of the day, we'll have to agree to disagree.
exercises.explanation: 「At the end of the day」 = 「归根结底」。

exercises.prompt: 造句:「综合考虑,我认为我们可以各让一步并继续推进。」
exercises.answer: All things considered I think we can meet in the middle and move forward

exercises.prompt: 造句:「总结来说,尽管有小分歧,我们仍达成了重要的共识。」
exercises.answer: To wrap up despite minor differences we have reached a significant compromise

lessons.title: 对话:会议小组讨论 — 礼貌反对
lessons.description: 你在小组讨论中礼貌地与另一位发言人意见相左 — 正式语域与缓和语气

exercises.prompt: 在会议小组讨论中礼貌反对时

turns.speaker: co
turns.text: I firmly believe remote work has permanently damaged team cohesion across the industry.

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 礼貌反对 — 「with respect」
options: With all due respect, I'd argue the evidence on that point is far from conclusive.
With all due respect, I'd argue the evidence on that point far from concluding.
Respect due with all, I argue the evidence point that conclusive far from.
turns.answer: With all due respect, I'd argue the evidence on that point is far from conclusive.

turns.speaker: co
turns.text: Numerous studies have shown a decline in spontaneous collaboration, though. Surely you agree?

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 部分认可,再提出反方论点
options: I partly agree, but I think the same studies overlook gains in deep-focus output.
I partial agree, but the same studies overlooking gains in deep-focus output.
Agree partly, but same the studies overlook the deep-focus gains output.
turns.answer: I partly agree, but I think the same studies overlook gains in deep-focus output.

turns.speaker: co
turns.text: Perhaps, but spontaneous innovation rarely happens over a video call, does it?

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 被动引述 — 「据称……」
turns.after: often claimed that, yet hybrid models consistently outperform fully in-person ones.

turns.speaker: co
turns.text: Fair point. Would you concede that leadership styles must evolve to make hybrid work?

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 用情态完成时回应
options: Absolutely. Managers should have adapted their playbooks years before the pandemic.
Absolutely. Managers should adapt their playbooks years before the pandemic.
Absolute. Managers adapt should playbooks the years before pandemic.
turns.answer: Absolutely. Managers should have adapted their playbooks years before the pandemic.

turns.speaker: co
turns.text: On that, we agree completely. Perhaps the takeaway is investment in modern leadership training.

topics.title: B2 — 综合复习
topics.description: 整合所有 B2 主题的综合练习

guide.intro: 本主题是对 B2 中所有话题的综合复习:表达观点、新闻、环境、科技、人际关系、条件句、语域和复杂时态。

items: 我能使用缓和语气的句型。
我能读懂新闻标题。
我掌握气候相关的搭配词组。
我能选出动词短语的对应中文。
我能构造第二类、第三类和混合条件句。
我能区分正式语域与非正式语域。
我能用过去完成时和将来完成时构建时间轴。

sections.text: 做完本节后,请记下出错的题目,并回到相关主题复习。

lessons.title: 综合复习 1
lessons.description: 观点、新闻与环境

exercises.prompt: 「依我看这个想法合理」 的英文是?
options: For me this idea makes sense.
As far as I'm concerned, this idea makes sense.
By me, this idea makes sense.
From me this idea makes logic.
exercises.answer: As far as I'm concerned, this idea makes sense.

exercises.prompt: 「The bill ___ expected to pass next week.」(中文:「该法案预计将于下周通过。」)
英文 — 中文
造句:「可再生能源正在变得越来越实惠。」
exercises.answer: Renewable energy is becoming more affordable

exercises.prompt: 选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: I'd argue the policy needs revision.
options: I'd argue the policy needs revision.
I argue the police need revision.
I'd agree the policy need revision.
I argued the policy needs vision.
exercises.answer: I'd argue the policy needs revision.

exercises.prompt: 「claimed」 通常带有什么样的语气?
options: 怀疑 / 无证据的主张
exercises.answer: 怀疑 / 无证据的主张

exercises.prompt: 「We must take ___ on climate change.」(中文:「我们必须就气候变化采取行动。」)
「actual」 翻译成中文是:
造句:「恕我直言,我并未完全被说服。」
exercises.answer: With all due respect I'm not entirely convinced

exercises.prompt: 「Two suspects ___ been detained.」(中文:「两名嫌疑人已被拘留。」)
下列哪一句符合英语用法?(表达「猫普遍是独立的动物」)
exercises.explanation: 中文 L1 常见错误:把表达普遍性的主语加上 「the」。中文「猫是独立的动物」 没有冠词,但学生过度补「the」 → 错。英语规则:表达整类(generic plural)时用零冠词 + 复数。

lessons.title: 综合复习 2
lessons.description: 科技、人际关系与语域

exercises.prompt: 「roll out a product」 如何翻译?
「Let's ___ back to that later.」(中文:「这事我们以后再回过来谈。」)
动词短语 — 中文
造句:「她敬重她的导师。」
exercises.answer: She looks up to her mentor

exercises.prompt: 选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: Should you require further assistance, please contact me.
options: Should you require further assistance, please contact me.
Should you required further assistance, please contact me.
Should you require farther assistance, please contact me.
Should require you further assistance, please contact me.
exercises.answer: Should you require further assistance, please contact me.

exercises.prompt: 正式书面语中,「get worse」 用什么替代?
「I'm fed ___ with the constant delays.」(中文:「我受够了不断的延期。」)
哪一种邮件开头适合发给陌生的正式收件人?
造句:「我会非常感谢您的帮助。」
exercises.answer: I would be grateful for your assistance

exercises.prompt: 「I look ___ to hearing from you.」(中文:「期待您的回复。」)

lessons.title: 综合复习 3
lessons.description: 条件句与复杂时态

exercises.prompt: 「要是我当时更努力,现在就会有更好的工作」 属于哪一种结构?
options: 第一类条件句(可能发生的未来)
第二类条件句(假设的现在)
第三类条件句(对过去的遗憾)
混合条件句(过去原因 + 现在结果)
exercises.answer: 混合条件句(过去原因 + 现在结果)
exercises.explanation: 「当时更努力」(过去)+「现在更好的工作」(现在)→ 混合条件句。结构:If + had + V3, would + V1。

exercises.prompt: 「If I ___ you, I'd take the offer.」(中文:「我要是你,我就接受这个提议。」)
造句:「我要是知道,就会打电话了。」
exercises.answer: If I had known I would have called

exercises.prompt: 句子 — 条件句类型

pairs.left: If I had time, I'd help.
If I had had time, I would have helped.
If I had taken that job, I'd be in London now.
pairs.right: 混合条件句(过去原因 + 现在结果)

pairs.left: If it rains, we'll stay in.
pairs.right: 第一类(可能发生的未来)

exercises.prompt: 「Had I known」 的等价说法?
选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: By 2030, AI will have transformed many industries.
options: By 2030, AI will have transformed many industries.
By 2030, AI has transformed many industries.
By 2030, AI will transform many industry.
Buy 2030, AI will have transformed many industries.
exercises.answer: By 2030, AI will have transformed many industries.

exercises.prompt: 「When I arrived, the meeting ___ already ended.」(中文:「我到达时,会议已经结束了。」)
「I wish I had told the truth」 = ?
options: 我希望我当时说了真话。
exercises.answer: 我希望我当时说了真话。

exercises.prompt: 造句:「要是我没换城市,我现在还会在那里工作。」
exercises.answer: If I hadn't moved cities I would still be working there

exercises.prompt: 「You ___ have warned me.」(中文:「你本应该提醒我的。」)

lessons.title: 对话:综合复习 — 正式会议
lessons.description: 在一次利益相关方会议上,综合涉及观点表达、被动结构与语域

exercises.prompt: 在利益相关方会议上综合运用 B2 句式

turns.speaker: chair
turns.text: Let's open the floor. What's your overall take on the proposed budget cuts?

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 选出正式的观点开场
options: From my perspective, the cuts are necessary but the timing should be reconsidered.
From my perspective, the cuts necessary but the timing should reconsider.
My perspective from, cuts the necessary timing reconsider should.
turns.answer: From my perspective, the cuts are necessary but the timing should be reconsidered.

turns.speaker: chair
turns.text: Interesting. Could you elaborate on why the timing concerns you specifically?

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 选出混合条件句
options: If we had announced this last quarter, morale wouldn't be so fragile right now.
If we announced this last quarter, morale wouldn't been so fragile right now.
Announced if we last quarter, morale fragile so right now wouldn't.
turns.answer: If we had announced this last quarter, morale wouldn't be so fragile right now.

turns.speaker: chair
turns.text: Fair point. It's been reported that several teams may resign if cuts proceed as planned.

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 被动引述 — 「本来可以避免」
turns.after: mitigated if leadership had communicated more transparently from the start.

turns.speaker: chair
turns.text: Noted. Would you support a phased rollout instead of an immediate freeze?

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 在正式的接受中提出建议
options: I'd strongly support a phased approach, provided staff are consulted at every stage.
I strong support a phased approach, provided staff consulting at every stage.
Strongly support I'd phased the approach, every stage staff at consult.
turns.answer: I'd strongly support a phased approach, provided staff are consulted at every stage.

turns.speaker: chair
turns.text: Thank you for the constructive input. Let's draft a revised proposal by Friday.

levels.name: C1 — 高级
levels.description: 在商务、学术和新闻语境中运用英语。捍卫观点、构建正式话语,并自如地使用习语。

topics.title: 商务英语
topics.description: 会议、谈判与正式书面沟通

guide.intro: 商务英语生存于远高于日常用语的语域中。报告中常用 「in light of」、「given the fact that」、「on account of」 来替代日常的 「because」。C1 阶段要教的不仅是词汇,更是如何始终保持语域的一致性。

sections.text: 正式语域中的因果连接词
「Because」 属于日常口语。在正式写作中,人们更倾向使用 「in view of」、「given that」、「in light of」、「owing to」。「Therefore」、「hence」、「consequently」 看似同义,但 「hence」 略显文言,「consequently」 则带有更浓的学术色彩。
在商务谈判中,说「不」的方式有几十种。「I'm afraid that won't be possible」、「We may have difficulty meeting that figure」、「Let me get back to you on that」 都是委婉的拒绝。中文里那种间接拒绝的反射(例如「现在很难」)在英语谈判中起到相同的作用。

rows.source: I'm afraid that won't be feasible at this stage.
rows.translation: 恐怕在现阶段难以落实。

rows.source: We may have difficulty meeting that figure.
rows.translation: 我们可能难以达到这个数字。

rows.source: Let me get back to you on that.
rows.translation: 关于这一点,我回头再答复您。

rows.source: I'd like to push back on that timeline.
rows.translation: 我想对这一时间表提出异议。

sections.text: 在英语商务环境中,关键不仅在于选词,更在于你的措辞有多委婉。从中文切换到英语的专业人士常犯的错误是:直接说 「It is not possible」 就戛然而止。更自然的版本是:「I'm afraid that may not be feasible right now — perhaps we could explore an alternative?」

lessons.title: 开始会议
lessons.description: 问候、议程与致谢

exercises.prompt: 「今天的议程涵盖三个主要议题」用英语怎么说?
options: Today's agenda covers three main points.
exercises.answer: Today's agenda covers three main points.

exercises.prompt: 「Thank you all for ___ time to attend.」(中文:「感谢大家抽出时间出席。」)
exercises.explanation: 「taking the time to」 = 「抽出时间」。

exercises.prompt: 开场句式 — 功能
请组合出这个句子:「我谨代表公司向各位致以热烈的欢迎。」
exercises.answer: On behalf of the company I extend a warm welcome to everyone

exercises.prompt: 下列哪一句在会议中存在语域(register)错误?
options: I'd like to begin by reviewing last quarter's results.
Yo team, let's smash this Q3 review.
Let's get started by going through the agenda.
exercises.answer: Yo team, let's smash this Q3 review.
exercises.explanation: 「Yo team」 与 「smash」 对正式会议而言过于俚语化。

exercises.prompt: 请选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: Without further ado, let's dive into the agenda.
options: Without further ado, let's dive into the agenda.
Without farther ado, let's dive into the agenda.
Without further to do, let's dive into the agenda.
With further ado, let's dive into the agenda.
exercises.answer: Without further ado, let's dive into the agenda.

exercises.prompt: 「In light ___ recent developments, we'll add an item.」(中文:「鉴于最近的进展,我们将增加一项议题。」)
「Let me hand it over to Sarah」 是什么意思?
exercises.explanation: 「hand over to」 是会议中常见的短语动词,意为「把话筒/发言权交给某人」。中文「移交」并不能完全覆盖这一动作。

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「考虑到时间有限,我们简短地谈一谈。」
exercises.answer: Given the limited time let's keep it brief

exercises.prompt: 「Today's session will run for ___ hour and a half.」(中文:「今天的会议将持续一个半小时。」)
exercises.explanation: 此处 「h」 不发音,故用 「an hour」。

exercises.prompt: 「I'd like to extend a warm welcome」 这一表达的细微含义是什么?
exercises.explanation: 「extend a welcome」 是固定的正式搭配,直译「延伸欢迎」是中文 L1 学习者的常见错误;请整体记忆。

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「此刻我把发言权交给我的同事。」
exercises.answer: At this point I'll hand over to my colleague

lessons.title: 谈判语言
lessons.description: 软化语气、反提议、底线

exercises.prompt: 下列哪一句以最得体的外交辞令拒绝了一项提议?
options: I'm afraid that won't be feasible at this stage.
exercises.answer: I'm afraid that won't be feasible at this stage.

exercises.prompt: 「We may have ___ meeting that figure.」(中文:「我们可能难以达到这个数字。」)
谈判句式 — 功能

pairs.left: Let me get back to you.

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「我想对这一时间表提出异议。」
exercises.answer: I'd like to push back on that timeline

exercises.prompt: 「That's a non-starter」 是什么意思?
options: 这是个完全无法接受的提议
exercises.answer: 这是个完全无法接受的提议
exercises.explanation: 中文直译「不是开始者」会丢失语义;在谈判中 「non-starter」 等于「根本谈不下去」。

exercises.prompt: 请选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: We have some flexibility on volume but not on price.
options: We have some flexibility on volume but not on price.
We had some flexibility on volumes but not on price.
We have some flexibility on volume but not on prices.
We have some flexible on volume but not on price.
exercises.answer: We have some flexibility on volume but not on price.

exercises.prompt: 「We can meet you ___」(中文:「我们可以各退一步。」)
下列哪一句属于「坚决拒绝」?
options: We can probably work something out.
There may be room for compromise.

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「我与团队商议后再回复你。」
exercises.answer: I'll get back to you after consulting my team

exercises.prompt: 「Could we explore some ___ options?」(中文:「我们能否探讨一些替代方案?」)
「We're prepared to walk away」 是什么意思?
exercises.explanation: 中文直译「走开」无法表达谈判语境;「walk away」 在商务英语中是固定习语,意为「离开谈判桌、不再继续」。

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「按这个价位我们无法继续推进。」
exercises.answer: We can't move forward at this price point

lessons.title: 正式书面沟通
lessons.description: 电子邮件、报告与合同语言

exercises.prompt: 在一封正式邮件中,「您将如何描述下个季度的展望?」 该怎样表达?
options: How would you characterise your outlook for the coming quarter?
Tell me about next quarter, dude.
exercises.answer: How would you characterise your outlook for the coming quarter?

exercises.prompt: 「Pursuant ___ our discussion…」(中文:「根据我们的讨论……」)
exercises.explanation: 「pursuant to」 = 「依据/据此」(正式)。

exercises.prompt: 商务书信用语 — 中文
请组合出这个句子:「如有疑问,请不要犹豫,随时联系我们。」
exercises.answer: Should you have any queries please do not hesitate to reach out

exercises.prompt: 在合同中,「aforementioned」 是什么意思?
exercises.explanation: 「aforementioned」 = 前述,合同与正式文书专属;中文里「上述」「前述」均可对应。

exercises.prompt: 请选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: Notwithstanding the delay, the deliverables remain unchanged.
options: Notwithstanding the delay, the deliverables remain unchanged.
Not withstanding the delay, the deliverable remain unchanged.
Notwithstanding the delays, the deliverables remained unchanged.
Notwithstand the delay, the deliverables remain unchanged.
exercises.answer: Notwithstanding the delay, the deliverables remain unchanged.

exercises.prompt: 「I am writing in ___ to your inquiry.」(中文:「现就您的询问做出回复。」)
在正式报告中,「we discovered」 通常会被替换为什么?
请组合出这个句子:「请您审阅我们的提案后再回复,十分感激。」
exercises.answer: We kindly ask that you revert after reviewing our proposal

exercises.prompt: 「The contract shall be ___ effective upon signing.」(中文:「本合同自签署之日起生效。」)
exercises.explanation: 「shall be deemed」 属于合同用语。

exercises.prompt: 「We regret to inform you」 带有怎样的语气?
exercises.explanation: 中文「很遗憾通知您」 = 英语 「We regret to inform you」;后者多用于正式商务/法律书面拒绝。

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「我们遗憾地通知您,您此次的申请将不会继续推进。」
exercises.answer: We regret to inform you that your application will not be progressing this time

lessons.title: 战略与决策
lessons.description: 风险、机会与优先级排序的语言

exercises.prompt: 战略术语 — 中文

pairs.right: 容易摘到的果实(易得收益)

exercises.prompt: 「low-hanging fruit」 是什么意思?
exercises.explanation: 比喻型习语:不能字面理解。「low-hanging fruit」 在商业语境中 = 「容易拿下的收益/机会」。

exercises.prompt: 「This initiative gives us a competitive ___」(中文:「这项举措带给我们竞争优势。」)
请组合出这个句子:「为降低风险,我们必须使资源多元化。」
exercises.answer: We need to diversify resources to mitigate risk

exercises.prompt: 在战略报告中,「going forward」 是什么意思?
exercises.explanation: 「going forward」 在商业语境中是高频副词性短语,等同于「from now on」 或 「henceforth」;中文 L1 常误译为「向前走」。

exercises.prompt: 请选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: We need to mitigate risk while pursuing growth.
options: We need to mitigate risk while pursuing growth.
We need to mitigated risk while pursuing growth.
We need to mitigate risks while pursuing growths.
We need to mitigate risk while perusing growth.
exercises.answer: We need to mitigate risk while pursuing growth.

exercises.prompt: 「The investment yields ___ returns at this scale.」(中文:「在这一规模下,这项投资呈现出收益递减的现象。」)
在商业语境中,「pivot」 是什么意思?
exercises.explanation: 源自篮球「中枢脚」隐喻;现代商业 = 公司转型/转向新方向。中文「转型」更接近此意,「转向」也可。

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「该公司转向了 B2B 业务。」
「It's a ___ proposition for both sides.」(中文:「这对双方而言都是一份共赢的提议。」)
「The deal must have fallen through last night.」 = ?
options: 这笔交易昨晚一定泡汤了。(对过去的强推测)
这笔交易昨晚必须泡汤。
这笔交易昨晚也许泡汤了。
exercises.answer: 这笔交易昨晚一定泡汤了。(对过去的强推测)
exercises.explanation: 「must have + V3」 = 对过去事实的强烈推测(基于现在的证据)。中文 L1 易把它和 「had to」(过去的义务)混淆,但语义截然不同。

exercises.prompt: 情态完成式 — 中文

pairs.right: 本可以做(有能力但未必做)

lessons.title: 撰写高管摘要
lessons.description: 面向高层管理者:简洁、克制、以行动为导向

exercises.prompt: 作为高管摘要的开篇,下列哪句最为恰当?
options: We have done a lot of stuff this quarter and want to share it.
This memo summarises Q3 performance, headline risks and the recommended course of action.
Hi team, here's what's been going on lately.
So basically the quarter went okay-ish.
exercises.answer: This memo summarises Q3 performance, headline risks and the recommended course of action.
exercises.explanation: 高管摘要在一句话中浓缩范围、风险和建议。

exercises.prompt: 「Revenue grew 12% year-on-year, ___ by enterprise renewals.」(中文:「在企业客户续约的推动下,营收同比增长 12%。」)
exercises.explanation: 在高管摘要中,「driven by」 用于说明增长的原因。

exercises.prompt: 高管摘要的表达 — 其功能
请组合出这个句子:「我们的建议是将资源重新分配到上层细分市场。」
exercises.answer: Our recommendation is to reallocate resources to the upper segment

exercises.prompt: 「Headwinds notwithstanding, margins held steady.」 是什么意思?
options: 尽管面临不利因素,利润率保持稳定。
风变大了,利润率下降了。
利润率随着逆风一起上升。
exercises.answer: 尽管面临不利因素,利润率保持稳定。
exercises.explanation: 「headwinds」 在商业语境中是「不利因素」的比喻;「X notwithstanding」 是 C1 级倒装让步,等同于 「despite X」 但更正式。

exercises.prompt: 请选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: On balance, the quarter exceeded expectations despite supply-side pressures.
options: On balance, the quarter exceeded expectations despite supply-side pressures.
On balanced, the quarter exceeded expectation despite supply-side pressures.
On balance, the quarter exceeded expectations despite supply-sided pressure.
Of balance, the quarter exceeded expectations despite supply-side pressures.
exercises.answer: On balance, the quarter exceeded expectations despite supply-side pressures.

exercises.prompt: 「The proposal is, on ___, the most defensible option available.」(中文:「总体而言,该提案是目前最具说服力的选择。」)
高管摘要中存在语域错误的是哪一句?
options: We absolutely crushed it last quarter, no cap.
Customer retention remained the principal lever for growth.
The data points to a structural rather than cyclical decline.
exercises.answer: We absolutely crushed it last quarter, no cap.
exercises.explanation: 「No cap」 与 「crushed」 不适合高管摘要。

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「尽管利润不及预期,现金流仍然稳健。」
exercises.answer: While profit fell short of expectations cash flow remained robust

exercises.prompt: 「The board is asked to ___ the proposed reallocation.」(中文:「现请董事会批准所提出的资源再分配方案。」)
exercises.explanation: 「endorse」 在正式批准场合常用。

exercises.prompt: 「Subject to board approval」 这一表达的作用是什么?
options: 以获得董事会批准为前提
董事会尚未讨论此议题
exercises.answer: 以获得董事会批准为前提
exercises.explanation: 「subject to X」 = 「以 X 为条件 / 待 X 成立」;在合同与高管摘要中是固定表达,中文「以……为准/前提」。

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「该风险看似可控,但仍需密切监控。」
exercises.answer: The risk appears manageable but warrants close monitoring

lessons.title: 正式电子邮件语域
lessons.description: 开头、请求、结尾:该选哪种语气

exercises.prompt: 给重要客户写邮件时,最合适的开场是哪一句?
options: I trust this email finds you well.
exercises.answer: I trust this email finds you well.
exercises.explanation: 正式而礼貌的开场;「I hope this finds you well」 是较中性的变体。

exercises.prompt: 「I am writing to ___ a meeting at your earliest convenience.」(中文:「我写信来希望在您方便时安排一次会议。」)
正式结尾用语 — 含义

pairs.right: 不知收件人姓名时(Dear Sir/Madam)
知道收件人姓名时(Dear Mr Smith)

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「事先感谢您的回复。」
exercises.answer: Thank you in advance for your reply

exercises.prompt: 下列哪种表达能礼貌地软化请求?
options: I would be most grateful if you could send the report by Friday.
Why haven't you sent it yet?
exercises.answer: I would be most grateful if you could send the report by Friday.

exercises.prompt: 请选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: Should you require any further information, please do not hesitate to contact me.
options: Should you require any further information, please do not hesitate to contact me.
Should you required any further informations, please do not hesitate to contact me.
If you require any farther information, please do not hesitate to contact me.
Should you require any further information, please not hesitate to contact me.
exercises.answer: Should you require any further information, please do not hesitate to contact me.

exercises.prompt: 「Apologies for the ___ in responding.」(中文:「对于回复的延迟深表歉意。」)
人们如何理解 「Per our last conversation」 这一表达?
options: 略带正式,有时带些施压意味(尤其是用于提醒对方时)
exercises.answer: 略带正式,有时带些施压意味(尤其是用于提醒对方时)
exercises.explanation: 「per」 = 「依据/根据」;直译中文「按照我们上次的对话」 显得平淡,但英语职场邮件里该句已成为「我提醒你一下」的礼貌施压套路。

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「我们清楚此事的紧迫性,会给予应有的重视。」
exercises.answer: We appreciate the urgency of the matter and will give it due care

exercises.prompt: 「Please find ___ the revised proposal.」(中文:「请查收附件中修订后的提案。」)
「I just wanted to circle back on…」 这一表达的微妙含义是什么?
options: 我第一次开启这个话题
我礼貌地回到我们之前讨论过的话题
exercises.answer: 我礼貌地回到我们之前讨论过的话题
exercises.explanation: 「circle back」 = 「绕回来」,职场邮件常用;中文直译「绕回去」不通顺,需整体理解为「再回到那个问题上」。

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「我会记下此事,下周再来跟进。」
exercises.answer: I will make a note to follow up on this next week

lessons.title: 对话:季度董事会汇报
lessons.description: 向持怀疑态度的董事会成员解释未达成的目标

exercises.prompt: 董事会会议 — 第三季度业绩未达标

turns.speaker: chair
turns.text: Let's get to it. Revenue came in eight percent below guidance — walk us through what happened.

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 正式开场:在承担责任的同时,选择一个用分裂句构建背景的表达
options: What we underestimated was the timing of the procurement freeze, not the underlying demand.
We didn't know that the procurement freeze would happen, so we missed it.
Basically the procurement freeze caught us with our pants down, that's the story.
turns.answer: What we underestimated was the timing of the procurement freeze, not the underlying demand.

turns.speaker: board
turns.text: Timing aside, the same risk surfaced last quarter. Why wasn't it priced into the forecast?

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 倒装强调(inversion)— 请补全助动词
turns.before: Granted, the signal was there, but
turns.after: we anticipate buyers consolidating orders this aggressively.

turns.speaker: chair
turns.text: And the proposed remediation? I'd like specifics, not aspirations.

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 请在正式语域中选择一个具体的承诺
options: We're going to, like, hustle harder on the pipeline next quarter, no worries.
We've recalibrated the pipeline coverage ratio to three-to-one and tied commercial bonuses to attainment.
Honestly, we'll just hope the macro turns around and pray for the best.
turns.answer: We've recalibrated the pipeline coverage ratio to three-to-one and tied commercial bonuses to attainment.

turns.speaker: board
turns.text: That addresses execution. What about exposure if the freeze persists into Q4?

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 正式条件状语 — 请填空
turns.after: , we have a contingency plan that protects roughly seventy percent of the gap.

turns.speaker: chair
turns.text: Useful. One last thing — how confident are you in the Q4 number you're now putting forward?

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: C1 模糊语 — 表达自信但不过度自负
options: I'm a hundred percent sure, no doubt about it whatsoever.
Honestly, who knows, it's anyone's guess at this point.
I'd characterise it as cautiously confident — the downside scenarios are now adequately hedged.
turns.answer: I'd characterise it as cautiously confident — the downside scenarios are now adequately hedged.

turns.speaker: chair
turns.text: Noted. We'll reconvene in six weeks for a mid-quarter check-in. Thank you.

turns.speaker: you
turns.text: Thank you. I'll circulate the updated forecast and remediation plan by close of business Friday.

topics.title: 学术英语
topics.description: 构建论证、引用来源、答辩论文

guide.intro: 学术英语将论断与证据绑定,使用模糊语,并倾向名词化表达。中文学术风格往往容许长句;而英语学术风格则偏好简洁清晰的句子、明确的论点和带有模糊语的阐释。

sections.text: 学者们不会直接说 「X is true」,而会写 「The data suggest that X may be the case」。这是一种礼貌的克制:数据可能改变,也存在其他解读。
学术英语偏爱把动词改写为名词:不说 「They decided to invest」,而说 「The decision to invest…」 或 「Their investment decision…」。这能使句子更紧凑,也使语气更客观。

rows.source: The findings suggest that climate policy may have unintended effects.
rows.translation: 研究结果表明,气候政策可能存在未曾预料的副作用。

rows.source: A growing body of evidence indicates that…
This study seeks to address that gap.
rows.translation: 本研究旨在填补这一空白。

sections.text: 学术写作中很少出现 「I think」,取而代之的是 「It is argued that」、「this paper contends that」。这相当于中文学术风格中用「认为」「学界普遍认为」来替代「我觉得」的偏好。

lessons.title: 模糊语与主张力度
lessons.description: 根据数据调整断言强度

exercises.prompt: 模糊语 — 中文释义
下列哪一句的主张语气最弱?
options: The data clearly show that X.
The data may suggest that X could occur.
exercises.answer: The data may suggest that X could occur.

exercises.prompt: 「A growing ___ of evidence indicates climate sensitivity.」(中文:「越来越多的证据表明气候敏感性。」)
请组合出这个句子:「本研究旨在填补这一空白。」
exercises.answer: This study seeks to address that gap
