exercises.prompt: 「It is argued that…」 是什么意思?
options: 有人主张……(刻意避开「我认为」)
exercises.answer: 有人主张……(刻意避开「我认为」)
exercises.explanation: 学术英语用被动 + 名词化避免主观「我」;中文学术写作里的「学界普遍认为」对应此用法。

exercises.prompt: 请选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: The findings appear to support our hypothesis.
options: The findings appear to support our hypothesis.
The findings appears to support our hypothesis.
The findings appear to supports our hypothesis.
The finding appear to support our hypotheses.
exercises.answer: The findings appear to support our hypothesis.

exercises.prompt: 「These results ___ that further investigation is warranted.」(中文:「这些结果表明,有必要进行进一步研究。」)
下列哪种形式属于学术文本中的名词化表达?
options: The decision to invest proved costly.
exercises.answer: The decision to invest proved costly.

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「数据表明,该假设无法被拒绝。」
exercises.answer: The data suggest that the hypothesis cannot be rejected

exercises.prompt: 「The phenomenon ___ to occur more frequently in summer.」(中文:「这一现象倾向于在夏季更频繁地出现。」)

lessons.title: 构建论文
lessons.description: 阐述、辩护、设定边界

exercises.prompt: 在学术论文中,「thesis statement」 是什么?
options: 作者所主张的核心论点
exercises.answer: 作者所主张的核心论点
exercises.explanation: 中文「论点」并非论文标题;「thesis statement」 特指引言段中作者亮明的核心主张。

exercises.prompt: 「This paper ___ that…」(中文:「本文主张:」)
论文常用句式 — 中文释义
请组合出这个句子:「本研究提出了一个新的理论框架。」
exercises.answer: This study proposes a novel theoretical framework

exercises.prompt: 「In contrast to prior literature, we find…」 用中文该怎么说?
options: 未与已有文献产生交集……
与已有文献相反,我们发现……
exercises.answer: 与已有文献相反,我们发现……
exercises.explanation: 「in contrast to」 = 「与……相反」,学术英语用于表明研究与前人立场不同;中文常用「相反/不同于」。

exercises.prompt: 请选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: Drawing on prior research, we extend the framework.
options: Drawing on prior research, we extend the framework.
Drawing in prior research, we extend the framework.
Drawing on priors research, we extends the framework.
Drawn on prior research, we extend the framework.
exercises.answer: Drawing on prior research, we extend the framework.

exercises.prompt: 「The findings have important ___ for policy.」(中文:「这些发现对政策具有重要的意义。」)
学术文本中使用 「we」 的情况如何?
options: 在部分学科中可被接受,在其他学科里倾向于使用被动语态。
exercises.answer: 在部分学科中可被接受,在其他学科里倾向于使用被动语态。
exercises.explanation: 中文学术写作回避「我」,英语在不同学科有不同惯例:理工科常用被动,人文社科可用 「we」。

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「研究结果表明,现有理论存在不足。」
exercises.answer: The findings indicate that existing theory falls short

exercises.prompt: 「The limitations of this study ___ as follows.」(中文:「本研究的局限性如下所述。」)

lessons.title: 数据讨论
lessons.description: 结论、阐释、局限

exercises.prompt: 数据相关句式 — 中文释义
「statistically significant」 用中文怎么说?
options: 在统计学上具有显著性
exercises.answer: 在统计学上具有显著性
exercises.explanation: 「significant」 在学术英语 ≠ 中文「重要的」;它专指「显著」(p < 0.05 等)。中文 L1 学习者常误以为「significant = important」。

exercises.prompt: 「As ___ in Table 2…」(中文:「如表 2 所示……」)
请组合出这个句子:「这一效应在不同性别之间相似。」
exercises.answer: The effect is similar across genders

exercises.prompt: 「a robust effect」 是什么意思?
options: 稳健的、在不同控制变量下都不消失的效应
exercises.answer: 稳健的、在不同控制变量下都不消失的效应
exercises.explanation: 「robust」 在中文里直译「强壮」会偏离意思;统计语境下指「稳健」,即结果在多种模型设定下都成立。

exercises.prompt: 请选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: The correlation is statistically significant at the one percent level.
options: The correlation is statistically significant at the one percent level.
The correlation is statically significant at the one percent level.
The correlation are statistically significant at the one percent level.
The correlations is statistically significant at the one percent levels.
exercises.answer: The correlation is statistically significant at the one percent level.

exercises.prompt: 「The sample is ___ relatively small.」(中文:「然而,样本量相对较小。」)
在结论部分,「These findings should be interpreted with caution」 是什么意思?
options: 这些发现是绝对确定的。
exercises.explanation: 学术模糊语标志:作者主动提醒读者注意结论的局限性。中文「请谨慎解读」是常见对应。

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「效应大小随时间推移而增大。」
exercises.answer: The effect size increases over time

exercises.prompt: 「Future research should ___ this question further.」(中文:「未来的研究应进一步探讨这一问题。」)

lessons.title: 学术综合 — 复习
lessons.description: 论文、模糊语与数据阐释

exercises.prompt: 「Notwithstanding these caveats, the results suggest…」 用中文怎么说?
options: 尽管存在这些保留意见,结果仍暗示……
由于这些保留意见,无任何结果。
这些保留意见很重要,故无结论。
这些保留意见已被驳回。
exercises.answer: 尽管存在这些保留意见,结果仍暗示……
exercises.explanation: 「caveat」 = 注意事项/保留意见(学术用词);「notwithstanding X」 = 「尽管 X」(正式)。

exercises.prompt: 「The results are robust ___ a number of specifications.」(中文:「在多种模型设定下,结果均稳健。」)
请组合出这个句子:「我们在本文中提出了一种新的机制。」
exercises.answer: In this paper we proposed a novel mechanism

exercises.prompt: 学术连接词 — 中文释义
请选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: The literature suggests that this effect is well-established.
options: The literature suggests that this effect is well-established.
The literature suggest that this effect is well established.
The literature suggests that this effects is well-established.
The literatures suggest that this effect is well-established.
exercises.answer: The literature suggests that this effect is well-established.

exercises.prompt: 下列哪一句包含主观个人主张?(在学术写作中通常需要回避)
options: I think we should reject the hypothesis.
The data appear to reject the hypothesis.
The hypothesis is rejected at the 1% level.
It is argued that the hypothesis can be rejected.
exercises.answer: I think we should reject the hypothesis.

exercises.prompt: 「Conversely, ___ found no such effect.」(中文:「相反,我们并未发现此类效应。」)
「thereby」 是什么意思?
exercises.explanation: 「thereby」 = 借此/由此(正式连接词);常用于学术写作连接因果。

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「这些发现以三种方式为相关文献做出贡献。」
exercises.answer: The findings contribute to the literature in three ways

exercises.prompt: 「The effect is statistically ___」(中文:「该效应在统计学上是显著的。」)

lessons.title: 文献综述模式
lessons.description: 引用先前研究、综合、识别空白

exercises.prompt: 在文献综述中,「X 研究者主张……」 最恰当的英文表达是什么?
exercises.explanation: 在学术引用中,通常会标注年份并使用 「argues / contends / posits」。

exercises.prompt: 「Smith (2021) ___ a similar conclusion in a different setting.」(中文:「Smith 在另一情境下得出类似结论。」)
exercises.explanation: 「reach a conclusion」 / 「draw a conclusion」 两种说法均可接受。

exercises.prompt: 引用动词 — 功能
请组合出这个句子:「现有文献对这一机制基本保持沉默。」
exercises.answer: The existing literature is largely silent on this mechanism

exercises.prompt: 「A growing body of research suggests that…」 这一句式的功能是什么?
options: 概述不断扩张的研究文献
exercises.answer: 概述不断扩张的研究文献
exercises.explanation: 「a growing body of research / evidence」 是学术综述常用句式;中文对应「越来越多的研究表明……」。

exercises.prompt: 请选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: While prior work has focused on outcomes, the underlying processes remain underexplored.
options: While prior work has focused on outcomes, the underlying processes remain underexplored.
While prior works have focused on outcomes, the underlying process remain underexplored.
While prior work has focused on outcomes, the underlying processes remains underexplored.
While prior work had focused on outcome, the underlying processes remain underexplored.
exercises.answer: While prior work has focused on outcomes, the underlying processes remain underexplored.

exercises.prompt: 「This study seeks to ___ that gap in the literature.」(中文:「本研究旨在填补文献中的这一空白。」)
下列哪一句是用来表明「理论框架」的?
options: We use Maslow's hierarchy as our theoretical lens.
We have a lot of stuff in mind.
We thought of stuff and went with it.
Maslow is famous, so we used it.
exercises.answer: We use Maslow's hierarchy as our theoretical lens.
exercises.explanation: 「Theoretical lens / framework」 是学术写作的固定表达。

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「研究结果在一定程度上反驳了先前的结论。」
exercises.answer: The findings partially refute earlier results

exercises.prompt: 「Recent scholarship has called this assumption into ___」(中文:「近期学界对这一假设提出了质疑。」)
exercises.explanation: 「call sth into question」 = 使……受到质疑。

exercises.prompt: 下列哪一句是反驳某研究者论点的最学术化表达?
options: However, Smith's account underestimates the role of context.
Smith doesn't know what he's talking about.
exercises.answer: However, Smith's account underestimates the role of context.

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「围绕该议题尚未形成共识。」
exercises.answer: No consensus has yet emerged on the subject

lessons.title: 摘要写作
lessons.description: 高度浓缩的信息:目的、方法、发现、结论

exercises.prompt: 一篇摘要(abstract)通常按怎样的顺序写就?
options: 结论 → 发现 → 方法 → 目的
目的 → 方法 → 发现 → 结论/建议
方法 → 目的 → 建议 → 讨论
讨论 → 引言 → 结论 → 方法
exercises.answer: 目的 → 方法 → 发现 → 结论/建议
exercises.explanation: 英语摘要遵守 IMRD 缩略顺序;中文学术摘要常更松散,但英语期刊要求严格。

exercises.prompt: 「This paper ___ the relationship between X and Y.」(中文:「本文研究 X 与 Y 之间的关系。」)
Abstract 部分 — 典型动词/表达
请组合出这个句子:「本研究采用了混合方法的研究路径。」
exercises.answer: This study adopts a mixed methods approach

exercises.prompt: 下列哪一句对于一篇 abstract 而言显得过于随意(informal)?
options: Our analysis reveals a robust association.
We sort of looked into how things turned out.
The findings suggest a moderating role of context.
exercises.answer: We sort of looked into how things turned out.
exercises.explanation: 「Sort of」 与 「turned out」 不符合摘要的语域要求。

exercises.prompt: 请选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: The findings have wider implications for policy and practice.
options: The findings have wider implications for policy and practice.
The finding have wider implication for policy and practice.
The findings has wider implications for policy and practice.
The findings have wider implication for policies and practice.
exercises.answer: The findings have wider implications for policy and practice.

exercises.prompt: 「Drawing ___ a sample of 240 firms, the analysis reveals…」(中文:「基于由 240 家公司组成的样本,分析揭示……」)
exercises.explanation: 「Drawing on / upon」 = 依据……。

exercises.prompt: 「The implications are twofold」 这一表达的含义是什么?
exercises.explanation: 「twofold / threefold / X-fold」 = 「分 X 个方面」,学术英语固定表达;中文「双重意义」是常见对应。

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「这些结果为因果性阐释提供了稳健的基础。」
exercises.answer: The results provide a robust basis for a causal interpretation

exercises.prompt: 「These findings ___ light on a long-standing debate.」(中文:「这些发现为一场长期存在的争论带来了启示。」)
exercises.explanation: 「shed/throw/cast light on」 = 阐明、揭示。

exercises.prompt: 在一篇 abstract 中,「we conclude that」 的更具模糊语色彩(更为谨慎)的替代表达是什么?
exercises.explanation: 在学术语言中,「tentatively suggest」 = 谨慎地提出。

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「这些结果应在考虑到样本较小的情况下加以解读。」
exercises.answer: The results should be interpreted with caution given the small sample

lessons.title: 对话:论文答辩中的方法论质询
lessons.description: 面对答辩委员会的提问,捍卫研究方法

exercises.prompt: 论文答辩 — 提问与回答环节

turns.speaker: chair
turns.text: We'll open the floor. Professor Demir, your first line of questioning, please.

turns.speaker: exam
turns.text: Your sample is overwhelmingly drawn from urban respondents. How do you defend the generalisability of your claims?

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 用学术模糊语承认局限,然后进行辩护
options: Yeah, that's a fair point, my sample is kind of weak there honestly.
I would readily concede the boundary, yet the patterns I identify hold across the urban strata I sampled, which I take pains to delimit in Chapter 4.
Generalisability isn't really my problem — the reader can decide.
turns.answer: I would readily concede the boundary, yet the patterns I identify hold across the urban strata I sampled, which I take pains to delimit in Chapter 4.

turns.speaker: exam
turns.text: Granted. But your coding scheme appears to collapse two analytically distinct constructs into one variable. Was that deliberate?

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 分裂句强调 — 请补全助动词
turns.after: precisely to avoid spurious distinctions in the pilot data that I merged them, and I document the decision rule in the appendix.

turns.speaker: exam
turns.text: Even so, you forgo the very contrast your literature review foregrounds. That strikes me as a methodological retreat.

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 在反驳时,请选择礼貌的学术立场
options: With respect, I'd push back on that characterisation: the contrast survives in the robustness checks in Section 5.3.
Yeah no, you're totally right, I shouldn't have done that.
That's not fair and you know it.
turns.answer: With respect, I'd push back on that characterisation: the contrast survives in the robustness checks in Section 5.3.

turns.speaker: exam
turns.text: Turning to your causal claim — the instrumental variable seems weak. Have you tested the exclusion restriction?

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 分词结构 — 请填入正确的动词形式
turns.after: the standard diagnostics, the instrument clears the conventional thresholds, though I flag the residual uncertainty in the discussion.

turns.speaker: exam
turns.text: One final question. If you were to revisit the design, what would you change?

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 请选择一种成熟的学术性自我反思
options: Nothing, the design is perfect as it stands.
Probably literally everything, it's a bit of a mess.
In hindsight, I would over-sample the rural strata and pre-register the coding scheme to forestall exactly the concerns you've raised.
turns.answer: In hindsight, I would over-sample the rural strata and pre-register the coding scheme to forestall exactly the concerns you've raised.

turns.speaker: chair
turns.text: Thank you. We'll move to the second examiner after a brief pause.

topics.title: 社会与政治
topics.description: 不平等、法律与公共辩论

guide.intro: 在社会议题的讨论中,词汇选择决定了政治语气。中文里的「国家」一词,在英语中可能对应 「state」、「government」 或 「public sector」,需视语境而定。C1 水平要求准确把握这些细微差别。

sections.text: 讨论社会议题时,既要立场鲜明,又要立场平衡:「There is a strong case for X, but…」、「On balance,…」、「It is widely acknowledged that…」。

rows.source: There is a strong case for reform.
rows.translation: 推行改革的理由非常充分。

rows.source: On balance, the policy has done more good than harm.
rows.translation: 总体而言,该政策利大于弊。

rows.source: It is widely acknowledged that the system is in need of overhaul.
rows.translation: 体系需要彻底改造这一点已被普遍接受。

sections.text: 英文 「liberal」 的含义因国而异:在美国偏左中,在英国偏中间偏中,在澳大利亚则是中右政党的名称。同一词汇带有截然不同的政治联想。

lessons.title: 国家、政府与机构
lessons.description: 选择正确的术语

exercises.prompt: 术语 — 中文释义
「public sector」 是什么?
exercises.explanation: 「public」 在政经语境中并非「公开的」,而是「公共/政府所属」;中文 L1 易混淆。

exercises.prompt: 「The ___ passed the bill last week.」(中文:「立法机关上周通过了该法案。」)
请组合出这个句子:「公民社会在此次改革中扮演了至关重要的角色。」
exercises.answer: Civil society played a critical role in this reform

exercises.prompt: 「policy」 和 「politics」 有什么区别?
options: policy:某一领域的具体方针;politics:整体的政治活动/权力博弈
exercises.answer: policy:某一领域的具体方针;politics:整体的政治活动/权力博弈
exercises.explanation: 中文「政治」涵盖两者;英语中 policy ≠ politics 是 C1 必须分清的关键区别。

exercises.prompt: 请选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: The judiciary remains independent in principle.
options: The judiciary remains independent in principle.
The judiciary remain independent in principle.
The judiciaries remains independent in principle.
The judiciary remained independent in principal.
exercises.answer: The judiciary remains independent in principle.

exercises.prompt: 「Voters in this ___ tend to favour reform.」(中文:「这一选区的选民倾向于支持改革。」)
下列哪一句呈现出中立的学术语气?
options: The damn government can't get anything right.
The government's policy choices have been mixed in their effects.
exercises.answer: The government's policy choices have been mixed in their effects.

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「政府颁布了一项新法律。」
exercises.answer: The government enacted a new law

exercises.prompt: 「The state has a ___ to protect citizens.」(中文:「国家有保护公民的义务。」)

lessons.title: 不平等讨论
lessons.description: 社会经济语言的细微差别

exercises.prompt: 术语 — 中文释义
「social mobility」 是什么?
options: 社会流动性(阶层之间的流动)
exercises.answer: 社会流动性(阶层之间的流动)
exercises.explanation: 「mobility」 此处 ≠ 「移动性」;指人在社会阶层间的上行/下行能力。中文「社会流动」是固定对应。

exercises.prompt: 「Income ___ has widened over the past decade.」(中文:「过去十年间,收入不平等不断加剧。」)
请组合出这个句子:「这一改革对最贫困群体产生了不成比例的影响。」
exercises.answer: The reform disproportionately affects the poorest

exercises.prompt: 「Disenfranchised」 是什么意思?
options: 权利被剥夺的 / 被排除的
exercises.answer: 权利被剥夺的 / 被排除的
exercises.explanation: 「dis- + franchise(选举权 / 特许权)」;中文「被剥夺权利的群体」是常见对应。注意中文 L1 易混淆 dis- / un- / non- 前缀。

exercises.prompt: 请选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: Marginalised groups face systemic barriers.

exercises.prompt: 「Closing the wage ___ remains a priority.」(中文:「缩小薪酬差距仍是当务之急。」)
「systemic」 一词强调的是什么?
options: 结构性 / 系统性问题
exercises.answer: 结构性 / 系统性问题
exercises.explanation: 「systemic」 ≠ 「systematic」(后者指方法上的系统化);中文「系统性的问题」是社政话语固定对应。

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「过去十年间贫困水平变化甚微。」
exercises.answer: Poverty levels have changed little over the past decade

exercises.prompt: 「The proposal aims to ___ structural barriers.」(中文:「该提案旨在拆除结构性障碍。」)

lessons.title: 公共辩论
lessons.description: 权利、责任与平衡

exercises.prompt: 「On balance, the policy has done more good than harm」 用中文怎么说?
options: 总体而言,这项政策利大于弊。
在平衡之中,这项政策是坏的。
exercises.answer: 总体而言,这项政策利大于弊。
exercises.explanation: 「on balance」 = 「权衡之下/综合而言」,是 C1 公共话语的高频表达;中文 L1 易直译为「在平衡上」。

exercises.prompt: 「There is a strong ___ for reform.」(中文:「推行改革有充分的理由。」)
议题讨论句式 — 中文释义
请组合出这个句子:「人们普遍承认这一体系需要彻底改造。」
exercises.answer: It is widely acknowledged that the system needs an overhaul

exercises.prompt: 请选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: Critics argue that the policy is short-sighted.
options: Critics argue that the policy is short-sighted.
Critic argue that the policy is short-sighted.
Critics argues that the policies are short-sighted.
Critic arguing that the policy is short-sighted.
exercises.answer: Critics argue that the policy is short-sighted.

exercises.prompt: 「short-sighted」 用中文怎么说?
options: 目光短浅 / 鼠目寸光
exercises.answer: 目光短浅 / 鼠目寸光
exercises.explanation: 字面是「短视」,在政经话语中固定指「缺乏远见」;中文「目光短浅」最贴切。

exercises.prompt: 「Proponents ___ that the law protects vulnerable groups.」(中文:「支持者主张该法律保护了脆弱群体。」)
「On the face of it」 是什么意思?
exercises.explanation: 中文 L1 直译「在脸面上」会错;习语整体记忆为「表面上,初看」。

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「这场讨论涉及多种细腻的视角。」
exercises.answer: The debate involves multiple nuanced perspectives

exercises.prompt: 「A more ___ approach is required.」(中文:「需要一种更具细腻度的处理方式。」)

lessons.title: 不平等与政策语言
lessons.description: 讨论结构性不平等所用的正式语域

exercises.prompt: 政策术语 — 中文释义

pairs.right: 对低收入群体冲击不成比例的税种

exercises.prompt: 「A regressive tax」 是什么意思?
options: 对低收入者造成不成比例负担的税
exercises.answer: 对低收入者造成不成比例负担的税
exercises.explanation: 「regressive」 = 累退的(税法专用),意指越穷的人承担比例越高;中文「累退税」是固定对应。

exercises.prompt: 「The reform risks ___ existing disparities.」(中文:「该改革有加深现有不平等的风险。」)
exercises.explanation: 「entrench」 = 使固化;「entrench inequality」 是常见搭配。

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「研究结果提供了反驳主流叙事的证据。」
exercises.answer: The findings offer evidence that undermines the prevailing narrative

exercises.prompt: 如何简洁地解释 「The policy disproportionately affects low-income households」?
options: 该政策对低收入家庭造成不成比例的影响
该政策对所有家庭影响相同
该政策影响的是高收入者
exercises.answer: 该政策对低收入家庭造成不成比例的影响
exercises.explanation: 「disproportionately」 是政经话语高频副词;中文「不成比例地 / 尤为严重地」是常见对应。

exercises.prompt: 请选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: Far from levelling the playing field, the reform may compound existing inequities.
options: Far from levelling the playing field, the reform may compound existing inequities.
Far from levelling the playing fields, the reform may compounded existing inequities.
Far from levelling the playing field, the reform may compound existing inequity.
Far from levelled the playing field, the reform may compound existing inequities.
exercises.answer: Far from levelling the playing field, the reform may compound existing inequities.

exercises.prompt: 「The wealth ___ has widened in the past two decades.」(中文:「过去二十年间,财富鸿沟不断扩大。」)
下列哪一句保持了中立的学术语气?
options: Rich people are robbing the poor.
Distributional outcomes have shifted markedly upward.
exercises.answer: Distributional outcomes have shifted markedly upward.
exercises.explanation: 在学术性政治话语中,「distributional outcomes」 是中性表达。

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「政策讨论倾向于关注表象,而非结构性原因。」
exercises.answer: Policy debate tends to focus on symptoms rather than structural causes

exercises.prompt: 「Means-___ benefits target the most vulnerable.」(中文:「与收入审查挂钩的福利针对最脆弱的群体。」)
exercises.explanation: 「Means-tested benefits」 = 以收入审查为条件的福利。

exercises.prompt: 在批评性文章中,「Trickle-down economics」 通常如何被引用?
options: 字面意义的「滴水经济学」
假设上层财富会「滴落」到下层的经济学(常被批评)
一种当代的凯恩斯主义模型
exercises.answer: 假设上层财富会「滴落」到下层的经济学(常被批评)
exercises.explanation: 「trickle down」 是隐喻型政策术语;中文常译「涓滴经济学」,批评者认为其假设是空想。

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「对特定群体产生不成比例影响的措施,需要特别的正当性论证。」
exercises.answer: Measures that disproportionately affect specific groups require particular justification

lessons.title: 公共话语策略
lessons.description: 框定议题、使用模糊语、有分寸的反对

exercises.prompt: 「It is often claimed that…」 这一表达的功能是什么?
options: 把流行观点框定出来,以便随后保持距离 / 加以反驳
exercises.answer: 把流行观点框定出来,以便随后保持距离 / 加以反驳
exercises.explanation: 「is claimed that」 = 「有人声称」,作者并不背书;此为公共话语中先框定后反驳的固定策略。

exercises.prompt: 「The argument is, at ___, incomplete.」(中文:「这一论证充其量是不完整的。」)
exercises.explanation: 「at best」 = 充其量(用于在话语中拉开距离)。

exercises.prompt: 话语策略 — 功能
请组合出这个句子:「该论证虽有可取之处,但证据基础较为薄弱。」
exercises.answer: While the argument has merit its evidentiary basis is thin

exercises.prompt: 「On closer inspection」 这一表达暗示了什么?
exercises.explanation: 中文「细究之下」是常见对应;C1 公共话语中常用此句式做让步后转向。

exercises.prompt: 请选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: Granted, the data are imperfect; that said, the trend is unmistakable.
options: Granted, the data are imperfect; that said, the trend is unmistakable.
Granted, the data is imperfect; that said, the trend is unmistakable.
Granted, the data are imperfected; that said, the trend is unmistakable.
Granted, the data are imperfect, that said, the trend is mistakable.
exercises.answer: Granted, the data are imperfect; that said, the trend is unmistakable.
exercises.explanation: 在学术英语中,「data」 作复数使用。

exercises.prompt: 「The claim is, to ___ a phrase, only half the story.」(中文:「借用一句话来说,这一说法只讲了故事的一半。」)
exercises.explanation: 「to borrow a phrase」 是固定表达。

exercises.prompt: 下列哪一句体现了「让步后反驳」(concede-and-rebut)的话语策略?
options: While there is some truth to that, it overlooks the broader pattern.
exercises.answer: While there is some truth to that, it overlooks the broader pattern.

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「关键在于我们错误地将这一问题归入了某一类别。」
exercises.answer: What matters is that we have miscategorised the problem

exercises.prompt: 「The data, ___ imperfect, point in the same direction.」(中文:「数据尽管并不完美,但都指向同一方向。」)
exercises.explanation: 「though imperfect」 = 尽管有瑕疵。

exercises.prompt: 下列哪一项体现了「框定议题」(framing)?
options: 用特定视角呈现某一议题
exercises.answer: 用特定视角呈现某一议题
exercises.explanation: 「framing」 是政治学/传媒学固定术语;中文「议题框定」是学术对应。

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「仔细阅读后,可以看出证据其实指向相反的结论。」
exercises.answer: On a careful reading the evidence says the opposite

lessons.title: 对话:关于不平等的市政厅会议
lessons.description: 在公开听证会上讨论公共政策

exercises.prompt: 市政厅 — 关于本地不平等问题的政策讨论

turns.speaker: mayor
turns.text: Tonight's agenda is the housing affordability gap in our district. The floor is open.

turns.speaker: res
turns.text: Rents have outpaced wages for a decade, and the council keeps recycling the same talking points. When do we see policy?

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 正式发言:用分裂句转移重音
options: It's not the diagnosis that's missing, it's the political will to ring-fence funding for genuinely affordable units.
Yeah everything's bad, I dunno what to tell you honestly.
Look, the rich people are the problem, period, end of story.
turns.answer: It's not the diagnosis that's missing, it's the political will to ring-fence funding for genuinely affordable units.

turns.speaker: mayor
turns.text: Ring-fencing is one mechanism. Others have argued for inclusionary zoning. Where would you come down?

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 正式让步状语 — 请填空
turns.after: inclusionary zoning has a mixed evidence base, I'd still prioritise it over deregulation, which historically benefits incumbents.

turns.speaker: res
turns.text: Easy for someone with a salary to say. What about families being priced out right now?

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 尊重对方但立场清晰的反驳
options: Whatever, that's not my problem honestly.
Point taken — and that's precisely why any zoning reform must be paired with emergency rental assistance, not promised in lieu of it.
Calm down, it's just a discussion.
turns.answer: Point taken — and that's precisely why any zoning reform must be paired with emergency rental assistance, not promised in lieu of it.

turns.speaker: mayor
turns.text: The fiscal envelope is finite. If we fund rental assistance, something else gives. What would you cut?

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 倒装结构 — 请补全助动词
turns.before: Only by ring-fencing the vacancy tax revenue
turns.after: we avoid raiding the education line — which I take as politically off-limits.

turns.speaker: res
turns.text: And the developers? They'll lawyer their way out of any obligation, the way they always have.

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 建设性的结尾:承认局限,同时提出机制方案
options: Enforcement is the achilles heel of every such scheme — which is why the ordinance should attach forfeiture clauses, not merely fines.
turns.answer: Enforcement is the achilles heel of every such scheme — which is why the ordinance should attach forfeiture clauses, not merely fines.

turns.speaker: mayor
turns.text: Thank you. I'll table a working draft incorporating tonight's points at the next session.

topics.title: 习语与搭配
topics.description: 让你说得地道的习语储备

guide.intro: 习语是任何语言的心脏。C1 水平要求熟记 「cut to the chase」、「on the back burner」 这类习语。将中文习语直译过去往往是危险的:「小题大做」对应英文的 「make a mountain out of a molehill」 或 「blow it out of proportion」,而不是字面直译。

sections.text: 商务场景中流行的习语

rows: 关键问题 / 最终结论
off the top of my head

sections.text: 从中文到英语切换时,直接翻译习语是危险的做法。在断言「英语里有对应说法」之前,先查证一下。

rows.source: Don't make a mountain out of a molehill.
rows.translation: 别小题大做。(英语字面是「别把鼹鼠丘当成山」。)

rows.source: It's the elephant in the room.
rows.translation: 人人心知肚明却避而不谈的大问题。

rows.source: We need to bite the bullet.
rows.translation: 我们必须硬着头皮接受现实。

sections.text: 警惕「直译」习语的陷阱:中文「念叨个没完」在英语里并不是 「iron the head」,而是 「talk someone's ear off」 或 「drone on」。不要直译,要去寻找等效表达。

lessons.title: 职场习语
lessons.description: 会议语言的隐藏词典

exercises.prompt: 习语 — 中文释义
「Let's cut to the chase」 是什么意思?
options: 别绕弯子,我们直奔主题吧
exercises.answer: 别绕弯子,我们直奔主题吧
exercises.explanation: 源自电影术语「跳到追逐戏」;现已固定为「直奔要点」。中文「直奔主题」是最佳对应,不可字面翻译。

exercises.prompt: 「That project is ___ the back burner for now.」(中文:「那个项目目前先搁置一下。」)
请组合出这个句子:「我们从去年起就一直在提高标准。」
exercises.answer: We've raised the bar since last year

exercises.prompt: 「touch base with someone」 是什么意思?
exercises.explanation: 源自棒球术语;中文「碰个头 / 联络一下」是 idiom 对应。不可字面翻译为「触底」。

exercises.prompt: 请选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: Let's touch base after the meeting.
options: Let's touch base after the meeting.
Let's touched base after the meeting.
Let's touch the base after the meeting.
Let's touched bases after the meeting.
exercises.answer: Let's touch base after the meeting.

exercises.prompt: 「The ___ line is, we need to ship by Friday.」(中文:「关键是,我们必须在周五之前交付。」)
「off the top of my head」 是什么意思?
options: 随口一说 / 凭印象估计
exercises.answer: 随口一说 / 凭印象估计
exercises.explanation: 习语整体记忆;不可字面理解。中文「凭印象 / 大致估计」是常见对应。

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「在这件事上,我们都同舟共济。」
exercises.answer: We're all in the same boat on this

exercises.prompt: 「Off the ___ of my head, I'd say twenty thousand.」(中文:「凭脑子粗略估,我会说两万。」)
「We need a ballpark figure」 是什么意思?
options: 我们要个体育场里的数字。
我们需要一个大概的数字。
我们要个加起来的总数。
exercises.answer: 我们需要一个大概的数字。
exercises.explanation: 「ballpark」 源自棒球场的比喻;「ballpark figure」 = 「估计 / 粗略数字」。中文 L1 易直译为「球场数字」。

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「我们别绕弯子,直奔主题吧。」

lessons.title: 经典习语储备
lessons.description: 日常语言中色彩鲜明的习语

exercises.prompt: 习语 — 中文对应说法

pairs.left: make a mountain out of a molehill

pairs.right: 人人心知肚明却避而不谈的大问题

exercises.prompt: 「You're pulling my leg!」 是什么意思?
exercises.explanation: 经典习语;字面是「拉我的腿」,实义为「逗我玩」。中文 L1 必须整体记忆,不可拆解。

exercises.prompt: 「Don't make a ___ out of a molehill.」(中文:「别小题大做。」)
请组合出这个句子:「我们就咬牙接受这个事实吧。」
「the elephant in the room」 是什么意思?
options: 房间里大象造型的装饰
所有人都心知肚明却避而不谈的大问题
exercises.answer: 所有人都心知肚明却避而不谈的大问题
exercises.explanation: 经典习语;中文里没有直接对应,但「心照不宣的问题」或「公开的秘密」是常用对应。

exercises.prompt: 请选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: We need to address the elephant in the room.
options: We need to address the elephant in the room.
We need to addressed the elephant in the room.
We need to address the elephants in the room.
We need to addresses the elephant in the rooms.
exercises.answer: We need to address the elephant in the room.

exercises.prompt: 「I had to bite the ___ and tell the truth.」(中文:「我只好硬着头皮说出真相。」)
「小题大做」 用英语怎么说?
options: make a mountain out of a molehill
kill a flea with a hammer
exercises.answer: make a mountain out of a molehill

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「我们来谈谈那个大家都避而不谈的大问题吧。」
exercises.answer: Let's talk about the elephant in the room

exercises.prompt: 「Stop pulling my ___」(中文:「别再拿我开玩笑了。」)

lessons.title: 假朋友(false friends)
lessons.description: 中文里容易混淆的陷阱

exercises.prompt: 英语 — 中文真实含义

pairs.right: 富有同情心的、能体谅的

exercises.prompt: 「sympathetic」 等同于中文里的「招人喜欢/讨喜」吗?
options: 不 ——「sympathetic」=「富有同情心 / 能体谅的」;若想表达「讨喜」请用 'likeable / charming'。
是的,但只用于文学语言。
exercises.answer: 不 ——「sympathetic」=「富有同情心 / 能体谅的」;若想表达「讨喜」请用 'likeable / charming'。
exercises.explanation: 假朋友:中文 L1 易因发音相近而误用;请记住 「sympathetic」 ≠ 「讨喜的」。

exercises.prompt: 「I read an interesting article in a science ___.」(中文:「我在一本科学期刊上读到一篇有趣的文章。」)
exercises.explanation: 假朋友!中文里说的「八卦杂志」对应英文的 gossip magazine;但英文 「magazine」 泛指任何期刊杂志。

exercises.prompt: 「sensible」 在英语中是什么意思?
exercises.explanation: 假朋友:中文 L1 常将 sensible 与 sensitive 混淆。「sensible」 = 「明智的」;「sensitive」 = 「敏感的」。

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「没确认之前不要发言。」
请选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: Could you please check the figures one more time?
options: Could you please check the figures one more time?
Could you please control the figures one more time?
Could you please checks the figures one more times?
Could you please check the figure one more time?
exercises.answer: Could you please check the figures one more time?

exercises.prompt: 「This is a ___ topic; he gets upset easily.」(中文:「这是个敏感话题,他容易因此心烦。」)
「realize」 在英语中是什么意思?
options: 既指「意识到、察觉到」,也指「实现某项目」
exercises.answer: 既指「意识到、察觉到」,也指「实现某项目」
exercises.explanation: 中文 L1 通常只熟悉「实现」一义,但 「realize」 的常用义反而是「意识到」。「I realized my mistake」 = 「我意识到了我的错误」。

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「我最终意识到了自己的错误。」
「The ___ cost was much higher than estimated.」(中文:「实际成本远高于预估。」)

lessons.title: 搭配训练
lessons.description: 自然的词组搭配

exercises.prompt: 搭配(collocation)— 中文释义
该用 「do」 还是 「make」?—— 表达「做决定」
exercises.explanation: 英语习惯说 「make a decision」;在英式英语中 「take a decision」 也可接受。

exercises.prompt: 「I need to ___ a phone call.」(中文:「我需要打个电话。」)
请组合出这个句子:「我们愿意承担这一风险。」
exercises.answer: We are willing to take the risk

exercises.prompt: 下列哪个搭配是错误的?
exercises.explanation: 正确说法是 「make progress」。

exercises.prompt: 请选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: We've made significant progress this quarter.
options: We've made significant progress this quarter.
We've done significant progress this quarter.
We've make significant progress this quarter.
We've made significant progresses this quarters.
exercises.answer: We've made significant progress this quarter.

exercises.prompt: 「Please ___ the law.」(中文:「请遵守法律。」)
该用 「do」 还是 「make」?—— 表达「制造噪音」
请组合出这个句子:「考试前深深地吸一口气。」
exercises.answer: Take a deep breath before the exam

exercises.prompt: 「She made a strong ___ in her speech.」(中文:「她的讲话给人留下了深刻的印象。」)

lessons.title: 商务习语(第二轮)
lessons.description: 会议与战略语言中固化的表达

exercises.prompt: 习语 — 中文释义

pairs.right: 试图一口吞下所有问题

exercises.prompt: 「I don't have the bandwidth this week」 是什么意思?
options: 本周我没有时间 / 精力
exercises.answer: 本周我没有时间 / 精力
exercises.explanation: 源自电信术语,现代职场英语中固定为「个人工作精力 / 容量」;中文「我这周没带宽」是错误的字面翻译。

exercises.prompt: 「Let's not boil the ___; let's start small.」(中文:「我们别试图一口吞下所有问题,先小步开始。」)
请组合出这个句子:「这个数字真有可能让收入指针明显移动。」
exercises.answer: This figure could really move the needle on revenue

exercises.prompt: 「We're spread thin」 这一表达的含义是什么?
options: 我们的资源分散过度 / 不足
exercises.answer: 我们的资源分散过度 / 不足
exercises.explanation: 字面是「摊得太薄」;习语义为「人/资源分配过散,无法兼顾」。中文「人手不够 / 摊子铺得太大」是常见对应。

exercises.prompt: 请选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: Let's circle back on that once we have more clarity.
options: Let's circle back on that once we have more clarity.
Let's circle backed on that once we have more clarity.
Let's circle back on that once we had more clarity.
Let circle back on that once we have more clarity.
exercises.answer: Let's circle back on that once we have more clarity.

exercises.prompt: 「That decision is above my pay ___.」(中文:「这个决定超出了我的职权范围。」)
在会议上,「Let's take this offline」 是什么意思?
options: 我们另找时间单独讨论
exercises.answer: 我们另找时间单独讨论
exercises.explanation: 中文 L1 易理解为「离线」;但在职场语境是「散会后单独谈」。

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「这个决定超出我的职权,我们把它上升到更高层级。」
exercises.answer: This decision is above my pay grade let's escalate it

exercises.prompt: 「We need to get all our ducks in a ___ before the launch.」(中文:「发布之前我们必须把每件事都安排妥当。」)
「It's not a hill I'm willing to die on」 是什么意思?
options: 这件事我不会死磕到底
exercises.answer: 这件事我不会死磕到底
exercises.explanation: 军事隐喻;意为「这不是值得我拼到底的争议」。中文「我不会为此较真到底 / 这不是我的硬底线」是常见对应。

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「先摘容易摘的果实,再去处理难题。」
exercises.answer: Let's pick the low-hanging fruit first then tackle the hard problems

lessons.title: 假朋友(第二轮)与语域陷阱
lessons.description: 中文使用者容易忽略的细微差别

exercises.prompt: 容易混淆的词对 — 正确用法

pairs.right: 能体谅的(不是「招人喜欢的」)

exercises.prompt: 「I am actually going to the meeting」 是什么意思?
exercises.explanation: 假朋友:中文 L1 (尤其受 Romance 语言影响的二外学习者)易把 「actually」 当作「现在」(actualmente)。英语 「actually」 = 「其实 / 事实上」。

exercises.prompt: 「She is a very ___ person; she rarely overreacts.」(中文:「她是个非常明智的人,很少反应过度。」)
exercises.explanation: 「sensible」 = 明智的;「sensitive」 = 敏感的。

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「其实我们多年前就该解决这件事了。」
exercises.answer: Actually we should have solved this years ago

exercises.prompt: 「Eventually we agreed」 用中文怎么翻译?
exercises.explanation: 假朋友:「eventually」 ≠ 「最终也许、可能」;它等于「最终、终究」(指经过一段过程之后)。

exercises.prompt: 请选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: I am sympathetic to your concern, but the policy stands.
options: I am sympathetic to your concern, but the policy stands.
I am sympathic to your concern, but the policy stand.
I am sympathetic to your concerns, but the policy stand.
I'm sympathetic to your concern, but the policies stands.
exercises.answer: I am sympathetic to your concern, but the policy stands.

exercises.prompt: 「The proposal is ___(意为可被辩护的),if not optimal.」(中文:「这一提议即便不是最优方案,也是可以被辩护的。」)
下列哪种描述准确?「I would like to invite you to please reply at your earliest convenience.」
options: 过于冗赘正式;「I would appreciate a reply at your earliest convenience」 更顺
exercises.answer: 过于冗赘正式;「I would appreciate a reply at your earliest convenience」 更顺
exercises.explanation: C1 写作的细微点:中文 L1 容易堆砌礼貌副词,导致英语句子叠床架屋。「I would like to invite ... to please reply」 是冗赘组合,本族语者不这么说。

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「我们应当寻找用更少词语表达同样意思的方式。」
exercises.answer: We should look for a way to say the same thing in fewer words

exercises.prompt: 「I'd like to ___(意为礼貌地表示反对)on that timeline.」(中文:「我想对这一时间表礼貌地提出异议。」)
在商务语境中,「I'm comfortable with that」 最准确的含义是什么?
options: 这让我身体上感到舒适
我可以接受 / 我没有异议
exercises.answer: 我可以接受 / 我没有异议
exercises.explanation: 商务语境中 「comfortable with」 = 「接受 / 同意」,不是身体感受。中文 L1 易直译为「我感觉舒服」。

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「最后,我想就定价方面再提一点异议。」
exercises.answer: Finally I would like to push back on the pricing at one point

lessons.title: 对话:商务社交场合中的习语化交流
lessons.description: 与行业高管进行习语密集的寒暄

exercises.prompt: 行业大会酒会时段

turns.speaker: exec
turns.text: Quite the turnout this year. Half the panels were preaching to the choir, if I'm honest.

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 习语用得对吗?请选出正确的回答
options: Couldn't agree more — and the keynote felt like it was hedging its bets right up to the closing line.
Yeah the keynote was hedging the bet so big.
Couldn't more agree — the keynote was on fire of pants.
turns.answer: Couldn't agree more — and the keynote felt like it was hedging its bets right up to the closing line.

turns.speaker: vc
turns.text: Speaking of fence-sitters, what's your read on the regulation? Are people actually going to move, or is this all hot air?

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 习语 — 在空白处填入正确的动词
turns.after: their cards close to their chest, but the early movers I've spoken to are quietly reallocating budget.

turns.speaker: exec
turns.text: Reallocation is one thing — execution is another beast entirely. Half of these initiatives die on the vine.

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 选出符合 C1 水准的、紧扣习语语境的回答
options: Tell me about it — by the time procurement signs off, the window of opportunity has well and truly closed.
Tell me of it — when procurement signs, the window of chance is closing.
Tell me about it — by the time procurement signs off, the window of opportunity has totally yeeted itself.
turns.answer: Tell me about it — by the time procurement signs off, the window of opportunity has well and truly closed.

turns.speaker: vc
turns.text: So where are you placing your bets? Or is it too early in the evening for that conversation?

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 习语 — 在空白处填入正确的动词
turns.before: Let's just say I'm keeping my powder
turns.after: until the next funding cycle clarifies the field.

turns.speaker: exec
turns.text: Wise. The last cohort of pre-emptive bets aged badly. A lot of egos got bruised.

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 请选出语域合适的习语
options: True — though one or two of them turned out to be horses for courses; the timing just wasn't on their side.
True — those guys ate dirt big time, classic L.
True — they totally face-planted, you love to see it.
turns.answer: True — though one or two of them turned out to be horses for courses; the timing just wasn't on their side.

turns.speaker: vc
turns.text: Anyway, I should make the rounds before the bar runs dry. Let's pick this up over coffee next week.

turns.speaker: you
turns.text: Sounds good — I'll drop you a line in the morning to lock in a time.

topics.title: 高级语法:倒装与分裂句
topics.description: 用于强调的结构性工具

guide.intro: 在 C1 阶段,用不同的结构传达相同信息是制造重音的关键手段。倒装(inversion)、分裂句(cleft sentences)和前置(fronting)都是 C1 的标志性手法。

sections.text: 当否定或限制性副词位于句首时,主语与助动词需要调换位置:「Rarely have I seen such talent」、「Not only did he refuse, he also walked out」。
It-分裂句(It is X who/that…)与 What-分裂句(What I need is…)用于突出特定成分:「It was John who broke the vase」(打碎花瓶的是 John),「What I want is silence」(我想要的是安静)。

rows.source: It was Sarah who first noticed the error.
rows.translation: 最先注意到这一错误的人是 Sarah。

rows.source: What surprises me most is his silence.
rows.translation: 最让我惊讶的是他的沉默。

rows.source: Rarely have we encountered such resistance.
rows.translation: 我们很少遇到这样的抗拒。

rows.source: Not only is the policy ineffective, it is also costly.
rows.translation: 该政策不仅无效,而且代价高昂。

sections.text: 倒装多用于正式写作和演说;在日常对话中显得做作。你会在学术文章和新闻文本里经常见到。

lessons.title: 否定倒装
lessons.description: 句首的否定副词

exercises.prompt: 「我这辈子很少见过这样的才华」用正式的倒装句怎么表达?
options: I have rarely seen such talent in my life.
Rarely have I seen such talent in my life.
Rarely I have seen such talent in my life.
Rarely seen I such talent in my life.
exercises.answer: Rarely have I seen such talent in my life.

exercises.prompt: 「Never before ___ I felt such pressure.」(中文:「我此前从未感受过这样的压力。」)
请组合出这个句子:「他不仅拒绝,还离开了房间。」
exercises.answer: Not only did he refuse but he also walked out

exercises.prompt: 开头 — 含义
下列哪一句是正确的倒装句?
options: Hardly I had arrived when the storm broke.
Hardly had I arrived when the storm broke.
Hardly had I arrive when the storm broke.
Hardly I arrived when the storm broke.
exercises.answer: Hardly had I arrived when the storm broke.

exercises.prompt: 请选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: Under no circumstances should you reveal the source.
options: Under no circumstances should you reveal the source.
Under no circumstance should you reveal the source.
Under no circumstances should you revealed the source.
Under no circumstances you should reveal the source.
exercises.answer: Under no circumstances should you reveal the source.

exercises.prompt: 「No sooner ___ I sat down than the phone rang.」(中文:「我刚坐下电话就响了。」)
倒装属于哪种语域?
exercises.explanation: 倒装句多见于学术写作、新闻评论、正式演说;若用于日常对话会显得做作。

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「在任何情况下都不应让门保持敞开。」
exercises.answer: Under no circumstances should the door be left open

exercises.prompt: 「Little ___ they realise the danger.」(中文:「他们对那危险几乎毫无察觉。」)
exercises.explanation: 「Little did they realise」 是惯用的倒装表达。

lessons.title: 分裂句
lessons.description: It-分裂句与 What-分裂句

exercises.prompt: 「最先注意到错误的是 Sarah」 用英语怎么说?
options: It was Sarah who first noticed the error.
exercises.answer: It was Sarah who first noticed the error.

exercises.prompt: 「___ surprises me most is his silence.」(中文:「最让我惊讶的是他的沉默。」)
请组合出这个句子:「我真正需要的是时间。」
exercises.answer: What I really need is time

exercises.prompt: 分裂句结构 — 强调重心
「It was in 2008 that the crisis hit」 用中文怎么翻译?
options: 正是在 2008 年危机才爆发。
exercises.answer: 正是在 2008 年危机才爆发。
exercises.explanation: It-cleft 把重音放在时间上,对应中文「正是 / 就是……才……」的「是……的」结构。

exercises.prompt: 请选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: What concerns me most is the lack of transparency.
options: What concerns me most is the lack of transparency.
What concern me most is the lack of transparency.
What concerns me most is the lacks of transparency.
What concerns me most is the lack of transparencies.
exercises.answer: What concerns me most is the lack of transparency.

exercises.prompt: 「It is the patient ___ deserves our attention.」(中文:「最值得我们关注的是病人。」)
「All I want is honesty」 用中文怎么说?
options: 我唯一想要的就是诚实。
exercises.answer: 我唯一想要的就是诚实。
exercises.explanation: 「All + 主语 + 动词 + is X」 = 「我所……的只是 X」;伪分裂句结构,强调「唯一」。

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「做出决定的是委员会,而不是某个个人。」
exercises.answer: It was the committee that made the decision not an individual

exercises.prompt: 「It was ___ here that we first met.」(中文:「我们当年正是在这里第一次相遇。」)

lessons.title: 分词从句
lessons.description: 用 -ing 和 -ed 构成的简短分句

exercises.prompt: 「她结束会议后离开了办公室」 用分词结构应该怎么写?
options: Finishing the meeting, she left the office.
Having finished the meeting, she left the office.
She finished meeting and left office.
exercises.answer: Having finished the meeting, she left the office.

exercises.prompt: 「___ in haste, the report contained errors.」(中文:「这份报告因写得仓促,含有错误。」)
请组合出这个句子:「她因为感到疲倦,早早就上床睡觉了。」
exercises.answer: Feeling tired she went to bed early

exercises.prompt: 结构 — 含义
「Approved by the board, the plan went ahead」 用中文怎么说?
options: 因被董事会批准,该方案得以推进。
exercises.answer: 因被董事会批准,该方案得以推进。
exercises.explanation: 「Approved by X, NP did Y」 是被动分词作状语;中文 L1 容易把这种简化关系从句当作完整主句来译,导致语义错乱。

exercises.prompt: 请选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: Having reviewed the data, she drew her conclusions.
options: Having reviewed the data, she drew her conclusions.
Having review the data, she drew her conclusions.
Have reviewed the data, she drew her conclusions.
Having reviewed the data, she draw her conclusions.
exercises.answer: Having reviewed the data, she drew her conclusions.

exercises.prompt: 「___ at the airport, we headed to the hotel.」(中文:「到达机场之后,我们前往了酒店。」)
下列哪个分词结构是错误的?
options: Walking down the street, I saw an old friend.
Walked down the street, I saw an old friend.
Having walked down the street, I saw an old friend.
Being tired, I went to bed early.
exercises.answer: Walked down the street, I saw an old friend.
exercises.explanation: 表达主动含义时需用 「-ing」。

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「这一被董事会审阅过的方案已获批准。」
exercises.answer: Reviewed by the board the plan was approved

exercises.prompt: 「___ ignored, the problem grew worse.」(中文:「问题在被忽视的过程中变得更加严重。」)

lessons.title: 分裂句与前置
lessons.description: 有意识地放置重音

exercises.prompt: 「It was the price that worried us」 是一个 ___ 句子。
exercises.explanation: 「It is/was X that…」 即为 it-分裂句结构。

exercises.prompt: 「___ I really want is a clear timeline.」(中文:「我真正想要的是一份清晰的时间表。」)(wh-cleft)
exercises.explanation: Wh-分裂句:「What I want is X.」

exercises.prompt: 结构 — 例句

pairs.right: It was John who solved it.
What we need is more time.
Never have I seen such a thing.
It is essential that he attend.

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「我们真正需要的是一份更清晰的简报。」
exercises.answer: What we really need is a clearer brief

exercises.prompt: 「Never have I encountered such resistance」 属于什么结构?
exercises.explanation: 当否定副词(never/rarely/seldom/hardly)位于句首时,主谓需倒装(助动词在主语前)。中文 L1 易遗漏这种助动词倒装。

exercises.prompt: 请选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: Not until the audit was completed did we grasp the full picture.
options: Not until the audit was completed did we grasp the full picture.
Not until the audit was completed we grasped the full picture.
Not until the audit was completed did we grasped the full picture.
Not until the audits were completed do we grasp the full picture.
exercises.answer: Not until the audit was completed did we grasp the full picture.

exercises.prompt: 「It ___ not until 2020 that we noticed the trend.」(中文:「直到 2020 年我们才注意到这一趋势。」)(it-cleft)
下列哪一句是正确的前置(fronting)示例?
options: Rarely have we seen such growth.
Rarely we have seen such growth.
We rarely have seen such growth, however.
Have rarely we seen such growth.
exercises.answer: Rarely have we seen such growth.

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「真正让我感到困扰的是透明度的缺乏。」
exercises.answer: What really troubled me was the lack of transparency

exercises.prompt: 「Only ___ examining the data did we identify the bias.」(中文:「直到检查完数据后,我们才识别出偏差。」)(前置 + 倒装)
exercises.explanation: 即 「Only after V-ing… did we…」 的结构。

exercises.prompt: 「It was Sarah who first raised the issue」 这一结构强调了什么?
exercises.explanation: It-cleft 把焦点放在 「Sarah」 上;对应中文「是 Sarah 第一个提出这个问题的」(「是……的」 强调焦点)。

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「在任何情况下我们都不会重回原协议。」
exercises.answer: Under no circumstances will we revert to the agreement

lessons.title: 高级关系从句与分词结构
lessons.description: 简化关系从句、分词从句、非限定结构

exercises.prompt: 「The report submitted yesterday is incomplete.」 属于什么结构?
exercises.explanation: 「which was submitted」 可简化为 「submitted」(过去分词短语)。

exercises.prompt: 「The candidate ___ for the role has fifteen years of experience.」(中文:「被选中担任这一职位的候选人具有十五年的经验。」)(分词)
结构 — 定义

pairs.right: 不可省略,省略后含义改变;不加逗号

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「主导谈判的顾问今天将做汇报。」
exercises.answer: The consultant leading the negotiation will report today

exercises.prompt: 在 「The findings, which were unexpected, prompted further study」 中,为什么要加逗号?
options: 因为这是非限定(补充信息)的从句
exercises.answer: 因为这是非限定(补充信息)的从句
exercises.explanation: 中文里不区分限定/非限定从句,因此中文 L1 学习者常常漏掉逗号;在英语中,逗号差异会改变语义。

exercises.prompt: 请选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: Having reviewed the proposal, we are prepared to move forward.
options: Having reviewed the proposal, we are prepared to move forward.
Having review the proposal, we are prepared to move forward.
Having reviewed the proposals, we is prepared to move forward.
Have reviewed the proposal, we are prepared to move forward.
exercises.answer: Having reviewed the proposal, we are prepared to move forward.

exercises.prompt: 「___ all things considered, the deal is fair.」(中文:「综合考虑一切因素,这笔交易是公平的。」)
exercises.explanation: 独立分词结构:「all things considered」。

exercises.prompt: 下列哪一句正确使用了分词从句?
options: Walking to work, my phone rang.
Walking to work, I noticed the new café.
Walking to work, the new café opened.
While walking to work, the new café was visible.
exercises.answer: Walking to work, I noticed the new café.
exercises.explanation: 分词的逻辑主语必须与主句一致:走路的是「I」,不是手机。

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「考虑到所做的分析,这一结论是站得住脚的。」
exercises.answer: Given the analysis conducted the conclusion is defensible

exercises.prompt: 「The author, ___ work has shaped the field, will keynote.」(中文:「这位作品塑造了该领域的作者将担任主题演讲嘉宾。」)
「Rules permitting, we'll launch on Friday」 属于什么结构?
options: 简化的 'if' 条件句(独立分词结构)
exercises.answer: 简化的 'if' 条件句(独立分词结构)
exercises.explanation: 「If rules permit」 = 「rules permitting」(独立主格);中文「如规则允许」对应。注意主语和分词必须搭配。

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「如果天气允许,开幕仪式将于明天举行。」
exercises.answer: Weather permitting the opening will take place tomorrow

lessons.title: 对话:与编辑就稿件展开拉锯
lessons.description: 通过分裂句与倒装句转移重音

exercises.prompt: 编辑驳回稿件

turns.speaker: editor
turns.text: Your lede buries the actual story. The reader shouldn't have to wait three paragraphs to find out who did what to whom.

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 为自己的写作辩护 — 用分裂句提出方案
options: Sure thing, I'll just put the answer in like the first sentence then.
What I was trying to foreground was the institutional context, not the individual actor — but I take your point and I'll restructure.
I don't get why you don't like it, it reads fine to me.
turns.answer: What I was trying to foreground was the institutional context, not the individual actor — but I take your point and I'll restructure.

turns.speaker: editor
turns.text: Foregrounding context is fine, but your verbs are limp. Half this draft is in passive voice.

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 倒装强调 — 请补全助动词
turns.after: I revise the verbs, I'll also tighten the modifiers — the draft has accreted some lazy hedges.

turns.speaker: editor
turns.text: Good. And the kicker? It lands like a wet sponge. We need a closing line that actually closes.

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 分裂句 + 建议 — 请选择自然的写作语言
options: It is precisely the absence of a verdict in the source material that I was trying to mirror — but I can sharpen the ambiguity into something more deliberate.
Yeah the ending sucks, my bad, I'll fix it.
Honestly endings are hard, can you just write it for me?
turns.answer: It is precisely the absence of a verdict in the source material that I was trying to mirror — but I can sharpen the ambiguity into something more deliberate.

turns.speaker: editor
turns.text: Sharpened ambiguity, I can work with. But the pull-quote needs an attribution; it's currently floating.

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 分词结构 — 请填入正确的形式
turns.after: the source on background, I had to scrub the attribution — but I can negotiate a partial reveal with her press team.

turns.speaker: editor
turns.text: Negotiate hard. A floating quote in a piece this length will be picked apart on social.

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 在书面话语中以 C1 水准收尾
options: Sure thing, I'll just text her or whatever.
Understood — I'll push for at least an on-the-record paraphrase and route the revision past you before filing.
turns.answer: Understood — I'll push for at least an on-the-record paraphrase and route the revision past you before filing.

turns.speaker: editor
turns.text: By Thursday, please. We're holding the slot but I won't hold it indefinitely.

turns.speaker: you
turns.text: Thursday it is. I'll send the revised draft and a note flagging every change I've made.

topics.title: 辩论与演说
topics.description: 正式辩论中的话语语言

guide.intro: 正式辩论(debate)遵循特定结构:opening(开篇)、rebuttal(反驳)、summary(总结)。词汇选择反映出说话者的信念与逻辑。C1 阶段的说话者会将流利度与词汇的多样性结合起来。

rows: I'd like to begin by addressing…
With respect, I must take issue with…
The argument falls apart when we consider…
In conclusion, the case is clear: …

sections.text: 演说中的形容词选择决定语气。「Profound」 = 深刻;「compelling」 = 极具说服力;「tenuous」 = 脆弱、勉强;「specious」 = 看似合理实则站不住脚;「unfounded」 = 毫无根据。

rows.source: The argument is compelling, but ultimately flawed.
rows.translation: 论证颇具说服力,但最终仍存在缺陷。
这些指控完全没有依据。

rows.source: The reasoning, while seductive, is specious.
rows.translation: 论证看似诱人,实则似是而非。

sections.text: 在英语辩论中,「with respect」 实际上是用来软化反对的措辞。其作用相当于中文里的「恕我直言」或「请允许我冒昧地说」。

lessons.title: 主张与反主张
lessons.description: 熟记句子的开头模式

exercises.prompt: 功能 — 句式

pairs.right: I'd like to begin by addressing…
With respect, I must take issue with…
The argument falls apart when we consider…

exercises.prompt: 「It is my contention that…」 用中文怎么说?
exercises.explanation: 「contention」 是「主张 / 论点」(辩论专用);中文 L1 易因「contend」与「contest」相近而混淆。

exercises.prompt: 「With ___, I must disagree.」(中文:「恕我直言,我必须表示不同意。」)
请组合出这个句子:「在更深入审视后,这一论证便站不住脚了。」
exercises.answer: The argument falls apart on closer inspection

exercises.prompt: 下列哪个形容词用于描述「极具说服力的论证」?
请选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: These claims are wholly unfounded.

exercises.prompt: 「The reasoning is ___; it merely appears valid.」(中文:「这一论证看似成立,实则似是而非。」)
「tenuous」 用中文怎么说?
exercises.explanation: 「tenuous link / claim」 = 「勉强的关联 / 站不住脚的主张」;辩论中用以批评对方论证。

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「总而言之,该主张是站不住脚的。」
「I would ___ urge you to reconsider.」(中文:「我谨以敬意请您重新考虑。」)

lessons.title: 演说性形容词及其细微差别
lessons.description: 为论证语气挑选词汇

exercises.prompt: 形容词 — 中文释义
「profound」 是什么意思?
exercises.explanation: 「profound」 ≠ 「professional」;中文 L1 易将词形相近的两词混淆。「profound」 = 「深远的、深刻的」。

exercises.prompt: 「The implications are ___」(中文:「其后果意味深远。」)
请组合出这个句子:「这个论证看似诱人,实则毫无根据。」
exercises.answer: The argument is seductive but unfounded

exercises.prompt: 哪个形容词承载着「看似有说服力但实则错误」的语气?
请选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: The link between these variables is tenuous at best.
options: The link between these variables is tenuous at best.
The link between these variable is tenuous at best.
The link between these variables is tenuous at beast.
The link between these variables are tenuous at best.
exercises.answer: The link between these variables is tenuous at best.

exercises.prompt: 「These accusations are ___」(中文:「这些指控毫无根据。」)
「rigorous」 用中文怎么说?
exercises.explanation: 「rigorous analysis / methodology」 = 「严谨的分析 / 方法」;辩论中称赞对方时常用。

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「这不是严谨的分析,只是空泛的揣测。」
exercises.answer: This is not rigorous analysis but mere speculation

exercises.prompt: 「Their reasoning is ___ flawed.」(中文:「他们的论证从根本上就是错误的。」)

lessons.title: 话语标记
lessons.description: Granted、conversely、notwithstanding

exercises.prompt: 话语标记词 — 中文释义
「notwithstanding」 是什么意思?
exercises.explanation: 正式语域中的让步连词;可放句首、句中或句尾(罕见);中文「尽管 / 不论」是常见对应。

exercises.prompt: 「___ his concerns, the project went ahead.」(中文:「尽管他有所担忧,项目仍然向前推进。」)
请组合出这个句子:「诚然,这个想法很诱人,然而它并不可行。」
exercises.answer: Granted the idea is appealing however it is not feasible

exercises.prompt: 「Hence」 的语气如何?
options: 正式 / 文言味的「因此」
exercises.answer: 正式 / 文言味的「因此」
exercises.explanation: 「hence」 略带文言色彩,比 「therefore」 更紧凑,比 「so」 更正式;中文「故 / 因而」对应。

exercises.prompt: 请选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: Conversely, smaller firms reported gains.

exercises.prompt: 「The market has shifted; ___, our strategy must adapt.」(中文:「市场已经发生变化,因此我们的战略必须随之调整。」)
下列哪个话语标记起到「让步」的作用?
请组合出这个句子:「相反,在小规模分析中呈现出不同的趋势。」
exercises.answer: Conversely the smaller scale analysis shows a different trend

exercises.prompt: 「___ the criticism, the policy stands.」(中文:「尽管面临批评,该政策依然有效。」)

lessons.title: 反驳模式(rebuttal)
lessons.description: 公平地复述对方论点,然后将其击倒

exercises.prompt: 下列哪一句是公平的「反驳」(rebuttal)的开头?
options: If I understand the argument correctly, …
exercises.answer: If I understand the argument correctly, …

exercises.prompt: 「The argument ___ on a questionable assumption.」(中文:「这一论证依赖于一个值得商榷的假设。」)
exercises.explanation: 「rest on / hinge on」 = 依赖于……。

exercises.prompt: 反驳策略 — 功能

pairs.right: 指出对方混淆了两个不同概念

pairs.left: The evidence cuts the other way

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「该论证将结构性原因与个人选择混为一谈。」
exercises.answer: The argument conflates structural causes with individual choices

exercises.prompt: 「That argument proves too much」 是什么意思?
options: 若接受这一论证,会顺带推出过多荒谬结论,因而有问题
这个论证需要写很多页
exercises.answer: 若接受这一论证,会顺带推出过多荒谬结论,因而有问题
exercises.explanation: 辩论术语:「proves too much」 是逻辑反驳手法 —— 同一论证的逻辑若适用过广,反而暴露其荒谬。

exercises.prompt: 请选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: Even granting the premise, the conclusion does not follow.
options: Even granting the premise, the conclusion does not follow.
Even granted the premise, the conclusion does not follow.
Even granting the premises, the conclusion do not follow.
Even granting the premise, the conclusions does not follow.
exercises.answer: Even granting the premise, the conclusion does not follow.

exercises.prompt: 「The conclusion does not ___ from the evidence presented.」(中文:「这一结论无法从所呈现的证据中推导出来。」)
下列哪一句揭示了对方在使用「稻草人谬误」?
exercises.explanation: 「mischaracterise」 = 误述、扭曲;典型的「稻草人」反击。

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「这一论证将相关性与因果性混为一谈。」
exercises.answer: This argument confuses correlation with causation

exercises.prompt: 「The data, ___ properly examined, suggest the opposite.」(中文:「如经过妥当审视,数据反而支持相反的结论。」)
exercises.explanation: 简化的分词结构:「when properly examined」。

exercises.prompt: 「You're attacking a position I never held」 用中文应怎样表达?
options: 您在攻击一个我从未持有的立场(即「稻草人谬误」)
您在攻击我以前的立场
exercises.answer: 您在攻击一个我从未持有的立场(即「稻草人谬误」)
exercises.explanation: 「稻草人谬误」 = straw man fallacy:对手歪曲你的立场再加以攻击。这是 C1 辩论中应识别的常见逻辑陷阱。

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「一旦其所依赖的假设被推翻,这一论证就会瓦解。」
exercises.answer: The argument collapses once its underlying assumption is rejected

exercises.prompt: 请选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: She told him that he had misunderstood her position entirely.
options: She told him that he had misunderstood her position entirely.
He told her that she had misunderstood his position entirely.
She told him that she had misunderstood his position entirely.
He told him that he had misunderstood her position entirely.
exercises.answer: She told him that he had misunderstood her position entirely.
exercises.explanation: 中文「他」和「她」 同音(tā),中文 L1 在听英语 「he/she/him/her」 时极易混淆。这条题专门训练你保持指代对象一致。

lessons.title: 让一步再反击
lessons.description: Concede-and-pivot:我同意,但是…

exercises.prompt: 下列哪一句是「让步后转向」(concede-and-pivot)的策略?
options: Granted, the cost is real; that said, the benefits outweigh it.
exercises.answer: Granted, the cost is real; that said, the benefits outweigh it.

exercises.prompt: 「There is ___ truth to that, but it overlooks the bigger picture.」(中文:「这话有几分道理,但忽视了更宏观的全貌。」)
话语策略 — 标签

pairs.left: That's true as far as it goes, but…

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「你在成本问题上是对的,但不作为的代价更高。」
exercises.answer: You are right about the cost yet inaction is more expensive still

exercises.prompt: 「That's true as far as it goes」 是什么意思?
options: 在一定程度上是对的(但不完整)
exercises.answer: 在一定程度上是对的(但不完整)
exercises.explanation: 「as far as it goes」 = 「就其本身而言」(但有边界);常用于做有限让步后再拓展批评。

exercises.prompt: 请选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: I take your point about timing; the underlying logic, however, still holds.
options: I take your point about timing; the underlying logic, however, still holds.
I take your point about timing; the underlying logic, however, still hold.
I take your points about timing; the underlying logic, however, still holds.
I take your point about timings; the underlying logics, however, still holds.
exercises.answer: I take your point about timing; the underlying logic, however, still holds.

exercises.prompt: 「I ___ your concern, but the data still favour the proposal.」(中文:「我理解您的顾虑,但数据仍然支持这一提案。」)
exercises.explanation: 「appreciate one's concern」 是礼貌承认对方关切的固定说法。

exercises.prompt: 「Be that as it may」 这一表达的功能是什么?
options: 先让一步,再表达不同意见
exercises.answer: 先让一步,再表达不同意见
exercises.explanation: 倒装让步句的化石用法;中文「即便如此 / 话虽如此」对应。属于 C1 / C2 正式语域。

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「这一批评是中肯的,但所提出的解决方案仍显不足。」
exercises.answer: The criticism is fair yet the proposed solution falls short

exercises.prompt: 「Be that ___ it may, the policy remains the most defensible option.」(中文:「即便如此,该政策仍然是最具说服力的选择。」)
下列哪一句最自然地体现了「让步后反驳」?
options: Fair enough on the data quality, but the trend is unmistakable.
exercises.answer: Fair enough on the data quality, but the trend is unmistakable.

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「即便我接受这一点,结论依然不变。」
exercises.answer: While I concede that point the conclusion still does not change

lessons.title: 对话:学术会议小组中的正式反驳
lessons.description: 让步再反击 — 正式小组讨论中的语言

exercises.prompt: 在小组讨论中回应反方论证

turns.speaker: mod
turns.text: Dr. Yıldız, your opponent argues that your framework collapses under scrutiny. Your rebuttal, please.

turns.speaker: opp
turns.text: The framework presumes rational actors, which empirical work has dismantled for at least two decades.

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 先让步,再反驳 — C1 演说句式
options: Nope, you're wrong, end of story.
I'd grant the premise on rationality — but the framework was never wedded to it; it survives the move to bounded rationality, as I argue in Chapter 3.
Actually empirical work doesn't even matter that much honestly.
turns.answer: I'd grant the premise on rationality — but the framework was never wedded to it; it survives the move to bounded rationality, as I argue in Chapter 3.

turns.speaker: opp
turns.text: That move, however, hollows out the predictive content. You're left with a model that explains everything and forbids nothing.

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 倒装强调 — 请补全助动词
turns.after: devoid of forbidden states, the critique would stick — but it generates testable restrictions on transition probabilities, which I document.

turns.speaker: opp
turns.text: Documenting restrictions is not the same as them surviving falsification. Have any been rejected?

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 在正式话语中选择 「fair point」 类的表达
options: Fair challenge — and yes, two of the original restrictions failed under the 2022 dataset, which I treat at length in the revised edition.
Don't think so but it's whatever.
turns.answer: Fair challenge — and yes, two of the original restrictions failed under the 2022 dataset, which I treat at length in the revised edition.

turns.speaker: opp
turns.text: Two failures out of how many? At some point one has to ask whether the framework is being protected by ad hoc patches.

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 正式的让步标记 — 请在空格中填入合适的表达
turns.after: the charge of ad-hocness is one I take seriously — which is precisely why each amendment is tied to a pre-registered prediction, not a post-hoc rescue.

turns.speaker: mod
turns.text: We have time for a final exchange. Dr. Yıldız, your closing thirty seconds.

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: C1 收尾 — 礼貌但清晰地占据优势
options: The disagreement is real, but it's a disagreement about degree, not about kind — and on that narrower terrain I am happy to leave the verdict to the empirical record.
turns.answer: The disagreement is real, but it's a disagreement about degree, not about kind — and on that narrower terrain I am happy to leave the verdict to the empirical record.

turns.speaker: mod
turns.text: Thank you both. We'll open it to the floor after a short break.

topics.title: 艺术与评论
topics.description: 电影、文学、音乐与画廊文章中的评论英语

guide.intro: 艺术评论英语是一种需要精细把握的语域。人们用 「accomplished」、「derivative」、「evocative」、「heavy-handed」 这类形容词来取代 「good」、「bad」。中文里的「经典」「悲剧」「讽刺」与英文同源词看似对应,但语义范围更窄:「a classic film」 = 某类型的代表作;「tragedy」 是文学体裁;「ironic」 是与预期相反(中文里常被错用为「巧合」)。

sections.text: 在 C1 阶段的评论写作中,直接说「好」或「坏」显得乏力。「Accomplished」(精湛)和 「masterful」(炉火纯青)用于褒奖;「derivative」(模仿性强)、「contrived」(刻意)、「pretentious」(故作姿态)、「heavy-handed」(粗笨)则用于批评。

rows.source: The film struck a chord with audiences worldwide.
rows.translation: 这部电影触动了全球观众的心弦。

rows.source: The novel falls flat in its final act.
rows.translation: 小说在最后一幕里失去了张力。

rows.source: It is a tour de force of contemporary cinema.
rows.translation: 是当代电影中的一部杰作。

rows.source: A slow burn that rewards patient viewers.
rows.translation: 是一部慢热但回报耐心观众的作品。

rows.source: The album was ahead of its time.
rows.translation: 这张专辑超越了它所处的时代。

rows.source: It's a guilty pleasure of mine.
rows.translation: 是我难以承认却确实喜欢的「秘密快乐」。

sections.text: 中文里的「艺术」涵盖手工艺;但英文 「art」 范围更窄,通常与高雅文化挂钩。表示手工艺时请用 「crafts」 或 「craftsmanship」。
中文里「经典的」有时也带有「典型的/老套的」之意(例如「典型错误」)。但英文 「a classic」 仅指「某类别中的杰出范例」;「典型错误」 = 「a textbook mistake」。

lessons.title: 评论性形容词
lessons.description: 褒义与贬义形容词的细微差别

exercises.prompt: 「成熟而精湛的表演」最适合用哪个形容词?
若要把一部电影评价为「缺乏原创、纯粹模仿」,该用哪个形容词?
exercises.explanation: 「derivative」 = 衍生自他人作品、缺乏原创性的。

exercises.prompt: 「The director's restraint makes the climax all the more ___.」(中文:「导演的克制使高潮更加富有联想力。」)
形容词 — 中文对应释义
「Heavy-handed」 这一批评强调的是什么?
exercises.explanation: 「heavy-handed」 = 「下手过重 / 粗糙」;评论中常用于剧本、配乐过于直白时。中文「拳重」「粗笨」是常见对应。

exercises.prompt: 请选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: Her debut novel is a remarkably accomplished piece of writing.
options: Her debut novel is a remarkably accomplished piece of writing.
Her debut novel is a remarkable accomplish piece of writing.
Her debut novel is a remarkably accomplish piece of writing.
Her debut novel is remarkable accomplished piece of writing.
exercises.answer: Her debut novel is a remarkably accomplished piece of writing.

exercises.prompt: 「The film is visually ___ but emotionally hollow.」(中文:「这部电影在视觉上精雕细琢,但在情感上空洞无物。」)
「Pretentious」 用中文该如何翻译?
options: 做作 / 故作姿态、内里空洞
exercises.answer: 做作 / 故作姿态、内里空洞
exercises.explanation: C1 评论形容词;中文 L1 学习者常误将「pretentious」与「impressive」混为一谈,但前者是贬义。

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「导演达到了一种原始而生猛的真诚。」
exercises.answer: The director achieves a raw honesty

exercises.prompt: 下列哪个形容词最贴近「将观众带入其中」?
「The dialogue feels ___ in places, as if written for effect.」(中文:「对话在某些段落显得刻意,仿佛是为了效果而写。」)
请组合出这个句子:「舞台设计简素朴拙,却充满联想力。」
exercises.answer: The set design is austere yet evocative

lessons.title: 褒奖与批评的模式
lessons.description: 组织正面与负面的评价

exercises.prompt: 「这部小说真正的精妙在于结构。」 用英语怎么说?
options: The novel's true mastery lies in its structure.
The novel true mastery is in structure.
The mastery true of novel lies on structure.
True mastery the novel structure has.
exercises.answer: The novel's true mastery lies in its structure.

exercises.prompt: 「The performance falls ___ in the second half.」(中文:「这场演出在下半场失去了张力。」)
评论句式 — 含义
请组合出这个句子:「这是过去十年最具野心的作品之一。」
exercises.answer: This is one of the most ambitious works of the past decade

exercises.prompt: 下列哪一句是负面评价?
options: The film is sorely lacking in emotional weight.
An immersive triumph from start to finish.
A polished piece of contemporary fiction.
exercises.answer: The film is sorely lacking in emotional weight.

exercises.prompt: 请选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: The screenplay never quite lives up to the premise.
options: The screenplay never quite lives up to the premise.
The screenplay never quite live up to the premise.
The screenplays never quite lives up to the premise.
The screenplay never quiet lives up to the premise.
exercises.answer: The screenplay never quite lives up to the premise.

exercises.prompt: 「A welcome ___ to form for the director.」(中文:「这位导演令人欣喜地回到了巅峰状态。」)
该如何理解 「It is by no means flawless, yet utterly compelling.」?
options: 并非毫无瑕疵,但极具感染力
exercises.answer: 并非毫无瑕疵,但极具感染力
exercises.explanation: 「by no means X, yet Y」 是评论文章中的典型让步;中文 L1 易漏掉 「by no means」 的强否定。

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「它没能兑现自己的承诺,很快从人们的记忆中消散。」
exercises.answer: It fails to deliver and quickly fades from memory

exercises.prompt: 「A ___ of the genre, both daring and disciplined.」(中文:「该类型中的一座高峰 —— 既大胆又自律。」)
「Uneven but never uninteresting」 用中文怎么翻译?
options: 水准参差不齐,但从未乏味
exercises.answer: 水准参差不齐,但从未乏味

exercises.prompt: 「A masterful, immersive piece of cinema.」 评论者的态度是什么?

lessons.title: 对话:展览开幕式上与策展人的交谈

exercises.prompt: 画廊开幕 — 站在新画作面前

topics.title: 新闻与评论专栏
topics.description: 新闻、分析与评论专栏语域中的高级英语

guide.intro: 新闻英语包含三种不同的语域:纯报道(reporting)、分析(analysis)与评论专栏(editorial / op-ed)。中文里的「新闻语言」看起来像是一种统一的范式,但在英语中,即便最微小的语气变化 —— 用 「claimed」 替换 「said」、用 「alleged」 替换 「reported」 —— 都会改变含义。

sections.text: Reporting 追求客观中立(「Officials announced…」)。Analysis 对数据进行解读(「What this means for…」)。Editorial / op-ed 则会表明立场(「It is high time we…」)。混用这三种语域是严重的语域错误。

rows: According to officials, the bill passed…
What this means for the wider economy…
It is high time we addressed…

rows.source: according to sources familiar with the matter
rows.translation: 据熟悉此事的消息人士透露

rows.source: amid concerns that markets may overheat
rows.translation: 在市场可能过热的担忧之中

rows.source: officials say no decision has been made
rows.translation: 官员表示尚未做出决定

rows.source: the spokesperson did not immediately respond

items: alleged:据称(尚未被证实)
claimed:声称(引述中带有距离感)
reportedly:据报道(确定性较低)
purportedly:声称的、所谓的(带怀疑色彩)
ostensibly:表面上(真实意图可能并非如此)

sections.text: 新闻标题中冠词通常被省略(「Senate Passes Budget」),用现在时表示过去事件(「Court Rules Against…」),使用冒号加引号的格式(「Minister: "This is a turning point"」),并以来源后缀结尾(「…: Report」)。
评论文章中常见的套路化表达:「It is high time we…」、「One could argue…」、「Make no mistake…」、「Far from being a panacea…」。这些句式是 op-ed 与评论文章的标志;若用于纯报道,则属于严重的语域错位。

lessons.title: Reporting / Analysis / Editorial 之间的区分
lessons.description: 辨析三种语域的语气

exercises.prompt: 下列哪一句使用了纯报道(reporting)的语域?

exercises.prompt: 「Make no ___: this changes everything.」(中文:「不要搞错:这件事改变一切。」)— op-ed

lessons.title: 引述与消息来源的模式
lessons.description: 「According to」、「amid concerns」、「declined to comment」等等

exercises.prompt: 「据熟悉此事的消息人士透露」 用英语怎么说?

according to sources familiar with the matter

exercises.prompt: 「The minister ___ to comment on the allegations.」(中文:「这位部长拒绝就指控发表评论。」)

exercises.prompt: 「Amid concerns that markets may overheat」 这一结构的功能是什么?
exercises.explanation: 「amid X」 = 「在 X 之中」;新闻报道常用以提示事件发生的背景氛围,不下定论。

exercises.prompt: 请选出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: The agency declined to comment, citing the ongoing investigation.

The agency decline to comment, citing the ongoing investigation.
The agency declined to comment, citing an ongoing investigations.
The agency declined to comments, citing the ongoing investigation.

exercises.prompt: 「Two ___ familiar with the talks confirmed the figure.」(中文:「两名熟悉谈判情况的消息人士证实了这一数字。」)
为了让 「Officials said」 的语气带上更强的怀疑色彩,应写什么?
exercises.explanation: 「claimed」 给引述添上怀疑色彩;「said」 是中性表达。

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「政府表示尚未做出任何决定。」

exercises.explanation: 新闻惯用句:形式上中立(只是叙述事实),但读者会读出「该方避而不答」的暗示。

exercises.prompt: 请组合出这个句子:「该办公室拒绝就此事置评。」

lessons.title: 标题语法

exercises.prompt: 下列哪个标题符合英语新闻标题的规则?

lessons.description: 论点句、强调技巧与套路化的署名风格

exercises.prompt: 「It is high time we acted on this.」 的语气如何?

exercises.answer: 强调紧迫性的个人主张
exercises.explanation: 「it is high time + 过去式」 是评论文章的固定句式;中文「该是 / 早该……了」是对应。属于 op-ed 标志性套路。

exercises.prompt: 请选出你听到的句子

topics.title: 文学散文
topics.description: 小说、随笔与高级文学中的语言

guide.intro: 文学英语层次密集,通常在拉丁词源与日耳曼词源之间精心平衡。C2 阶段,作家的语域选择(Latinate vs Germanic)、句长与隐喻使用都是有意为之的工具。中文读者尤需注意:英语「commence / terminate / perceive」类词带有文言式克制,与中文 之 / 然 / 矣 的书面色彩相当;而 Germanic 短词则近乎白话直叙。

sections.text: 英语表达同一概念常有两条路径:盎格鲁-撒克逊词源(短、具体)与拉丁/法语词源(长、抽象)。文学作者借这一选择切换文本的语调。中文学习者常误以为长词总更得体——其实正相反,刻意的 Germanic 短句往往更具文学张力。
散文中叙述视角(第一人称、第三人称、自由间接引语、第二人称)决定语调与距离。「Free indirect speech」(自由间接引语)是英语的标志:不加引号、不带「he said」即可呈现角色的思想。中文白话文虽也有近似手法,但更倚赖句末助词如 罢了 / 也罢 来透露心理。

rows.source: She wondered if he had ever truly loved her. Probably not.
rows.translation: 她在想他是否真的爱过她。大概没有吧。

rows.source: It was not, he reflected, the worst of all possible worlds.
rows.translation: 他寻思,这并不是所有可能世界中最糟的一个。

rows.source: The hour was late; the streets, deserted; the city, somnolent.
rows.translation: 夜深;街道,空寂;城市,昏沉。

sections.text: C2 读者应当意识到:逗号也可以与分号同样具有戏剧性。文学语体中,标点常是节奏本身的一部分,正如中文的「、」与「,」差之毫厘。

turns.answer: Earned, on balance — though the final paragraph teeters on the edge of sentimentality without quite tipping over.

turns.speaker: mara

topics.title: 修辞与说服
topics.description: 演讲、社论与说服艺术

guide.intro: 修辞依托三大支柱:ethos(品格)、pathos(情感)、logos(逻辑)。C2 演说者会构造能引发听众思考的句子,熟悉古典修辞格。中文写作传统讲究「起承转合」,英语社论则讲究「thesis → argument → refutation → call to action」——两者节奏不同,需要切换。

rows: We shall fight on the beaches; we shall fight on the landing grounds…
Government of the people, by the people, for the people.
Ask not what your country can do for you; ask what you can do for your country.
It was the best of times, it was the worst of times.
Veni, vidi, vici (I came, I saw, I conquered).

sections.text: Op-ed(社论)英文以论点开篇,用证据支撑,承认并驳斥对方,以呼吁(call to action)收束。句长在短促与绵长之间切换节奏。中文社论常用「不得不说」「值得深思」类钩子,英语则偏好「Make no mistake」「To suggest otherwise is to ignore the evidence」。

rows.source: Make no mistake: this policy will define a generation.
rows.translation: 毋庸讳言:这项政策将定义一整代人。

rows.source: To suggest otherwise is to ignore the evidence.
rows.translation: 若作他论,等同无视证据。

rows.source: We owe it to ourselves — and to those who come after — to act now.
rows.translation: 我们既亏欠自己,也亏欠后来者——必须现在行动。

sections.text: 中文里「我们大家」对应英语 'we, as a society' 或干脆只用 'we'。加上 'as a society' 会让语气更克制、更具公共性。

exercises.prompt: 把「客气一点说,他的回应让人失望」 翻成 C2 英语,最自然的是?
options: Speak more politely, his response was disappointing.

lessons.title: 对话:与编辑修改社论
lessons.description: 在报社与编辑一起打磨你的专栏稿——修辞格与 hedging。

exercises.prompt: 与编辑修改社论

turns.speaker: editor
turns.text: The argument's solid, but the lede is doing too much heavy lifting. You're asserting where you should be insinuating. Soften the verbs.

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 接受编辑关于 hedging 的建议
options: Fair point — I'll recast 'proves' as 'suggests' and let the reader do the arithmetic.
OK, I will make the words less strong, that is a fair point.
Sure, I'll dial down the rhetoric so it's not so in-your-face, totally.
turns.answer: Fair point — I'll recast 'proves' as 'suggests' and let the reader do the arithmetic.

turns.speaker: editor
turns.text: Better. Now, paragraph three — that tricolon. It's clean, but it lands as glib. Either earn it or cut it.

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 一个修辞动词——让一个修辞格物有所值
turns.before: I take your point — let me see whether the tricolon
turns.after: its keep before I sacrifice it.

turns.speaker: editor
turns.text: Good. And the kicker — you're hedging there in a way that reads as cowardice rather than nuance. Pick a side, or commit to your ambivalence.

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 针对编辑的批评,捍卫这种模棱两可
options: I'd push back, gently — the ambivalence isn't a hedge, it's the argument. To resolve it would be to misrepresent the evidence.
I disagree with you, the not-deciding is the actual point of the piece.
Nah, that's me sitting on the fence on purpose, it's literally the whole point.
turns.answer: I'd push back, gently — the ambivalence isn't a hedge, it's the argument. To resolve it would be to misrepresent the evidence.

turns.speaker: editor
turns.text: Fair — though if that's the move, the kicker has to signal it. As written, it reads as flinching.

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 用一个修辞格回应——提出 antithesis
options: Then let me rebuild it with an antithesis — 'not certainty, but the courage of uncertainty' — something to that effect.
I will make the ending have two opposite words to make it stronger.
I'll throw in some literary device, you know, like 'A but not A' or whatever.
turns.answer: Then let me rebuild it with an antithesis — 'not certainty, but the courage of uncertainty' — something to that effect.

turns.speaker: editor
turns.text: And the headline — it's serviceable, but it doesn't earn the piece beneath it. Can you give me something that whispers rather than shouts?

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 用于 hedging 的柔和情态动词
turns.before: Let me try — something like 'Why the certainty is the symptom' — that
turns.after: do the work without overselling.

turns.speaker: editor
turns.text: Now you're cooking. Send me a fresh draft by six and we'll run it tomorrow.

topics.title: 哲学与抽象思考
topics.description: 形而上学概念与精细论证

guide.intro: 哲学文本是英语名词化(nominalization)最密集的体裁。「to be / to know」一类基本动词常被转为名词:being, knowing, becoming, awareness。C2 阅读者应能从这种密度中读出论证结构。中文学习者需注意:汉语「之」「者」可以承担轻量名物化,但英语的 -ness / -ity / -ion 名词化往往会让句子结构更长更抽象。

rows: 能动性 / 行动者地位

sections.text: 哲学中情态动词的选择决定论证的强度。'Might have done'、'could have done'、'may have done' 之间差异微妙:'might' 最弱,'could' 强调能力或可能性,'may' 偏许可或或然。中文「也许 / 可能 / 可以」之间的边界比英语模糊,需要刻意训练。

rows.source: He might have known, but the evidence suggests otherwise.
rows.translation: 他也许知道,但证据另有所指。

rows.source: Such an act may be defensible on consequentialist grounds.
rows.translation: 此种行为在后果论立场上或可辩护。

rows.source: One ought not to assume that being entails knowing.
rows.translation: 不应想当然地认为「存在」即蕴含「知道」。

sections.text: C2 测试常用哲学文本:高密度名词化、被 hedge 过的情态用法、长句论证结构,这些正是中文学习者最易卡住之处。

lessons.title: 对话:哲学研讨课上的概念辩论
lessons.description: 在博士研讨课上讨论「自由」概念的界定——情态细微差别密集。

exercises.prompt: 哲学研讨课上的自由概念

turns.speaker: prof
turns.text: Let's begin from a deceptively simple question: when we say an agent could have done otherwise, what is the modal force of that 'could'?

turns.speaker: rina
turns.text: I'd read it as nomological possibility — consistent with the laws of nature, given the actual state of the world.

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 用情态细微差别提出反方立场
options: I'd want to distinguish that from a weaker reading on which 'could' tracks merely epistemic possibility — what, for all we know, might have obtained.
I think we should say 'could' just means we don't know what could happen.
Yeah but maybe 'could' just means like, anything could happen, you know?
turns.answer: I'd want to distinguish that from a weaker reading on which 'could' tracks merely epistemic possibility — what, for all we know, might have obtained.

turns.speaker: prof
turns.text: Good. And on the nomological reading, are we already conceding too much to the compatibilist? Rina?

turns.speaker: rina
turns.text: Possibly, yes — though I'd want to hear the counter-move before I commit.

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 在哲学辩论中使用一个情态助动词
turns.after: grant the laws-plus-state reading while denying that this exhausts what we mean by 'could'.

turns.speaker: prof
turns.text: Now you're making the move I was hoping someone would make. Press on it.

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 把论证推进到 C2 水平
options: The thought is that 'could have done otherwise' tracks something agential — a capacity exercised — and capacities aren't reducible to the modal profile of physical states.
The idea is that doing things is about the person, not about science laws and stuff.
Like, 'could have' is about you, not physics, capisce?
turns.answer: The thought is that 'could have done otherwise' tracks something agential — a capacity exercised — and capacities aren't reducible to the modal profile of physical states.

turns.speaker: rina
turns.text: But now you owe us an account of capacity that doesn't smuggle modality back in through the side door.

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 用哲学家的口吻作出让步
options: I'll concede that's the genuine difficulty — though I'd resist the suggestion that the regress is vicious rather than merely uncomfortable.
OK that is a problem but maybe it is not a real problem.
Touché — but, like, the loop isn't bad-bad, just awkward-bad.
turns.answer: I'll concede that's the genuine difficulty — though I'd resist the suggestion that the regress is vicious rather than merely uncomfortable.

turns.speaker: prof
turns.text: Excellent. We'll return to whether 'merely uncomfortable' will do, next week.

topics.title: 地区英语:UK / US / Aus

guide.intro: 英语是全球语言,但地区差异显著。C2 水平要求能辨识 UK、US 与 Aus 之间的词汇与发音差异。Register 错位会传递错误印象:在美国说 lift 显得做作,在英国说 elevator 则显得刻意。中文学习者常以为「英美差不多」,但 fries / chips / crisps 的三方错位足以让你在饭桌上点错菜。

sections.text: UK 拼写:-our (colour)、-ise (organise)、-re (centre)、-lled (travelled)。US 拼写:-or (color)、-ize (organize)、-er (center)、-led (traveled)。Aus 一般跟随 UK。中文学习者投稿英文论文时尤需统一一种拼写系统,不可混用。

topics.title: 学术写作与文学批评
topics.description: 捍卫论点并设定边界

guide.intro: C2 写作不仅是语法,更是逻辑结构的精雕细琢。论点句要锐利,证据要精挑,反方论点要诚实地交代。中文学生写英文论文常见两大问题:一是段落塞入多个 claim,二是过度使用绝对化(definitely, undoubtedly),容易招致审稿人质疑。

rows: 交代背景与议题重要性
重述论点 + 扩展语境

sections.text: 批判性论文不只是「概述」一本书或一篇文章,而是检验其论证、置于语境、评估其贡献。中文写作传统里「读后感」往往以「我觉得」开头,英语学术评论则改用「The text argues / overlooks / underplays」等结构动词。

rows.source: While the author makes a compelling case, the analysis overlooks…
rows.translation: 作者论述具说服力,但其分析忽略了……

rows.source: This essay argues that, contrary to the prevailing view,…
rows.translation: 本文主张:与主流看法相反,……

sections.text: 英语学术段落围绕一个 claim 展开。中文学习者常在一个段落塞入多个论点——这在 C2 评分里直接扣分。

lessons.description: Hedging 与限定

lessons.title: 对话:研究生写作工作坊
